scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
This..and..that...
All guys...are distrustful.
Makes me a braggart.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
這個...那個...
所有人...都不信任我。
這讓我像個吹牛大王。

scripts.text: Do you have a problem?
scripts.translation: 你有問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I haven't seen you before.
Are you a traveler?
If so, then you may have
seen many marvelous things
from near and far.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我以前沒見過你。
你是旅行者嗎？
如果是的話，那你一定
見過遠近許多奇妙的景象。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I'm sure you'll probably
be interested in my story.
All the villagers are blockheads,
so they treat me like an idiot.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我想你大概會對我的故事感興趣。
村民們都是些笨蛋，
他們把我當傻子看待。

scripts.text: I'm not interested in any story.
scripts.translation: 我對任何故事都不感興趣。

scripts.text: Tell me.
scripts.translation: 告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Indeed... You are not interested...
That's ok.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
確實...你並不感興趣...
沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If you change your mind,
you can talk to me whenever.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
如果你改變主意了，
隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Good, I have been thinking that
I would tell you this story from the start.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
很好，我本來就想
從頭開始給你講這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
You seem to have spent
only a few days here.
Have you ever heard
about The Moving Island?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
你似乎只在這裡待了幾天。
你聽說過“移動之島”嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
In Moscovia,
a story is handed down
from the ancients, like legends.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
在莫斯科比亞，
有一個故事從古代流傳下來，
就像傳說一樣。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
It is said that
there is an island
which sometimes moves,
not far out at sea.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
據說在離海岸不遠的地方，
有一座島嶼，
它有時會移動。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But, nobody has seen
the island before.
So, few people have
believed the legend.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
但是，沒有人見過
那座島嶼。
所以，很少有人
相信這個傳說。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
實際上，我以為那
可能只是某種
古老的故事...僅此而已。
但後來...我看見了...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...
The Moving Island!!!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
實際上，我以為那
可能只是某種
古老的故事...僅此而已。
但後來...我看見了...
移動之島！！！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Surprised? Right...
It is so surprising.
Frankly, you don't believe
any of this story either.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
驚訝嗎？沒錯...
確實很令人驚訝。
坦白說，你也不相信
這個故事的任何部分。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I saw the island
from the middle of
the village's south shore.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我是從村莊南岸的
中間位置看到那座島的。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
At first, I doubted my eyes.
I have never heard that that island
really existed here, even though I
have lived here all my life!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
起初，我懷疑自己的眼睛。
雖然我在這裡生活了一輩子，
但我從未聽說過那座島
真的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I tried to go up
to look at it from
higher ground, but
the island receded
and disappeared...
back to the sea.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我試圖爬上去，
從高處觀察它，但
島嶼退去了，
消失了...
回到了大海中。

scripts.text: The island doesn't appear anymore?
scripts.translation: 島嶼不再出現了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If it does,
one might just think
that they've looked
at an apparition.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
如果是這樣，
人們或許會覺得
自己看到了
海市蜃樓。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But a few nights ago...
Finally, the island appeared
in front of me again,
while I was driving my ship to go home.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
但就在幾天前...
當我駕船回家時，
那座島終於再次
出現在我面前。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
At that time, I tried to
get near the island again,
slowly, but it disappeared...
beyond the sea once more.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
當時，我試圖
再次靠近那座島，
慢慢地，但它又消失了...
再次隱入大海深處。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
It was then, I couldn't help
to finally believe
in the existence of
The Moving Island!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
就在那一刻，我不得不
最終相信
移動島的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Surely, this must be
a great discovery!
Don't you think??
Doesn't your heart shout out in
hopes of adventuring out to the island?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
這絕對是一個
偉大的發現！
你不覺得嗎？
難道你的心中
沒有湧起想要去島上冒險的渴望嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I haven't given up yet!
Certainly, it'll appear again
right in front of us!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我還沒有放棄！
它一定會再次
出現在我們面前！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
And on that day,
I'll definitely go up to that
island... and verify it with my own eyes!
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
到那一天，
我一定會登上那座島...
並親眼驗證它的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Clearly, I want to prove
the existence of that island to everyone...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
顯然，我想向所有人
證明那座島的存在...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If the island appears again,
I should certify its identity.
Would you like to try it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
如果那座島再次出現，
我應該確認它的身份。
你想試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
The best way to find the
island is by direct contact
with a ship in the sea.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
找到那座島的最佳方式
是直接與海上的船隻
取得聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Me?
Of course I have a ship.
I am a fisherman after all...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
我？
當然我有船。
畢竟我是個漁夫...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Ah, you do? You need...
a ship? Hm...too bad.
I can't lend my ship to you...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
啊，是嗎？你需要...
一艘船？嗯...真遺憾。
我不能把我的船借給你...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But maybe Mr. Ibanoff
can lend his ship to you
He likes going around
adventuring like me.
He seems to enjoy his youth...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
但也許伊巴諾夫先生
可以把他的船借給你。
他喜歡像我一樣四處冒險。
他似乎很享受他的青春...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Mr. Ibanoff also traveled and
adventured all over the world
like you, so he might understand
your sentiments well.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
伊巴諾夫先生也像你一樣
周遊世界並冒險，
所以他可能很理解
你的心情。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If you want to find the island
by ship, go to Mr. Ibanoff
and ask for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
如果你想坐船找到那座島，
去找伊巴諾夫先生
請求他的幫助吧。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Are you serious? Did you say
you've found The Moving Island?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
你是認真的嗎？你說你
找到了移動島？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
The legend is true!!
I was right, wasn't I?
You must be a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
傳說是真的！！
我是對的，不是嗎？
你一定是一位偉大的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Welcome to Moscovia.
What's your impression thus far?
Looks gorgeous, huh?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
歡迎來到莫斯科比亞。
你目前的印象如何？
看起來很壯觀，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Most travelers and strangers
like our village.
I want you to visit places here and
there. You'll probably love this town.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾巴耶夫]
大多數旅行者和陌生人
都喜歡我們的村莊。
我想讓你去這裡那裡逛逛。
你大概會喜歡這個城鎮的。

scripts.text:
[Charabel Schedule]
NOTICE, due to the varying
tides here in Moscovia,
the charabel can only
depart when the tide is low.
scripts.translation:
[查拉貝爾日程]
告示：由於莫斯科比亞的潮汐變化，
查拉貝爾船隻能在低潮時出發。

scripts.text:
[Charabel Schedule]
The Charabel can depart
between the following times:
^0000FF12:00am PST^000000 to ^0000FF3:00am PST
^0000FF6:00am PST^000000 to ^0000FF9:00am PST
^0000FF12:00pm PST^000000 to ^0000FF3:00pm PST
^0000FF6:00pm PST^000000 to ^0000FF9:00pm PST
scripts.translation:
[查拉貝爾日程]
查拉貝爾船可在以下時間出發：
^0000FF上午12:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF上午3:00 PST
^0000FF上午6:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF上午9:00 PST
^0000FF下午12:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF下午3:00 PST
^0000FF下午6:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF下午9:00 PST

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You are also an adventurer from another province. I also was a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你也是來自其他地區的冒險者。我也曾是一位偉大的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Uf...I just want to be 20 years younger, so I can travel here and there with invigorating youth such as you... Time is an enemy. Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
唉...我真希望能年輕20歲，這樣就能像你們這些充滿活力的年輕人一樣四處旅行了...時間真是敵人啊。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. Are you Mr. Ibanoff?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。請問是伊巴諾夫先生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Yes. I am Mr. Ibanoff.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
是的，我就是伊巴諾夫先生。
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me an adventure story.
scripts.translation: 給我講個冒險故事。

scripts.text: Lend me your ship.
scripts.translation: 借你的船用一下。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You are an adventurer, right?
You come from a strange land?
Well, well, well...
You are welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你是一位冒險者，對吧？
你來自一個陌生的地方？
哎呀，哎呀...
歡迎你來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When I adventured around
Rune-Midgarts, maybe it was
well before you were born.
Ah... I miss those days...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
當我在盧恩·米德加茲冒險的時候，也許那還是你出生前很久的事。
啊...我懷念那些日子...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Now, I'm so tired;
my body and my heart.
I get reminded of fond
memories just by looking at the sea...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
現在，我太累了；
身心俱疲。
只要看著大海，就會想起那些美好的回憶...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Um... Stories...
What to talk about first?
Right, I'll talk about that time I
fought against a huge flock of Porings...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯...故事...
先講哪個好呢？
對了，我就講講那次我和一大群波利戰鬥的經歷吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahaha...

[Mr. Ibanoff]
You'll be happy that you
listened to the adventure story.
Well, well, well...
When I was 24 years old...
My colleagues and I were passing by
a forest near Payon...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
聽了這個冒險故事，你一定會很高興的。
哎呀，哎呀...
在我24歲的時候...
我和同事們路過斐揚附近的一片森林...

scripts.text: when...
and....
then.....
Finally......

[Mr. Ibanoff]
I did a very good
job in the fight, so
my colleagues and I were
able to get back safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
在那場戰鬥中我表現出色，
所以我和同事們都能安全地回來了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What did you think?
Next... Let's talk about
the haunting of a Goblin mob...!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你覺得怎麼樣？
接下來...讓我們聊聊刺刀哥布靈群出沒的故事吧...！

scripts.text: I'll listen next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再聽吧...

scripts.text: Interesting. Keep talking.
scripts.translation: 有意思。繼續說。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If not...Ooo, I can just
keep going and going...
No? Too bad... Hehe...
Let's talk next time.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果不聽的話...噢哦，我簡直可以一直說下去...
不？太可惜了...嘿嘿...
下次再聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Yeah? Ohohoh... my friend,
we are in sync with each other...!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
是嗎？噢哦哦...我的朋友，
我們真是心有靈犀啊...！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ok, this time I'll talk
about the bloody fight at the
haunting of a Goblin mob...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
好吧，這次我要講講
刺刀哥布靈群出沒時那場血腥的戰鬥...

scripts.text: You see...
scripts.translation: 你看...

scripts.text: and....
also.....
Lastly......

[Mr. Ibanoff]
So, the day's great bloody
fight was over like that...
Ohwee...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
就這樣，那天那場偉大的血腥戰鬥結束了...
噢喂...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hah! You are the first
to listen carefully to
my stories, for a long time.
Feels so good...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哈哈！你是很久以來
第一個認真聽我講故事的人。
感覺真好...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You absolutely have talent,
as a great adventurer.
You can become a good friend to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你絕對有天賦，
作為一名偉大的冒險者。
你可以成為我的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Next time, we talk about your
adventure story... eh? ~
If you ever need anything,
come talk to me whenever, hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
下次，我們聊聊你的
冒險故事...嗯？~
如果你需要任何幫助，
隨時來找我，哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ah! The good listener!
What will you do if you
borrow my ship? I wonder...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
啊！這位善於傾聽的朋友！
如果你借我的船，你會做什麼呢？我很好奇...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm going to adventure out
to sea, to find a moving
island which has brought
many a legend to this neighboring village.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要出海冒險，
去尋找一座移動島嶼，
它給這個鄰近的村莊
帶來了許多傳說。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The Moving Island?
I have never seen that really...
You are young! Hawhawhaw!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
移動島嶼？
我從未真正見過它...
你還年輕啊！哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I hope that you find
the island without fail,
and that you bring back
surprising news to us!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我希望你能順利找到那座島嶼，
並給我們帶回令人驚訝的訊息！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Let it be so!
First, I should check
the state of the ship...
You have some work to do,
if you want to help me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
那就這麼定了！
首先，我應該檢查一下船的狀態...
如果你想幫我，
你還有些工作要做。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
She has not floated
for a long time,
so we should check
and repair the parts
that power her up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
它已經很久沒有浮起來了，
所以我們應該檢查並修復
那些驅動它的部件。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Preparing the tools for repairs, in
this place, takes several days...
if you can possibly prepare them.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
在這裡準備維修工具
需要幾天時間...
如果你能準備的話。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The materials needed are:
^0000FFStrange Steel Piece 10, Rusty Screw 10, Flexible Tube 5, Jubilee 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
需要的材料是：
^0000FF魔幻拉鏈 10, 生鏽的螺絲 10, 軟管 5, Jubilee 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you've prepared all the
materials, bring them to me. I'll
repair the ship.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
當你準備好所有材料後，
把它們帶給我。我會修復這艘船。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You want to borrow
my ship so spontaneously??
I don't even know you!!
You are more rude than you look.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你竟然這麼隨意地
想借我的船？
我甚至都不認識你！！
你比看起來還要無禮。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I don't know, how you know
that I have a ship...
Anyway, I can't lend my ship
willingly to strangers.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我不知道你是怎麼知道
我有船的...
總之，我不能
心甘情願地把船借給陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Did you bring all the materials?
If we have all the materials,
we can prepare for departure!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你帶齊所有材料了嗎？
如果材料都齊了，
我們就可以準備出發了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh! You got the all materials.
It's enough.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦！你帶齊了所有材料。
足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Okay, we are at the ready.
When would you like to depart?
I'll say one thing...
It's difficult to keep this
ship afloat after the sun has set.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
好的，我們準備好了。
你想什麼時候出發？
我說一句...
太陽落山後，
很難讓這艘船保持漂浮。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
In these neighboring waters,
there are many raging waves.
After the sun sets, the tide does
not get any easier... even for an
expert seaman.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
在這些附近的海域，
有很多洶湧的波浪。
太陽落山後，潮汐
並不會變溫和...即使是
經驗豐富的水手也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Remember, the poor condition of
this ship also factors when
attempting to plow through the
raging waves.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
記住，這艘船糟糕的狀況
也是試圖穿越
洶湧波浪時的一個因素。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you are ready to depart, tell
me, and we can check the tides.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果你準備好出發了，告訴我，
我們可以檢視潮汐。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
These materials are insufficient.
Perhaps you forgot some of them?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
這些材料不夠。
也許你忘了其中一些？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The materials needed are:
^0000FFStrange Steel Piece 10, Rusty Screw 10, Flexible Tube 5, Jubilee 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
需要的材料是：
^0000FF魔幻拉鏈 10, 生鏽的螺絲 10, 軟管 5, Jubilee 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. Are you ready to depart?
Good, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦。你準備好出發了嗎？
很好，讓我們看看...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。時間還不錯。
趁潮汐低的時候
我們應該快點。
船已經在附近的碼頭
準備好了，我們可以
立刻出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That last sailing was tough...
But, all adventures
are like that...
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
上次航行很艱難...
但是，所有的冒險
都是這樣的...
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you keep a mind to
depart again... tell me
and we can check the tides.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果你打算
再次出發...告訴我，
我們可以檢視潮汐。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Will you depart?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你要出發了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我們走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you are ready to depart, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
當你準備好出發時，告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。時間還不錯。
趁潮汐低的時候
我們應該快點。
船已經在附近的碼頭
準備好了，我們可以
立刻出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey you... You are alive!
When you were swept away by the
waves, I thought that was the last
I would ever see of you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿...你還活著！
當你被海浪捲走時，
我以為那是
我最後一次見到你了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Anyway, where were you all this time?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
總之，你這段時間都在哪裡？

scripts.text: Explain the whole story.
scripts.translation: 解釋整個故事

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh... that's really marvelous.
Well I never...
The island truly exists...?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦...那真是太神奇了。
哎呀...
那個島真的存在...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's more...
The island is not an island?!?
It's a gigantic whale???
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
更令人驚訝的是...
那個島根本不是島？！？
它是一頭巨大的鯨魚？？？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And trees grow... and water
streams... along the whale's
back!!?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
而且鯨魚的背上
還長著樹木...
流淌著溪流...！！？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That's unbelievable!
The most marvelous incident I have
ever heard in my lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
這簡直難以置信！
是我有生以來
聽過的最不可思議的事情！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Also, I am surprised at the
presence of an aged person on Whale
Island!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
另外，我也很驚訝
鯨魚島上竟然有一位長者！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
He must be a man strong in
spirit... with experience and high
discipline.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
他一定是一位
精神強大、經驗豐富
且自律極高的人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The story of the island has
advanced enough until this part.
Why don't you announce your
findings to our dearest Csar
and receive aid to find Whale
Island?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
關於這座島的故事
到這裡已經足夠完整了。
何不向我們要好的凱撒大人
彙報您的發現，
並請求援助以尋找鯨魚島呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Our dear Csar likes it very
much to hear stories about
valuable things, so if he
listens to your story, he may give
you a prize...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我們要好的凱撒大人
非常喜歡聽關於珍貴事物的故事，
所以如果您講述這個故事，
他可能會給您獎勵...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And if you have any plans to go
back to the island, I want to go
together with you! Eh? Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果您有再次前往該島的計劃，
我想和您一起去！啊？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If our dear Csar listens to this
kind of story, he would find it a
pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果我們要好的凱撒大人
聽到這樣的故事，
他會感到很高興的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
He might even give you a prize...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
他甚至可能會給您獎勵...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. Our dear Csar requested
evidence of the whale island?...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。我們要好的凱撒大人
要求提供鯨魚島存在的證據？...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That may prove a little
difficult...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
這可能會有一點困難...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do you have a guarantee that you
can find Whale Island again?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
您有把握能再次找到鯨魚島嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I think you won't give up.
How about if we depart
once more, and I will gladly help
you find Whale Island!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我想您不會放棄的。
不如我們再出發一次，
我很樂意幫助您尋找鯨魚島！

scripts.text: Try again to find Whale Island.
scripts.translation: 再次嘗試尋找鯨魚島

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That does it! I expected it.
I knew you weren't the type to give up an adventure!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
就是這樣！我早就料到了。
我就知道您不是那種會放棄冒險的人！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Again, let's get the ship ready and sail before the sun sets!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
再次出發吧，讓我們準備好船，在日落前起航！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see...
Even though you like adventure,
it might be impossible to find
Whale Island again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我明白了...
雖然您喜歡冒險，
但可能無法再次找到鯨魚島...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you change your mind,
anytime, come tell me.
Frankly, I would love to see you
prove the existence of Whale Island
to our dear Csar.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果您改變主意，
隨時來告訴我。
說實話，我很想看到您
向我們要好的凱撒大人證明鯨魚島的存在。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh! Are you ready to depart?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦！您準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我們走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you are ready to depart, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
當你準備好出發時，告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。時間還不錯。
趁潮汐低的時候
我們應該快點。
船已經在附近的碼頭
準備好了，我們可以
立刻出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What a surprise!!
Where have you been??
I was worried that you had
disappeared forever!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
真是嚇死我了！！
你跑哪裡去了？？
我還以為你徹底消失了呢！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I don't care... Wherever you have
been, it's very good to see you
again.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我才不在乎...不管你去哪裡了，
能再次見到你真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I can guess you'd like to go to
Whale Island once again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我猜你大概又想再去一次鯨魚島吧...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。時間還不錯。
趁潮汐低的時候
我們應該快點。
船已經在附近的碼頭
準備好了，我們可以
立刻出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. You came back!
So, how did you do?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦。你回來了！
那麼，結果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You say...
If you bring the materials, the old
man makes the instrument...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你是說...
如果你帶材料過去，那位老人就會製作樂器...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And he promised that he won't move
the island until you go back
again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
而且他承諾，在你再次回來之前，
他不會移動島嶼...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see. I remember the exact
directions. Let's leave
immediately, as soon as you are
ready.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
明白了。我記得確切的方向。
等你準備好了，我們立刻出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. Did you get all the
materials you needed?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦。你拿到所有需要的材料了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If so, do you want to go now?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果是的話，你想現在出發嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好。

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我們走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see. I will wait.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
明白了。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ok, let's go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
好，我們走！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Finally, everything has ended
successfully. With this, I add 1
more page to my... no, OUR adventure story!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
終於，一切圓滿結束。至此，我在...不，我們的冒險故事中又添了一頁！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Someday, I want to have another
chance to have another fantastic
adventure with a person like you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
總有一天，我希望還能有機會和你這樣的人物一起經歷一次精彩的冒險！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I heard that you played a great
performance, with the instrument
from Whale Island, at the Imperial
Palace. Eh? You must have quite the talent!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我聽說你在皇宮裡用鯨魚島的樂器演奏了一場精彩的演出。咦？你一定很有天賦吧！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Finally, everything has ended
successfully. With this, I add 1
more page to my... no, OUR adventure story!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
終於，一切圓滿結束。至此，我在...不，我們的冒險故事中又添了一頁！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Someday, I want to have another
chance to have another fantastic
adventure with a person like you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
總有一天，我希望還能有機會和你這樣的人物一起經歷一次精彩的冒險！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's going on?
You should ride a ship now? Let's ready to leave hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
怎麼回事？
你現在應該上船了？我們快點準備出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's going on?
You should ride a ship now? Let's ready to leave hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
怎麼回事？
你現在應該上船了？我們快點準備出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Gee. The tide is too high.
It's too dangerous to depart
right now because of the waves
getting too rugged.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哎呀。潮水漲得太高了。
現在海浪太洶湧，出發太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When the sea calmes down a bit,
you can come back. We can't depart
right now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
等海況稍微平靜一點，你再回來吧。我們現在無法出發。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What a time for sailing!
The wind of the sea is so cool.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
真是揚帆的好時候！
海風涼爽宜人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't have to accompany me
through this dangerous sailing...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不必陪我經歷這次危險的航行...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Such as I am, I know the
sea a lot better than you!
And this ship has been my
friend through all my life!
I wouldn't abandon a friend.
Would you? ~
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
像我這樣的人，比你知道的海況多多了！
而且這艘船是我一生的摯友！
我不會拋棄朋友的。
你會嗎？~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I will order you where to go, by
watching the seas.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我會通過觀察海況，指揮你該往哪裡走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You just adjust the direction of
the rudder by following my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你只需要聽從我的指令，調整舵的方向。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
At first, hold the rudder to go
forward, to the east.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
首先，把舵打向正前方，朝東航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Keep the direction by holding the
rudder to move forward to the
East.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
保持方向，把舵打向正前方，繼續向東航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. The sea currents have changed.
Adjust the rudder forward to the
North, to follow the currents.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。洋流變了。
把舵打向正前方，朝北航行，順著洋流走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Nothing yet... Nothing has changed
in the flow of water. There is
nothing to note...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
還沒有... 水流沒有變化。
沒有什麼值得注意的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We had better keep sailing on this
heading for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我們最好暫時保持這個航向繼續航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We must first repulse the
monsters!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我們必須先擊退魔物！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey!
Did you not hear me?
Change the rudder forward to the
North, and follow the currents!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿！
你沒聽到嗎？
把舵打向正前方，朝北航行，順著洋流走！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look... Beyond the sea!
Do you see something moving
mysteriously?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
看... 海的那一邊！
你看到有什麼東西在神秘地移動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Heheh... What is...
that... Hey! You...
Go around the deck to look more
carefully! Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿嘿... 那是...
什麼... 嘿！你...
去甲板周圍仔細看看！快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What are you doing...? Go around
the deck to look more carefully!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你在幹什麼...？去甲板周圍仔細看看！
快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
This time, I hope to find that
whale island again without any
incidents...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
這次，希望能再次找到那個鯨魚島，而且不出任何意外...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The method is the same as before.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
方法和之前一樣。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I will order you where to go, by
watching the seas.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我會通過觀察海況，指揮你該往哪裡走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You just adjust the direction of
the rudder by following my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你只需要聽從我的指令，調整舵的方向。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
At first, hold the rudder to go
forward, to the east.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
首先，把舵打向正前方，朝東航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Keep the direction by holding the
rudder to move forward to the
East.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
保持方向，把舵打向正前方，繼續向東航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look there!
There is a moving island!
We have done well!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
看那裡！
有一座移動的島嶼！
我們成功了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh...my...
It really is there...
A whale! It's unbelievable!
It is as true as that...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦...我的...
它真的在那裡...
是鯨魚！難以置信！
就像... 那是真的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I feel I can go anywhere with you!
Even through impossible things!
Haha! You are a friend who brings
good luck.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我覺得只要有你在，我就能去任何地方！
即使是不可思議的事情！
哈哈！你是帶來好運的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Okay, now that you have landed on
the island, I have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
好了，既然你已經登上了島嶼，我就得回去了...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If another wave crashes against
this boat, I feel she might break
into pieces!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
如果再有海浪拍打這艘船，我覺得它可能會散架！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Good luck. I hope you
can return without problems.
I will pray for you.
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
祝你好運。希望你能平安歸來。
我會為你祈禱的。
下次見。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What? How did you get on
this ship?? You... No.
I'll forgive you this once, but go
back now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
什麼？你是怎麼上這艘船的？
你...不。
這次就原諒你了，但現在立刻回去。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. The sea currents have changed.
Adjust the rudder forward to the
{0}, to follow the currents.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嗯。海流改變了。
請將船頭轉向{0}，順著海流前進。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Nothing yet... Nothing has changed
in the flow of water. There is
nothing to note...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
還沒有... 水流沒有變化。
沒有什麼值得注意的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We had better keep sailing on this heading for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我們最好暫時保持這個航向繼續航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey!
Did you not hear me?
Change the rudder forward to the
{0}, and follow the currents!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿！
你沒聽到嗎？
將船頭轉向{0}，順著海流前進！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You don't have to adjust the rudder for now.
Wait for my direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
現在不需要調整船舵。
等待我的指令。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do not yet adjust the rudder.
Only when I order you to,
you adjust the rudder.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
現在不要調整船舵。
只有在我下令時，你才調整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We should make sure to kill any
monsters onboard.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我們必須確保消滅船上所有的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do not yet adjust the rudder.
Only when I order you to,
you adjust the rudder.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
現在不要調整船舵。
只有在我下令時，你才調整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look... Beyond the sea!
Do you see something moving
mysteriously?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
看... 海的那一邊！
你看到有什麼東西在神秘地移動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Heheh... What is...
that... Hey! You...
Go around the deck to look more
carefully! Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿嘿... 那是...
什麼... 嘿！你...
去甲板周圍仔細看看！快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You can adjust the rudder,
under my direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
你可以調整船舵了，
按照我的指令。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey! Listen to what I am saying.
How come you go there without my
permission...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿！聽我說。
為什麼沒有經過我的允許就那樣做...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What? How did you get on
this ship?? You... No.
I'll forgive you this once, but go
back now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
什麼？你是怎麼上這艘船的？
你...不。
這次就原諒你了，但現在立刻回去。

scripts.text: Which way?
scripts.translation: 哪個方向？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Good. Firstly, we should
keep heading {0} this way.
When I give the order,
please adjust the rudder again.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
很好。首先，
我們要保持向{0}的方向前進。
當我下達指令時，
請再次調整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Wait! Something has appeared in front of us...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
等等！前方出現了什麼東西...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Monsters!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
魔物！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
These monsters are like none I have
ever encountered! Be careful! We
must repulse these monsters!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
這些魔物是我從未見過的！小心！
我們必須擊退這些魔物！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I said that we should go {0}!
You should sail in the right
direction! To the {1}!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
我說過我們要向{0}前進！
你應該朝正確的方向航行！向{1}！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh no! Monsters have appeared!
Let's get ready to fight! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
糟糕！魔物出現了！
準備戰鬥！快！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You're carrying too many items.
Please come after using kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你攜帶的物品太多了。
請使用卡普拉服務後再來。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh, your awake.
How do you feel? Are you ok??
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦，你醒了。
感覺怎麼樣？沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... where..is...
Eck! What happened...?

[Aged Stranger]
Well... You were a bit
of a surprise! I haven't
talked for a long time...
with a person who lives on dry
land.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯...你讓我有點驚訝！
我已經很久沒有和生活在陸地上的
人交談了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
Who are you old man?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡？
你是誰，老人家？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This is... well...
What can I say...
This is called a moving island, by
most people.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
這裡是...嗯...
該怎麼說呢...
大多數人稱之為“移動島嶼”。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This is a small island that only I inhabit.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
這是一座只有我居住的小島。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I call it...
Whale Island.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我稱它為...
鯨魚島。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This place is very famously known
as The Moving Island! But... This
island is... Maybe...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個地方非常有名，被稱為“移動島嶼”！但是...這座島...也許...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Now do you get it? Hahaha!
Right. We are standing on
the back of a gigantic whale!
That's why I call it Whale Island!
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
現在你明白了嗎？哈哈！
沒錯。我們正站在一隻巨大鯨魚的背上！
所以我才叫它鯨魚島！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How...? How is it possible
that the water flows in streams
here? And trees grow! On the
whale's back!?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎麼...？怎麼可能
水在這裡像溪流一樣流動？
還有樹木生長！在鯨魚的背上！？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Heheheh. This is an island
of legend. Right now you are
experiencing greatness! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
呵呵呵。這是一座傳說中的島嶼。
你現在正體驗著偉大！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you a real person?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是真人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Heheh, as you can see,
I am just an aged man.
I've simply spent my lifetime here
leisurely, by breaking off
relations with any unworldly life.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
呵呵，正如你所見，
我只是一個年邁的男子。
我只是在這裡悠閒地度過一生，
斷絕了與世俗生活的一切聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, now you get yourself
together. I will send you back to
dry land. If you don't go back
soon, some people may worry.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
好了，現在你整理一下自己。
我會把你送回陸地。如果你不快點回去，
有些人可能會擔心的。

scripts.text:
-The island starts to move slowly
when the old man plays an
unfamiliar instrument...-
scripts.translation:
-當老人彈奏起一種陌生的樂器時，
島嶼開始緩慢移動...-

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
In a few minutes, you will go back
to the land from whence you came.
You can relax.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
再過幾分鐘，你就會回到你來的地方。
你可以放鬆一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... Almost there...
Young man, you will arrive back on
the mainland in a few minutes. Go carefully.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯...快到了...
年輕男子，再過幾分鐘你就會回到大陸了。小心點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Old man, if I want to come back
here again, how can I do it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老人家，如果我想再來這裡，
該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hehe... Do you want to come here
again? Here? Where I live alone? In
this small island? You are
funny...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
呵呵...你想再來這裡嗎？
這裡？我獨自居住的地方？
這座小島上？你真有趣...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If we are preordained to meet,
we will meet here again,
won't we? Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果我們有緣相遇，
我們就會在這裡再次相見，
不是嗎？呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's time to... well,
go back safely. Someday, if you
want to come again to meet me, you
can endure the same seas as last
time. I won't stop you. Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
是時候...嗯，
安全回去了。如果有一天你想再來見我，
你可以像上次一樣經歷同樣的風浪。
我不會阻止你。呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hahaha... I didn't know that I
would meet you again! How did you
return?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哈哈哈...我不知道我會再次見到你！
你是怎麼回來的？

scripts.text: Explain the whole story.
scripts.translation: 解釋整個故事

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... just like that?
Whoever hasn't come here directly
would expect you to return like
that. Well.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯...就這樣？
沒有直接來過這裡的人
會以為你是這樣回來的。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I just wanted to spend the rest of
my life here, leisurely... I'm
interested in the world... but I'm
no match for it...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我只是想在這裡安度餘生，悠閒地生活...我對世界很好奇...但我無法與之抗衡...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do not look sorry for me.
When you went back I didn't ask you
not to say anything about this
island to others.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
不要可憐我。
當你回去時，我並沒有要求你
不要向其他人提起這座島。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If I had decided to hide where
nobody can find... Well, you
needn't worry too much about that
now.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果我決定藏在一個沒人找得到的地方...嗯，
你現在也不必太擔心這個。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Anyway, are you troubled?
What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
總之，你有心事嗎？
你打算怎麼做？

scripts.text: Think more.
scripts.translation: 再想想

scripts.text: Don't you have a way?
scripts.translation: 難道沒有辦法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do that. Think carefully, the
answer is to be found...
Hoohoohoo!
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
那就去做吧。仔細想想，
答案就在...那裡。
呼呼呼呼！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
To bring the Csar here and show him
everything?!? It's difficult...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
把皇帝帶到這裡，讓他看到一切？！？這很難...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
An evidence of whale island...
That's all you need if only it
existed in this island...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
鯨魚島的證據...
只要它存在於這座島上，
這就足夠了...

scripts.text:
-The aged man closes his eyes and
starts to play his instrument, as
he falls in thought.-
scripts.translation:
-年邁的男子閉上眼睛，
開始演奏他的樂器，
陷入了沉思。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Old man, could you make one of
those instruments for me? That is a
marvelous thing that I've seen only
here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老人，你能給我做一件那樣的樂器嗎？
那是我在別處從未見過的奇妙之物。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh... That's a good idea.
There isn't an instrument like this
in all Moscovia! Absolutely...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦...這是個好主意。
整個莫斯科比亞都沒有這樣的樂器！絕對...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... If you grant my request, I
will make this instrument for you.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯...如果你答應我的請求，
我就為你製作這件樂器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is your request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的請求是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Just in time. I have always used
this instrument which is already
over 50 years old. The body is so
worn. It's not surprising that it's
falling apart...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
正好。我一直使用這把已經50多年的樂器。
琴身磨損得很厲害。它快要散架了也不奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It is made with strings that only
exist in this place, but you can
get the other materials for it in
the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
它使用的是隻有這裡才有的琴絃，
但其他材料你可以在大陸上找到。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you bring the materials, I can
make a new one.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果你帶來材料，
我就可以做一把新的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
The materials are ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
材料是 ^0000FF原木 30, 強韌木藤條 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獺的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I won't move the island, so you can
find it when you come back with the
materials.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我不會移動這座島，所以當你帶著材料回來時，
你能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Tell me whenever you're ready, and
I'll send you back to the
mainland.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
當你準備好了告訴我，
我會送你回大陸。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, are you ready to go back to the mainland?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
好的，你準備好回大陸了嗎？

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什麼材料？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你應該帶上這些材料：

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你應該帶上這些材料：
^0000FF原木 30, 強韌木藤條 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獺的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
明白了。如果是這樣，我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh... Did you get all the
materials?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦... 你集齊所有材料了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You found the right materials.
Okay, I will start to make the
instrument.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你找到了正確的材料。
好的，我開始製作樂器了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Wait for a moment until I make the
instrument successfully.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
請等一下，直到我成功製作出樂器。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Ugh... We need more materials...
We need ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
唉... 我們需要更多材料...
我們需要 ^0000FF原木 30, 強韌木藤條 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獺的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
What will you do? Will you go back
to the mainland to find the
materials?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你打算怎麼做？要回大陸尋找材料嗎？

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什麼材料？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你應該帶上這些材料：

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你應該帶上這些材料：
^0000FF原木 30, 強韌木藤條 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獺的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
明白了。如果是這樣，我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's not completed yet. Please wait a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
還沒有完成。請再稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I have succeeded in making the
instrument! Here you are. It's yours.
This instrument is called a Gusli.
This is a traditional instrument
which comes from a faraway land of
the ancestors of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我成功製作出樂器了！給你，這是你的。
這件樂器叫做古斯里琴。
這是一種來自莫斯科比亞祖先遙遠故土的傳統樂器。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I am the last person who has
learned it in this land.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我是這片土地上最後一個學會它的人。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
So, indeed... This is a very
special item here, that only we
have.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
所以，確實... 這是一件非常特別的物品，只有我們擁有。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you show this to the good Csar,
he can believe your story about the
island. Everything is going to be
well.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果你把它展示給善良的沙皇看，
他就會相信關於這座島的故事。一切都會好起來的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Are you ready to learn the Gusli?
Please equip the Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你準備好學習古斯里琴了嗎？
請裝備古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... Very well.
At first, look at me how I play,
then you play it slowly.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯... 很好。
首先，看我怎麼彈奏，
然後你慢慢彈奏。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do not hurry,
keep your composure,
just look carefully,
and follow me slowly.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
不要著急，
保持鎮定，
仔細觀看，
跟著我慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh! Ooh... Your hands are really good. You are surely talented with a music instrument.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦！噢... 你的手真靈巧。你肯定很有音樂天賦。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I heard that there are some adventurers in the mainland... that like playing instruments and singing songs! You must be one of them...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
我聽說大陸上有一些冒險者... 喜歡演奏樂器和唱歌！你一定是其中之一...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This may go faster than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
這可能比我預期的要快。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]

scripts.translation:

好了，輪到你了。彈吧，彈我剛才彈的那首曲子。

with your ability, you can

[Aged Stranger]
This is the Whale Island.
I don't know how you came here.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
這裡是鯨魚島。
我不知道你是怎麼來到這裡的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you want, I can send you back
to the mainland. What'll it be?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果你願意，我可以送你回大陸。你想怎麼做？

scripts.text: Look around.
scripts.translation: 四處看看

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland.
scripts.translation: 回到大陸

scripts.text: Venture into the unknown.
scripts.translation: 探索未知之地

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Well, well... Do as you please.
If so, I will take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
好吧，好吧... 隨你便。
既然這樣，我就休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
明白了。如果是這樣，我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh, if you want, I can
guide you to a good place for you.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦，如果你願意，我可以指引你去一個適合你的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
There are some lands...
untouched and mysterious...
around Moscovia...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
在莫斯科比亞周圍，
有一些土地...
未被觸碰且充滿神秘...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you want, I'll send you there. What do you think of that?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果你願意，我就送你過去。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Consider it.
scripts.translation: 考慮一下

scripts.text: Ok, please send me there.
scripts.translation: 好的，請送我過去

Please stay and take a rest.
scripts.translation:

你大概很喜歡這座島吧？
請留下來休息一下。

scripts.text:
A old man started to play a instrument
closing his eyes.
And then he didn't any answer so, looks like
falling down to only his world.
scripts.translation:
一位老人閉著眼睛開始彈奏樂器。
隨後他不再回應，彷彿沉入了自己的世界。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh! You are good at playing the
Gusli! In such a short time... you
are great!
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
哦！你彈古斯里琴彈得真好！
在這麼短的時間內...你太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You've done well. I don't need to
teach you anymore. Your ability
will be improved with more practice.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你做得很好。我不需要再教你了。
多加練習，你的技藝會越來越好。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Now go back to the mainland and
play the Gusli for our dear Csar.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
現在回到大陸，為我們敬愛的沙皇彈奏古斯里琴吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
With your ability to play, surely
you can win the admiration of all.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
以你的演奏水平，一定能贏得所有人的讚賞。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Um, a little bit greenhorn...
Do not play that way.
Take more time to concentrate while
you play.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
嗯，還有點生疏...
不要那樣彈。
彈奏時要更專心，多花點時間集中精神。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Practice more on your own.
I will check on you again.
If you practice, you will be good
at it in no time.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
自己多練習吧。
我會再檢查你的。
只要勤加練習，你很快就會彈好的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
So, what will you do now?
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
那麼，你現在打算做什麼？

scripts.text: How would I get back here?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼回到這裡？

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland.
scripts.translation: 回到大陸

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You are my friend now,
and you have this instrument.
Whenever you want to come back
here again, just play the Gusli
at the docks of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你現在是我的朋友，
而且你擁有這把樂器。
無論何時你想再回來，
只要在莫斯科比亞的碼頭彈奏古斯里琴即可。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Even if it's difficult to play it
well, because you may not yet know
how to play it, it's not a problem.
Just make a sound.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
即使很難彈好，因為你可能還不會彈，也沒關係。
只要能發出聲音就行。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This island... this whale... can
perceive the sound of a Gusli from
an endless distance away.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
這座島...這頭鯨魚...
能感知到從極遠處傳來的古斯里琴聲。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you play this instrument,
wherever you are, I'll go to you
with this island. Only if you are a
friend... heheh.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
只要你彈奏這把樂器，
無論你在哪裡，我都會帶著這座島去找你。只有你是朋友的話...嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You really want to...
learn this instrument...
don't you?
Well... it's hard to learn
in such a short time...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
你真的想...
學習這把樂器...
對吧？
嗯...在短時間內學會很難...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's okay if you can't play this
instrument. I already made it for you.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
如果你彈不好這把樂器也沒關係。我已經為你做好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
But I can teach you how
to play it anyway.
I can't be too sure, though
because I have never taught others.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
但我還是教你怎麼彈吧。
不過我不太確定，因為我從未教過別人。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay. If you are ready to play the
Gusli, let me know.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
好的。當你準備好彈奏古斯里琴時，告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. Okay, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的陌生人]
明白了。好的，我們開始吧。

scripts.text:

Whenever you want to come back here
again, play the Gusli at the docks
of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:

彷彿陷入了一個只屬於他自己的世界。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You're carrying too many items.
Please come after using kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務後再來。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You!!!
So many people saw you
meet with Baba Yaga!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你！！！
有那麼多人都看到你
和芭芭雅嘎見面了！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
The guilt which must be felt, when
meeting secretly with a witch...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
秘密會見女巫...
這種罪行所應感受到的愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For that, we indict capital
punishment without any just trial!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
為此，我們將不經公正審判
直接判處死刑！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you are a stranger to these
lands... So I will hold you in special trial.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但你是這些土地上的陌生人...
所以我會為你舉行特別審判。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you have anything to say...
spare me no detail.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果你有什麼要說的...
請不要隱瞞任何細節。

scripts.text: Explain the circumstances.
scripts.translation: 解釋情況

scripts.text:
-Talk about what happened with Baba
Yaga, and move forward with the plan.-
scripts.translation: -講述與芭芭雅嘎發生的事，並繼續推進計劃。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm-hm, that's an embarrassing story...
But if you are telling the
truth, my people will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯嗯，這是個令人尷尬的故事...
但如果你說的是真話，
我的子民會感到欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Okay, Bring to me
any evidence, to believe
what you are saying.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
好的，給我帶來任何證據，
以證明你所說的是真的。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You killed the Baba Yaga!!
If this is true, bring
me Yaga's Pestles.
If you do, I will make
sure no one ever doubts you.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你殺了芭芭雅嘎！！
如果這是真的，
就給我帶來亞卡祖母的杵棒。
如果你做到了，我會確保
沒有人再懷疑你。

scripts.text: Show the Yaga's Pestles.
scripts.translation: 出示亞卡祖母的杵棒

scripts.text: Do nothing.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不做

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Here you are.
-Offered the Yaga's Pestles.-
scripts.translation: -獻上了亞卡祖母的杵棒。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm.. You do have them.
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯.. 你確實有它們。
暫時，我承認你
是在往返獵殺芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但不要做出可疑的行為，
以免引起我的子民
採取奇怪的行動！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果你那樣做，我會立即逮捕你！
所以請小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
And, when you succeed in
banishing winter with magic,
announce that to me immediately.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
還有，當你成功
用魔法驅散冬天時，
立即向我報告。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我說過要你給我帶來
40根芭芭雅嘎的亞卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Did you bring some evidence to
resolve your issue of doubt, traveler?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
旅行者，你帶來了什麼證據，
以消除你的疑慮嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: I am confused.
scripts.translation: 我很困惑

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Good,
I won't doubt you anymore.
Because you've proven yourself,
you can remain a free traveler.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
很好，
我不再懷疑你了。
既然你證明了自己，
你可以繼續作為自由的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Surely, I hate cooperating with Baba Yaga.
But if my people are happy
after the work you do,
I am also pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
當然，我討厭與芭芭雅嘎合作。
但如果我的工作完成後，
我的子民感到幸福，
我也很高興。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
暫時，我承認你
是在往返獵殺芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:

behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:

以免引起我的子民
採取奇怪的行動！

scripts.text:
