So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果你那樣做，我會立即逮捕你！
所以請小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Your items do not match the
count of 40 Yaga's Pestles.
Did you forget the amount,
or did you wish to lie to me...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你的物品數量
與40根亞卡祖母的杵棒不符。
你是忘記了數量，
還是想對我撒謊...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I will treat that as a joke!
A kind of sarcasm!
You go away now and bring some
evidence to certify your innocence.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我會把這當作一個玩笑！
一種諷刺！
現在離開，
帶來一些證據來證明你的清白。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我說過要你給我帶來
40根芭芭雅嘎的亞卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Are you here to tease me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你是來這裡取笑我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
It'd be great if I stayed put, for
the good of both me and my people.
I don't want to see the Baba Yaga
personally.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果我能保持不動，
對我自己和我的子民都有好處。
我不想親自見到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
So, I want you to 
take my place for that.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
所以，我希望你
代替我去做這件事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Please help Baba Yaga
to seize the summer.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
請幫助芭芭雅嘎
奪取夏天。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Are you here for...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你是為了...而來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I already heard about the
weather from the minister.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我已經從大臣那裡
聽說了天氣的情況。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Actually, I was a little
dissatisfied with the doing
of witchcraft at the center
of the square...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
實際上，我對在廣場中心
進行巫術的行為
有點不滿意...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But... I can admit it was good work.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但是...我可以承認
這是一項好的工作。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Everyone hates the cold winter.
Now, the winter will not
come anymore! So, I'm very pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
每個人都討厭寒冷的冬天。
現在，冬天不會再來了！
所以，我非常高興。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Right.
I want to give you something
in the name of the people.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
是的。
我想以人民的名義
給你一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Here, take it.
I give it as an atonement
to make my people happy.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
拿著吧。
我把它作為贖罪，
讓我的子民感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Stay here as long as you want, and
enjoy yourself to the fullest this summer.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
想待多久就待多久，
在這個夏天盡情盡興吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Welcome to Moscovia!
I am the ruler, Csar Aleksay III, of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
歡迎來到莫斯科比亞！
我是莫斯科比亞的統治者，沙皇 亞歷克賽三世。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Go back to your hometown and talk about the beauty of Moscovia! Talk about my great government to all the people of the lands!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
回到你的家鄉，向人們講述莫斯科比亞的美麗吧！
向所有土地上的人民宣揚我偉大的統治！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
A foreign traveler...?
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
外來的旅行者...？
你有什麼事要告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If it is not important,
have an audience with the Prime Minister first.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果不重要，
請先去見首相。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh, are you the traveler who told me about an interesting adventure story...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦，你是那位給我講過有趣冒險故事的旅行者...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Not only are you not from Moscovia, but also... you have found the moving island, which only existed in legends! I want to hear details...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你不僅不是莫斯科比亞人，而且...你竟然找到了只存在於傳說中的移動島嶼！我想聽聽詳細的情況...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Let's hear it...
Tell me quickly.
I'm anxious to know the truth about the island...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
讓我聽聽...
快說吧。
我迫切想知道關於那座島嶼的真相...

scripts.text: Tell the story all the while.
scripts.translation: 講述整個故事

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Surely, an interesting story... But it sounds so unbelievable! What do you think, Prime Minister?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
確實是個有趣的故事...但這聽起來太不可思議了！首相，你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
It doesn't sound like a lie,
but it's difficult to believe
completely. I mean, I've known
a whale to be huge, but...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
這聽起來不像是在撒謊，
但也很難完全相信。我是說，我知道鯨魚很大，但是...

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
a person living there...
water streaming...
and a tree growing on it...!!!
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
有人住在那裡...
水流潺潺...
還有樹長在上面...！！！
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I agree. I have heard many kinds of mysterious adventure stories, but this sounds like an absurd story!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我同意。我聽過許多種神秘的冒險故事，但這個聽起來像個荒謬的故事！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Not to mention that it's happened near my nation. Unbelievable!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
更別提它發生在我國家附近了。難以置信！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
But Csar... In my memory,
I heard that exactly, the
last time a story was told
about the mysterious moving island. But there was a musical instrument...which an old man played.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
但是沙皇...在我的記憶中，
我記得上一次聽到關於神秘移動島嶼的故事時，
有一位老人正在演奏樂器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Really? Tell me the details.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
真的嗎？告訴我詳細情況。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Surely, I have heard the same
story, as told in the legends
of our ancestors; about an old man who lived there.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
確實，我聽過同樣的故事，
就像祖先傳說中那樣；
關於一位住在那裡的老人。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. There are many doubtful points. Ordinarily, I would give you a big prize, but in this case, it is difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯。有很多疑點。通常我會給你豐厚的獎賞，但在這種情況下，很難相信。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Bring me something to prove
the existence of the whale.
If you do, I will give you a big prize.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
帶些東西來證明鯨魚的存在。
如果你做到了，我會給你豐厚的獎賞。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But if you don't,
I will punish you for your lies! Bring this instrument that supposedly an old man has.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但如果你做不到，
我會懲罰你的謊言！把那位老人據稱擁有的樂器帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Csar... This is a foreigner...
No disrespect was meant to you.
Perhaps a little more generosity is in order?.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
沙皇...這位是外國人...
他並沒有對您不敬。
或許可以稍微寬容一些？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
No way! If the story is not true, many other foreign travelers who pass by this land will disrespect me like this... What would you have me do?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
絕對不行！如果故事不是真的，那麼許多經過這片土地的外國旅行者都會像這樣對我無禮...你想讓我怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
......
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
......

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You got it, traveler?
You have a heavy responsibility.
Bring evidence of this whale island to me, to provide me with some relief. Now go.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你明白了嗎，旅行者？
你肩負著沉重的責任。
帶些鯨魚島的證據來給我，讓我安心。現在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I'm tired... I want to take a rest, so... leave.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我累了...我想休息一下，所以...退下吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Just think about finding the whale island...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
好好想想怎麼找到鯨魚島吧...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. You've come back...
Hm. Did you find something to bring
to me from the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦。你回來了...
嗯。你找到什麼可以帶給我
來自鯨魚島的東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Did you bring the instrument?
A Gooselri? Which only exists
in the whale island? Let's see.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你帶了樂器來嗎？
古斯里琴？那種只存在於
鯨魚島的樂器？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦...這件樂器...是古斯里琴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Actually, Csar, I believe it is
called a Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
其實，沙皇，我認為它
應該叫古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. Prime Minister, is this the
correct instrument from the
legends, then?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦。首相，這是傳說中
正確的那件樂器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't be sure, but this is
definitely an instrument never seen
in our lands before.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不能確定，但這絕對是
我們這片土地上從未見過的樂器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. This is also my first time
seeing this kind of musical
instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯。這也是我第一次
見到這種樂器。真神秘...嘿！
你會彈嗎？

scripts.text: I can play.
scripts.translation: 我會彈。

scripts.text: I can't play it.
scripts.translation: 我不會彈。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You can play it!
Good, play it right away!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你會彈！
很好，馬上彈給我聽！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... What is this? Do you mock me?
You are so impudent... You...!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯...這是什麼？你在嘲笑我嗎？
你太放肆了...你...！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Csar... Calm down, please.
If you are quick to anger by such a
lowly person, it will become a
problem of prestige for you.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
沙皇...請冷靜。
如果您因為這種卑微的人
而輕易發怒，那將成為
您的威信問題。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Agh... I agree with you.
You. Give a proper prize to the
adventurer and send them on their way.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
啊...我同意你的看法。
你。給這位冒險者
合適的獎賞，然後送他們離開。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
How can I re...reward...?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我該怎麼...獎勵...？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I ordered you instead Prime
Minister, to make this poor player
disappear from in front of my eyes,
right now.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我命令你，首相，
讓這個可憐的玩家
立刻從我眼前消失。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You should be grateful for the
Csar's mercy... impudent
traveler...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你應該感激沙皇的仁慈...
放肆的旅行者...

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it and go out.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
雖然我認為你這段時間的努力值得肯定，但還是獎勵你一下吧。拿著，然後離開。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... That's too bad.
I see... Will I ever believe...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯...真是遺憾。
我明白了...我會永遠相信...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Thanks for your efforts.
Hey, Prime Minister,
reward this traveler.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
謝謝你的努力。
嘿，首相，
獎勵這位旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
How can I reward the traveler?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我該怎麼獎勵這位旅行者？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I leave the matter in your hands;
it's up to you. I will take a
rest.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
這件事就交給你了；
由你決定。我要去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
The Csar didn't take pleasure in
your story, as I expected.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
正如我所料，沙皇並沒有
對你的故事感到高興。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
雖然我認為你這段時間的努力值得肯定，但還是獎勵你一下吧。拿著。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
What are you doing? Can you play it
without even holding the musical instrument???
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你在做什麼？不拿著樂器
也能演奏嗎？？？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Don't be impudent with me! Do it right!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
別對我這麼放肆！給我好好彈！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh you come...hum did you find
something to satisfy me
at the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦，你來了...哼，你在
鯨魚島找到了什麼能讓我
滿意的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦...這件樂器...是古斯里琴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Actually, Csar, I believe it is called a Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
其實，陛下，這東西叫古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. Prime Minister, is this the
correct instrument from the
legends, then?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦。首相，這是傳說中
正確的那件樂器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't be sure, but this is
definitely an instrument never seen
in our lands before.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不能確定，但這絕對是
我們這片土地上從未見過的樂器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. This is also my first time
seeing this kind of musical
instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯。這也是我第一次
見到這種樂器。真神秘...嘿！
你會彈嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I learned how to play it at Whale Island.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我在鯨魚島學會了怎麼彈它。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh! Oh!... You can play it!
Play it right away. I wonder about its sound.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦！哦！...你會彈！
馬上彈給我聽。我很好奇它的聲音。

scripts.text:
-When the music of the Gusli is
played, all the people in the
Csar's Palace fall in with the tune.-
scripts.translation:
-當古斯里琴的音樂響起時，
沙皇宮裡的所有人都
隨著旋律搖擺起來。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh! I can't hear without tears.
That's a sad tune.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦！我聽得都要哭了。
這是一首悲傷的曲子。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
That's right, Csar.
I have never heard a sad tune such as this.
Kh-huk. Sniff.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
是的，陛下。
我從未聽過如此悲傷的曲子。
呼...吸。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Huk... You. Give a big prize to
this traveler!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
呼...你。給這位旅行者
一份豐厚的獎賞！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Hukhuk... Sniff. How can I reward this?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
呼...吸。我該怎麼獎勵他？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I leave this matter in your hands.
Give a proper prize to whom has
Shown me a great story and
beautiful music.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
這件事就交給你了。
給這位向我展示了精彩故事
和美妙音樂的旅行者
一份合適的獎賞。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I express thanks to you on behalf
of our dear Csar and all the people
in his palace. I will reward your
efforts, in the name of the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我謹代表我們敬愛的沙皇陛下
以及宮殿中的所有人
向您表示謝意。
我將以沙皇的名義
獎賞您的付出。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you... Where do you keep the
instrument which you are to show me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但是...你。
你要展示給我的樂器
放在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Don't you need to be holding the instrument, in order to play it???
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
難道你不該拿著樂器
才能演奏嗎？？？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry. I will be ready now, and try again to play it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。我現在準備好了，
請讓我再試一次演奏。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
What happen... If you have special things go out.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
發生了什...如果你有什麼
特別的東西要拿出來。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... You are a traveler as I saw.
If you have special things, don't interfere my rest.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯...我看你是個旅行者。
如果你有什麼特別的東西，
請不要打擾我的休息。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... You. ~
Nice to see you again.
I want for you to sometimes stop by here and play some music for me. ~
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
哦...你。
~
很高興再次見到你。
我希望你偶爾能來這裡
為我演奏一些音樂。~

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Welcome to Moscovia,
I am Csar Alexsay the Third.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
歡迎來到莫斯科比亞，
我是沙皇 亞歷克賽三世。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Go back to your hometown and tell everyone about the beauty of Moscovia,
and my great government.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
回到你的家鄉，
告訴所有人莫斯科比亞的美麗，
以及我偉大的統治。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You!!!
So many people saw you
meet with Baba Yaga!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你！！！
有那麼多人都看到你
和芭芭雅嘎見面了！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
The guilt which must be felt, when
meeting secretly with a witch...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
秘密會見女巫...
這種罪行所應感受到的愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For that, we indict capital
punishment without any just trial!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
為此，我們將不經公正審判
直接判處死刑！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you are a stranger to these
lands... So I will hold you in special trial.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但你是這些土地上的陌生人...
所以我會為你舉行特別審判。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you have anything to say...
spare me no detail.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果你有什麼要說的...
請不要隱瞞任何細節。

scripts.text: Explain the circumstances.
scripts.translation: 解釋情況

scripts.text:
-Talk about what happened with Baba
Yaga, and move forward with the plan.-
scripts.translation: -講述與芭芭雅嘎發生的事，並繼續推進計劃。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm-hm, that's an embarrassing story...
But if you are telling the
truth, my people will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯嗯，這是個令人尷尬的故事...
但如果你說的是真話，
我的子民會感到欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Okay, Bring to me
any evidence, to believe
what you are saying.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
好的，給我帶來任何證據，
以證明你所說的是真的。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You killed the Baba Yaga!!
If this is true, bring
me Yaga's Pestles.
If you do, I will make
sure no one ever doubts you.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
你殺了芭芭雅嘎！！
如果這是真的，
就給我帶來亞卡祖母的杵棒。
如果你做到了，我會確保
沒有人再懷疑你。

scripts.text: Show the Yaga's Pestles.
scripts.translation: 出示亞卡祖母的杵棒

scripts.text: Do nothing.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不做

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Here you are.
-Offered the Yaga's Pestles.-
scripts.translation: -獻上了亞卡祖母的杵棒。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm.. You do have them.
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
嗯.. 你確實有它們。
暫時，我承認你
是在往返獵殺芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
但不要做出可疑的行為，
以免引起我的子民
採取奇怪的行動！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
如果你那樣做，我會立即逮捕你！
所以請小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
And, when you succeed in
banishing winter with magic,
announce that to me immediately.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
還有，當你成功
用魔法驅散冬天時，
立即向我報告。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亞歷克賽三世]
我說過要你給我帶來
40根芭芭雅嘎的亞卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are in trouble if
you conspire against the Csar,
so, make your actions carefully,
and if you want to clean yourself
from suspicion... do everything you
can to prove your innocence.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
如果你密謀反對沙皇，
那就大禍臨頭了。
所以，請謹慎行事。
如果你想洗清嫌疑...
請盡你所能證明你的清白。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You have just cleared your name,
but... we don't trust you wholly yet.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你剛剛洗清了名聲，
但是...我們還沒有完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't trust you, but...
if you succeed in taking hold of
the summer... I might be able to.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我無法信任你，但是...
如果你能成功掌控夏季...
我或許可以。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
We know that you mean well.
But we can't fully trust you,
so we kept an eye on your movements.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我們知道你心存善意。
但我們無法完全信任你，
所以我們一直在監視你的動向。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I heard that you performed
witchcraft at the palace square...
so, I ordered scholars to
investigate the weather.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我聽說你在宮殿廣場
施展了巫術...
所以，我命令學者們
調查天氣情況。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
The results from taking observation
of the weather, are the reducing
change of temperature, and that the
highest temperature is now stabilized.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
對天氣進行觀測的結果顯示，
氣溫變化正在減少，
且最高溫度現在已趨於穩定。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I don't know what this may mean, by
way of principle, but I've decided
to admit the facts.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不知道這在原則上意味著什麼，
但我決定承認這一事實。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Already, our dear Csar knows.
I finished the report.
Go and announce it to him.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我們敬愛的沙皇已經知道了。
報告已經寫好。
去向他稟報吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are a foreign traveler. This is the Moscovia Palace, home of Csar Aleksay the Third. Extending your every courtesy here... is not bad manners.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你是一位外國旅行者。這裡是莫斯科比亞宮殿，
沙皇 亞歷克賽三世的居所。
在這裡保持禮貌...
並不是什麼壞事。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Traveler, why have you come to the Csar's Palace?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
旅行者，你為何來到沙皇宮殿？

scripts.text: Just to look around.
scripts.translation: 只是四處看看

scripts.text: To see the dear Csar.
scripts.translation: 想見見敬愛的沙皇。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
If so... look around with caution. Do not bother the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
如果是這樣...請小心四處看看。不要打擾沙皇。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Moscovia welcomes all travelers such as yourself!
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
莫斯科比亞歡迎所有像您這樣的旅行者！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Marvelously, our dear Csar likes it very much when interesting stories are often told to him.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
奇妙的是，我們敬愛的沙皇非常喜歡聽有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Did you come to see our dear Csar? If so, tell me your business with him in advance.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
您是來見我們敬愛的沙皇的嗎？如果是，請提前告訴我您的來意。

scripts.text: I'd like to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我想打個招呼。

scripts.text: I have an adventure story for him.
scripts.translation: 我有一個冒險故事要講給他聽。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I will tell him directly about your business. You don't need to worry yourself with the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我會直接向沙皇稟報您的來意。您不必擔心與沙皇的對話。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I wonder what sort of things have happened to you... The Csar will be very pleased to hear your stories.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我很好奇您身上發生了什麼...沙皇聽到您的故事一定會很高興的。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I will admit you. If our dear Csar is satisfied with your story, he will give you a big prize.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我會為您引薦。如果敬愛的沙皇對您的故事滿意，他會給您豐厚的賞賜。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I already announced you,
so go see him and speak to him directly.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我已經為您通報過了，
快去見他，直接與他對話吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Now, our dear Csar needs a rest.
You should do your duty and go find the whale island.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
現在，我們敬愛的沙皇需要休息。
您應該履行您的職責，去尋找鯨魚島。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Ah! You've come back.
I will request for you to see him immediately.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
啊！您回來了。
我會立刻為您請求覲見。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I don't want to hear your terrible 
performance anymore so, go out away.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不想再聽您那糟糕的表演了，出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
What's up? Dear Chare is taking a rest.
If you have nothing special, go out.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
怎麼了？敬愛的沙皇正在休息。
如果沒有特別的事情，請出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Your Gusli performance was so touching.
Unforgettable! Whenever you are here, please allow us to hear that tune again.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
您的古斯里琴演奏太動人了。
令人難忘！只要您在這裡，請允許我們再聽一次那首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are a foreign traveler. This is a palace
which lives Alexei the Third.
Extend you every courtesy don't not bad manner.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你是一位外國旅行者。這裡是亞歷克賽三世居住的宮殿。
請保持禮貌，不要失禮。

scripts.text:
-Watching the sea from the docks,
it suddenly dawns upon you that you
have memories from Whale Island.-
scripts.translation:
-望著碼頭上的大海，
你突然想起了鯨魚島的回憶。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stop by the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
去鯨魚島看看？

scripts.text: Go to Whale Island.
scripts.translation: 前往鯨魚島

scripts.text: Stay put.
scripts.translation: 留在原地

scripts.text:
-Slowly, your hands are on the
Gusli, and the playing starts...
reminding you of the melody which
the aged stranger had played...-
scripts.translation:
-慢慢地，你的手放在了古斯里琴上，演奏開始了...
讓你想起了那位年邁的陌生人曾彈奏過的旋律...-

scripts.text:
[Village resident]
So...something is rising from the sea!!!
scripts.translation:
[村中居民]
天哪...有什麼東西從海里升起來了！！!

scripts.text:
[Village Youth]
What...What is that...??
scripts.translation:
[村裡的年輕人]
那...那是什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ohohoh!... That's the whale
island...!!! Someday, I hope to go there! Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
哦哦哦！...那是鯨魚島...！！！總有一天，我要去那裡看看！哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my goodness... Slipped right out
of my mind... to forget equipping the Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...我竟然忘了...忘了裝備古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The aged stranger said that when I
want to go to Whale Island again, I
should play the Gusli from this place...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那位年邁的陌生人說過，當我想再去鯨魚島時，
應該在這裡彈奏古斯里琴...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can go some other time.
I will do other work now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以改天再去。
現在先做點別的事。

scripts.text: seeewaaaaaaaaaaa
scripts.translation: 嗚哇啊啊啊啊啊

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey {0}! Look!
It's dangerous! Hide! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
嘿 {0}！快看！
很危險！快躲起來！快！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That... that is...

[{0}]
Something... something is rising...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什麼東西...有什麼東西正在升起...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Watch out! {0}!
Ah... That... That is... What...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
小心！{0}！
啊...那...那是...什麼...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Now that all the monsters are gone,
we can start sailing again
normally.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴諾夫先生]
既然所有的魔物都消失了，
我們可以正常出海了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, where the heck is he?
I'll teach him a lesson.
He's timid like Dad.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
哦，那個混蛋在哪裡？
我要好好教訓他。
他膽小得像爸爸一樣。

scripts.text:
[Anna]
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
米哈伊爾，他是個膽小鬼，愛哭鬼。
米哈伊爾，他是個膽小鬼，愛哭鬼。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
It's because you didn't look after your brother. So you clean the house, Anna?
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
因為你沒有照顧好你的弟弟。所以你要打掃房子，安娜？

scripts.text: Talk to her.
scripts.translation: 和她說話

scripts.text: Just pass by her
scripts.translation: 直接走過

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I'm worried that he's making trouble somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
我擔心他在哪裡惹麻煩了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, there?

[Gallina]
Oh, God!
I didn't see you there. Sorry!
You want to buy a hotcake, don't you?
I'm sorry but we're not ready to open the store..
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
天哪！
我沒看到你在那兒。抱歉！
你是想買鬆餅嗎？
抱歉，我們還沒準備好開店...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's ok.
Is there something that I can help with? What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。
有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, well...
My son, Mikhail broke our Matrushka while I was away from home.
He's afraid that I would punish him. So he ran away.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
哦，那個...
我兒子米哈伊爾趁我不在家的時候打壞了我們的套娃。
他怕我懲罰他，所以跑掉了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
How timid the boy is!
I doubt that he'd be able to be a great general in the future
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
這孩子真膽小！
我懷疑他將來能當上大將軍。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
He used to come home at this time.
I'm worried that something bad has happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
他以前這個時候都會回家的。
我擔心他出了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look anxious. I'd like to help you to find your son.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起來很焦慮。我想幫你找到你的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Did you say I'm anxious?
I'm just anxious for him to get home.
...So I can punish him for what he did.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
你說我焦慮？
我只是擔心他什麼時候能回家。
...這樣我就可以懲罰他做的事了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
But it's not good that I refuse your kindness
Will you find Mikhail for me?
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
但我不能拒絕你的好意。
你願意幫我找米哈伊爾嗎？

scripts.text: I was not serious.
scripts.translation: 我不是認真的。

scripts.text: Yes, I will!
scripts.translation: 是的，我會的！

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
You meanie! I'm not in the mood for jokes.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
你這個壞蛋！我沒心情開玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, God, You're so kind
Mikhail is such a timid boy. I guess he didn't leave this village.
Please bring him to me, then~
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
天哪，你真好。
米哈伊爾是個膽小的男孩。我想他沒有離開這個村莊。
請把他帶給我，好嗎~

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Mikhail, my timid son must still be in this village.
I'm sorry if he's shy and timid like his father.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
米哈伊爾，我膽小的兒子一定還在這個村莊裡。
如果他和父親一樣害羞膽小，我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mikhail hasn't come yet?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
米哈伊爾還沒回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
No, where on earth is he?
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
沒有，他到底在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
He came back with my Matrushka roughly pasted together and just left...
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
他帶著我的套娃回來了，雖然只是勉強粘在一起的，然後就走了...

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I'm sorry that I treated the little boy badly.
He did his best in his own way.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
抱歉我那樣對待小男孩。
他盡力用自己的方式做了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's ok. You will be a sweet mom to your little boy. haha
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。你會成為小男孩的好媽媽。哈哈

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Yes. I'm sure I will. hoho..
Anna, my daughter made a mistake. She laid the blame upon her brother alone. I'll punish her too.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
是的。我相信我會的。呵呵...
安娜，我的女兒犯了錯。她把責任全推給了弟弟。我也會懲罰她的。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I appreciate your effort. You went to a dangerous place to find my son
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
我很感激你的付出。你去了危險的地方尋找我的兒子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It often happens to me, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這種事經常發生在我身上，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I can't afford to reward you with much but... I'll let you know how to make a delicious hotcake!
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
我沒法給你太豐厚的獎勵，但是...我會告訴你怎麼做美味的鬆餅！

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I have to work now but Larissa will tell you about that. She's our maid..
She's really a nice cook.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]
我現在得去工作了，拉麗莎會告訴你怎麼做。她是我們的女僕...
她真的很擅長烹飪。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Hotcakes of Moscovia are so delicious!
Once you make it, I bet you that you'll love it.
scripts.translation:
[加利納]

scripts.translation:
[維克多]
莫斯科比亞附近有一個大島。坐船過去要花很長時間，所以沒人願意去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Victor]
If you go deep into its forest, you can find a swamp where sticky weeds are growing.
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
如果你深入它的森林，就能找到一片長著粘粘的草的沼澤。

scripts.text:
[Victor]
You should bring ^3131FF'10 sticky herbs'^000000 and ^3131FF 1 medicine bowl^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
你應該給我^3131FF10個粘粘的草^000000和^3131FF1個藥缽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Victor]
If you want to make adhesives
get 10 sticky herbs and
1 medicine bowl for me.
Those sticky herbs are growing in the swamp. It may be dangerous but that shouldn't be a problem for you?
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
如果你想製作強力膠，
給我10個粘粘的草和
1個藥缽。
那些粘粘的草長在沼澤裡。雖然很危險，但對你來說應該不是問題吧？

scripts.text:
[Victor]
What do you want with me this time??
Oh, you said you wanted an adhesive...
You're bothering me so much!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
這次你又想讓我做什麼？？
哦，你說你想要強力膠...
你真是煩死我了！

scripts.text:
[Victor]
Give me the stuff! I'll make it quickly. You're annoying me!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
把材料給我！我會很快做好的。你真煩人！

scripts.text: - He's making adhesive with a crunching sound -
scripts.translation: - 伴隨著咔嚓咔嚓的聲音，他在製作強力膠 -

scripts.text: - And he may be rubbing something -
scripts.translation: - 他可能還在摩擦什麼東西 -

scripts.text:
[Victor]
Ok, done!
I don't want you to bother me any longer!
Please leave!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
好了，完成了！
我不想再被你打擾了！
請離開！

scripts.text:
[Victor]
He's annoying me so much. Give me the materials!
Oh dear? What are those things? I said 10 sticky herbs and 1 medicine bowl!!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
他太煩人了。把材料給我！
天哪？那些是什麼東西？我說的是10個粘粘的草和1個藥缽！！

scripts.text:
[Victor]
Even though I'm always in the pub, I have my own business... !
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
雖然我整天泡在酒館裡，但我也有自己的生意...！

scripts.text:
[Victor]
..................
What are you staring at? Bring them to me right now!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
...........
你在那兒發什麼呆？快把它們給我！

scripts.text:
[Victor]
What did you say? I just want to drink peacefully!
scripts.translation:
[維克多]
你說什麼？我只想安安靜靜地喝酒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I got a good night's sleep. How long did I sleep?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我睡得很香。我睡了多久？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although I was forced to stay here, it's true that it's got great facilities.
I feel refreshed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雖然是被迫留在這裡，但這裡的設施確實不錯。
我感覺神清氣爽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, I guess I will go to the landlord to get some info.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想去問問房東，瞭解一下情況。

scripts.text: - Your bag is very heavy today -
scripts.translation: - 今天你的背包非常沉重 -

scripts.text: - You feel sticky just looking at this swamp. -
scripts.translation: - 光是看著這片沼澤，你就覺得黏糊糊的。 -

scripts.text: - Gas bubbles are rising. The atmosphere here is pretty scary -
scripts.translation: - 氣泡正在升起。這裡的氣氛相當恐怖 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't see any traces of Mikhail. I think I should go back and check his house one more time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒看到米哈伊爾的蹤跡。我覺得應該回去再檢查一下他的房子。

scripts.text: - You can see a small muddy swamp -
scripts.translation: - 你可以看到一片小小的泥濘沼澤 -

scripts.text: - Gas bubbles are rising. The atmosphere here is pretty scary -
scripts.translation: - 氣泡正在升起。這裡的氣氛相當恐怖 -

scripts.text: - You feel sticky just looking at the swamp. -
scripts.translation: - 光是看著這片沼澤，你就覺得黏糊糊的。 -

scripts.text: - Gas bubbles are rising. The atmosphere here is pretty scary -
scripts.translation: - 氣泡正在升起。這裡的氣氛相當恐怖 -

scripts.text: - You stretch out to find sticky herbs. -
scripts.translation: - 你伸出手去採摘粘粘的草。 -

scripts.text: - You have pricked your finger on a Sticky Herb. -
scripts.translation: - 你的手指被粘粘的草扎傷了。 -

scripts.text: - You have pricked your finger on a Green Herb. -
scripts.translation: - 你的手指被綠色藥草扎傷了。 -

scripts.text: - You can see a small swamp which seems very muddy. -
scripts.translation: - 你可以看到一片看起來非常泥濘的小沼澤。 -

scripts.text: - Gas bubbles are rising. The atmosphere here is pretty scary -
scripts.translation: - 氣泡正在升起。這裡的氣氛相當恐怖 -

scripts.text:
- Please stop here !! -
- You're carrying too many items -
- Please try again -
- after using the kafra service -
scripts.translation:
- 請在此停下！！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了 -
- 請再次嘗試 -
- 在使用卡普拉服務後 -

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Oh, you're the adventurer that Madame told me about.
Did you find her son?
I'm so glad. He's a good kid.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
哦，你就是夫人提到的那位冒險者。
你找到她的兒子了嗎？
太好了。他是個好孩子。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Here you are. This special pancake is for you.
It will be very delicious.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
給你。這是特製的鬆餅，請享用。
味道一定很棒。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Whenever you'd like to eat these pancake, you come on by.
I'll bake you the most delicious one.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
想吃鬆餅的時候，隨時歡迎過來。
我會為你烤出最美味的鬆餅。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Did the pancake taste good?
Would you like another pancake?
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
鬆餅好吃嗎？
還要再來一塊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Let me check if you have all the ingredients.
A frying pan, milk... potion that softens the dough, cheese..honey..and firewood.
Perfect!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
讓我檢查一下你是否備齊了材料。
平底鍋、牛奶...軟化麵糰的藥水、乳酪...蜂蜜...還有柴火。
完美！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Let us begin by kneading the dough.
I'll add sugar and baking powder.
It can be mixed well with this sieve.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
我們先來揉麵團。
我會加入糖和泡打粉。
用這個篩子可以混合得很均勻。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
What should I do with the wheat flour?
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
小麥粉應該怎麼處理呢？

scripts.text: Turn it down.
scripts.translation: 調小火。

scripts.text: Pass it through a sieve.
scripts.translation: 用篩子過篩。

scripts.text: Press it with your fist.
scripts.translation: 用拳頭按壓。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Oh, my! What are you doing now?
I'm going to do that from the beginning.
Look, pass it through a sieve.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
哎呀！你現在在做什麼？
我要從頭開始做。
看，用篩子過篩。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
There you go. Just do it slowly while tapping the sides, sifting the sugar and baking powder through the sieve together.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
就是這樣。慢慢來，一邊輕敲篩子邊緣，一邊將糖和泡打粉一起過篩。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
If we don't have the sieve, we can use our fist but we've got one. So we might as well use it right?
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
如果沒有篩子，可以用拳頭，但我們現在有篩子。所以還是用它比較好，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
That way, it will mix well.
And then I'm adding an egg, some milk and a white potion.
What next?
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
這樣混合得更均勻。
然後我加入一個雞蛋、一些牛奶和一瓶白色藥水。
接下來該做什麼？

scripts.text: Stir it up with great speed.
scripts.translation: 快速攪拌。

scripts.text: Do the same as she said.
scripts.translation: 照她說的做。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
No, you don't have to do that way. It won't rise properly if you stir it too fast.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
不，不需要那樣做。如果攪拌得太快，麵糰就不會發起來。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
You're very good at this!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
你很擅長這個！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
It'll rise while baking if you stir it properly
Ok, let me bake now. Let's pour it on our pan and spread it around.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
只要攪拌得當，烤的時候就會膨脹。
好了，讓我來烤。把它倒進平底鍋裡，攤開。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Cook in low temperature. It'll rise and have bubbles on it.
When you see the bubbles, you can turn it over.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
用低溫烹飪。它會膨脹並冒出氣泡。
看到氣泡時，就可以翻面了。

scripts.text: Cook in high temperature.
scripts.translation: 用高溫烹飪。

scripts.text: Can I turn it over now?
scripts.translation: 現在可以翻面了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
No, you don't do that.
You'll burn it up.
Wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
不，不要那樣做。
你會把它烤焦的。
再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Hmm let's see. It's good.
You were good at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
嗯，讓我看看。不錯。
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok, turn it over. Oh it looks delicious
What should I top it with? First I put some cheese but the rest is up to you...
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
好，翻面吧。看起來很好吃。
我該加什麼配料呢？我先放了一些乳酪，剩下的由你決定...

scripts.text: Caviar
scripts.translation: 魚子醬

scripts.text: Mushrooms
scripts.translation: 蘑菇

scripts.text: Honey
scripts.translation: 蜂蜜

scripts.text: Strawberry jam
scripts.translation: 草莓果醬

scripts.text: Sour cream
scripts.translation: 酸奶油

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok. you want caviar. Fortunately, I still have a little left.
Hoohoo, this'll be luxurious..
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
好，你要魚子醬。幸好我還剩一點。
哇，這下會很奢華呢。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok. you want mushrooms.. It has an earthly flavor.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
好，你要蘑菇。它有一種泥土的芬芳。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok, honey syrup goes perfectly with pancakes.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
好，蜂蜜糖漿和煎餅是絕配。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Who could get sick of pancakes with strawberry jam?
Hoohoo it tastes sweet too.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
誰能抗拒草莓果醬煎餅呢？
哇，味道也很甜美。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
You want sour cream.. you will feel as if you fly in the sky.
It can help reduce stress.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
你要酸奶油...你會感覺像在天空中飛翔。
它能幫助緩解壓力。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
That's good. I have ingredients and several toppings but...
It's still not enough. You need to get all of the things that we don't have now.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
很好。我有食材和幾種配料，但是...
還是不夠。你需要去弄齊我們現在缺少的東西。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
I need ^4d4dff1 old frying pan , 2 bottles of milk , 2 white potion, 1 cheese, 1 Trunk, 1 Honey ^000000.
We can bake our pancake when we get all of those.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
我需要^4d4dff1個破舊平底鍋、2瓶牛奶、2瓶白色藥水、1塊乳酪、1個樹幹、1瓶蜂蜜^000000。
集齊這些後，我們就可以烤煎餅了。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok we can bake it next time.
I'm always available.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
好，下次我們可以烤。
我一直都在。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Young lady is a practical joker and her brother is tenderhearted.
By the way, I haven't seen him for quite some time.
scripts.translation:
[拉麗莎]
年輕女士是個愛開玩笑的人，她的哥哥則很溫柔。
順便說一下，我已經很久沒見到他了。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
We have very fresh acorns. Everyone will like them!
You can buy one acorn for 100zeny!
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
我們有非常新鮮的橡子。大家都會喜歡的！
你可以用100 Zeny買一個橡子！

scripts.text: Buy one.
scripts.translation: 買一個

scripts.text: What can I use them for?
scripts.translation: 它們有什麼用？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Well uh...
You can grind them to make
something to eat and you can feed squirrels.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
呃...
你可以把它們磨碎做成食物，
也可以喂松鼠。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Someone can decorate their house
with them but I don't know how...
they've got to be highly talented.
Haha.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
有人會用它們來裝飾房子，
但我不太懂...
那需要非常有天賦才行。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
I'll bet you that they are very fresh!
How many acorns do you need?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
我敢打賭它們非常新鮮！
你需要多少個橡子？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Do you want to cancel this trade?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你要取消這筆交易嗎？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
You can't buy more than 500.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你一次不能買超過500個。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Hello, I think you can't get acorns
now. You're carrying too many
items!
Please use Kafra service. I'll be
right here.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你好，我想你現在拿不了橡子了。
你攜帶的物品太多了！
請使用卡普拉服務。我就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Hello? You've turned pale! Are you ok??
Do you have enough money?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你好？你臉色好蒼白！沒事吧？
你的錢夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Oh, thank you...
What do you think of them? They're fresh, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
哦，謝謝...
你覺得它們怎麼樣？很新鮮，對吧？

scripts.text:
- Please stop here!! -
- You're carrying too many items -
- Please try again -
- after using the kafra service -
scripts.translation:
- 請在此停下！！ -
- 您攜帶的物品過多 -
- 請先使用卡普拉服務 -
- 然後再試一次 -

scripts.text: - It's an extraordinary big squirrel. -
scripts.translation: - 這是一隻巨大的松鼠。 -

scripts.text: - When the animal comes across you, it starts to sniffle and purse up its lips. -
scripts.translation: - 當這隻動物靠近你時，它開始嗅來嗅去，並撅起了嘴唇。 -

scripts.text: Give acorns to it.
scripts.translation: 給它橡子

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text: Ask about the squirrel.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於松鼠的事

scripts.text: - You take one of acorns out and hold it out to the squirrel. -
scripts.translation: - 你拿出一顆橡子，遞給松鼠。 -

scripts.text: - It cocked it's ears up and begins to nibble the acorn quickly. -
scripts.translation: - 它豎起耳朵，開始快速地啃食橡子。 -

scripts.text:
- It makes a crunching sound -
- It makes a crunching sound -
- It makes a crunching sound -
scripts.translation:
- 發出咔嚓咔嚓的聲音 -
- 發出咔嚓咔嚓的聲音 -
- 發出咔嚓咔嚓的聲音 -

scripts.text: - After eating the acorn up, the squirrel dances around wildly. Suddenly it curls its body and throws something up with a spit-spit sound -
scripts.translation: - 吃完橡子後，松鼠瘋狂地跳起舞來。突然它蜷縮起身體，伴隨著噗噗的聲音吐出了什麼東西 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's so cute.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它好可愛。

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
Is it bigger than an ordinary one?
I found it one day and was barely able to save it...
scripts.translation:
[年邁的男子]
它比普通的大嗎？
有一天我發現它時，差點沒能救下它...

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
I felt that heaven had sent me a friend so that my life wouldn't be so lonely.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的男子]
我覺得這是上天賜給我的朋友，讓我的生活不再那麼孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
But I didn't know that it eats so much, it won't give me any attention if I give anything ^3131FFbelow 20 acorns^000000.
That's why it's bigger than ordinary ones hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[年邁的男子]
但我沒想到它胃口這麼大，如果給的橡子少於^3131FF20顆^000000，它根本不理我。
所以它才長得比普通松鼠大，哈哈。

scripts.text: - The squirrel looks at the acorn which you held for a while but it turned its head with indifference. -
scripts.translation: - 松鼠盯著你手中的橡子看了一會兒，然後冷漠地轉過頭去。 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hohoho
I need to kick your ass more.
Come here,
to play a game.
Heeeeeeeee.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呼呼呼
我得好好揍你一頓。
過來，
陪我玩個遊戲。
嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me live, leave me alone, and don't come near me.
Stop, I am hungry and scared.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我活命，別管我，離我遠點。
住手，我又餓又怕。

scripts.text: -She is blabbing something weird.-
scripts.translation: - 她在胡言亂語。 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, if you let me live, I will compensate you
with a present, how about that?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，如果你讓我活命，我會送你一份禮物作為補償，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: A present?
scripts.translation: 禮物？

scripts.text: I don't need.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, if you let me live
I will give you the Yaga Pestles
Aren't you gathering them?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，如果你讓我活命，
我會給你“雅嘎的研杵”。
你難道不是在收集它們嗎？

scripts.text: I don't need them anymore.
scripts.translation: 我不再需要它們了。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Kaaaaaaaaaak!
Please, let me live,
I will do anything you want.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘎啊啊啊啊啊！
求求你，讓我活命，
你想讓我做什麼都行。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Don't you need any cream for wounds
or indigestion?
They are a bit dirty,
but very useful.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你不覺得需要治療傷口
或消化不良的藥膏嗎？
雖然有點髒，
但非常有用。

scripts.text: Well...

[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
How about this?
I bewitch this country so that
the winter will never come here again.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這樣如何？
我施展魔法，讓這裡
永遠不再迎來冬天。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I guess that people will like it and
I'm sure that the Csar
will award you for it.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我想人們會喜歡的，
而且我確信沙皇
會因此獎賞你。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah? You seem
interested... ya?
What do you think about that?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊？你似乎
很感興趣... 是嗎？
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Good, but I think you're lying.
scripts.translation: 不錯，但我覺得你在撒謊。

scripts.text: I am not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Sure, you can trust me.
It is so complicated that I cannot
perform it on my own
I am not a liar.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
當然，你可以相信我。
這件事太複雜了，我獨自
無法完成。
我不是騙子。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, the problem is...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，問題是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to get the materials necessary
because I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我身體不舒服，
無法獲取所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
So,
if you give me a hand,
I can use the magic that
stops winter from returning. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
所以，
如果你能幫幫我，
我就能施展阻止冬天再次降臨的魔法。
你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會的。

scripts.text: No. I don't like it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Heeeek,
Just, just I need a little help.. It is really little.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿...嘿...
我只是需要一點點幫助...真的只是一點點。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Please, don't kill me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
求求你，別殺我...

scripts.text: 'Hmmm, what should I do...'
scripts.translation: '嗯...我該怎麼辦呢...'

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkk... What on earth did you do to me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊...你到底對我做了什麼...

scripts.text: Hmm... What do you want...
scripts.translation: 嗯...你想要什麼...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkkk!
You came back..
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊！
你回來了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
If you tell the Csar that
winter won't come back again
he will reward you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果你告訴凱撒，
冬天不會再回來了，
他會獎勵你的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Isn't that better for you
than hurting me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這難道不是比傷害我更好嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 好，告訴我故事。

scripts.text: Let me think...
scripts.translation: 讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Certainly, trust me.
It is so complicated that I cannot
perform it on my own
I am not a liar.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
當然，你可以相信我。
這件事太複雜了，我獨自
無法完成。
我不是騙子。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The problem is...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
問題是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to get the materials necessary
because I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我身體不舒服，
無法獲取所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
So,
if you give me a hand.
I can use the magic that
stops winter from returning. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
所以，
如果你能幫幫我，
我就能施展阻止冬天再次降臨的魔法。
你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會的。

scripts.text: No. I don't like it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Heeeeek,
Just, just I need a little help.. It is really little.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿...嘿...
我只是需要一點點幫助...真的只是一點點。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Please, don't kill me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
求求你，別殺我...

scripts.text: 'Hmm... what should I do...'
scripts.translation: '嗯...我該怎麼辦呢...'

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You think more...
What do you want from me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你再想想...
你想要我做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You just need to help little,
really little...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你只需要幫一點點忙，
真的只是一點點...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, did you change your mind?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，你改變主意了嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, let's try.
scripts.translation: 好，試試看。

scripts.text: Let me think more...
scripts.translation: 讓我再想想...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You think more...
What do you want from me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你再想想...
你想要我做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see...where the season spell...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我看看...那個季節咒語...

scripts.text: rummaging...
scripts.translation: 翻找中...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, here it is... I found it!
Hoook~ Hoook~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，在這裡...我找到了！
呼~呼~

scripts.text: -What a dusty old book!-
scripts.translation: -真是一本落滿灰塵的舊書！-

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, open your ears.
It is so rare around here that
it is not easy for you to remember at once.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好了，豎起耳朵聽好。
這裡很少見，
你恐怕一時半會兒記不住。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Above all,
I need 20 Grasshopper's Legs...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
首先，
我需要20個蝗蟲後腿...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough,
Kaaak, Kaaaaak
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳，
嘎嘎，嘎嘎嘎

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Sniff, sniff.
5 Spawn...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
吸溜，吸溜。
5個Spawn...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
eh... and...
20 Wings Of Red Bat...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃...還有...
20個紅蝙蝠翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see...
a glue, no, to cast a spell
10 Sticky Mucus...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我看看...
膠水，不對，施法需要
10個粘稠液體...

scripts.text: ...Are you sure?
scripts.translation: ...你確定嗎？

scripts.text: A glue? You want me to kill you?!
scripts.translation: 膠水？你想害死我？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, yes, I am certain. Why don't you trust me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，是的，我很確定。你為什麼不相信我...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough,
I am coughing now, so do not disturb me,
you write them down.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳，
我現在正在咳嗽，別打擾我，
你把這些記下來。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
No, It just...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
不，只是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhh, terrible.
Hey, relax your hand and
keep writing.
Forget the Sticky Mucus...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃，糟透了。
嘿，放鬆你的手，
繼續寫。
忘掉粘稠液體...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Where were we...
Cough, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
剛才說到哪了...
咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, yes. Next elements are
essential.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，對了。接下來的材料
是必不可少的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
10 Witched Starsand
10 Fine Grits...
Hooook, hooook~
Ekkkk, what a dusty book!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
10個女巫星沙
10個黃晶沙的一角...
呼...呼...
咳咳，這書真落灰啊！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Next is for
something hot.
1 Detonator
5 Red Blood,
and 10 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下來是
用來加熱量的材料。
1個雷管
5個火靈礦石，
還有10個燃燒的心臟。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, and I need
a 1, 2, or 3 carat
^ff0000Diamond^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，對了，我還需要
1克拉、2克拉或3克拉的
^ff0000鑽石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ok, I am repeating the items.
Eh, they are...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好的，我重複一下材料。
呃，它們是...

[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs,
5 Spawn,

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am preparing to make it,
you should get me them quickly. Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我準備開始製作了，
你最好快點把它們弄來。咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhh... You came back earlier.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃...你回來得真早。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I'm almost prepared..
Did you get
all of the items?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我快準備好了..
你把所有材料
都帶來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Right, you got them all.
With this amount.. For some time...
No, to make the Secret Medicine,
These are enough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
沒錯，你都帶來了。
以這個數量.. 夠一段時間了...
不，要製作秘藥，
這些足夠了，咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see, we have all
that we need...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我看看，我們需要的
東西都齊了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhhh...
Huk!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃...
咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough, cough!
Eh... I mean...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳咳！
呃...我是說...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Have you heard the story of
a dragon sleeping for a long time?
Next thing that I need is
something from that dragon, kkkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你聽說過
一條沉睡了很久的龍的故事嗎？
我接下來需要的東西
就來自那條龍，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You can find a funny-shaped bottle
in the dragon's lair.
It's a gourd bottle that can
contain people's speech.
I must have this.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你可以在龍巢穴找到一個
形狀奇怪的瓶子。
那是一個葫蘆瓶，可以
裝下人們的言語。
我必須得到它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I don't know how strong you are,
but I would like to recommend that
you avoid fighting that dragon, Kaaaaak~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我不知道你有多強，
但我建議你
避免和那條龍戰鬥，咳咳~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Then, release me.
I want to do something,
...but, my life is the priority. Yes, it is... Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
那麼，放我走吧。
我想去做點事，
...但是，我的命最重要。是的，就是這樣... 咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I think
I need more, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我想
我還需要更多，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to do
anything without them.
I am repeating the items in the list,
you should get them all, kaaaaak!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
沒有它們，我什麼都做不了。
我再重複一遍清單上的物品，
你應該把它們都收集齊，咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs,
5 Spawn,
20 Wings Of Red Bat
10 Sticky Mucus,
10 Witch Starsand^000000...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
^ff000020個 蝗蟲後腿,
5個 幼蟲,
20個 紅蝙蝠翅膀
10個 粘稠液體,
10個 魔女之星沙^000000...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs,
5 Spawn,
20 Wings Of Red Bat
10 Witch Starsand^000000...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
^ff000020個 蝗蟲後腿,

20個 紅蝙蝠翅膀

scripts.text:

1 Detonator,

1個 雷管,
5個 火靈礦石
10個 燃燒的心臟^000000
以及一顆1、2或3克拉的
^ff0000鑽石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough.
Hu, I talked so much
that it hurts me, Kaaaak~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳。
呼，我說了這麼多，
嗓子都疼了，咳咳咳~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is very, very hard to return alive
from a lair of a dragon
without strength and courage.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果沒有力量和勇氣，
想要從龍的巢穴活著回來，
是非常、非常困難的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Unless you want to be killed,
you'd better forget
the magic gourd bottle, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
除非你想死，
否則最好忘掉
那個魔法的葫蘆瓶，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkkk?
Did you really bring it
from the lair of the dragon...?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊？
你真的從龍的巢穴
把它帶回來了...？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You are superbly great.
I don't know whether
you killed the dragon or
you just stole it from the dragon,
either way I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你真是了不起。
我不知道
你是殺了那條龍，
還是直接從它那裡偷來的，
反正我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is great that
you've returned alive
from the lair of the dragon, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你能從龍的巢穴
活著回來，真是太好了，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Here, I told you before that
this gourd bottle can
contain people's speech
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
給你，我之前告訴過你，
這個葫蘆瓶可以
裝下人們的言語。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The next thing that we have to do
is to receive sincere speeches from
people with this bottle.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下來我們要做的，
就是用這個瓶子
收集人們真誠的言語。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The important thing is that
you cannot force them to speak.
For example, you cannot tell them
to say 'I don't want winter to come.'
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
重要的是，
你不能強迫他們說話。
例如，你不能告訴他們
說“我不想讓冬天到來”。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You should have them
speak naturally.
Ah, one more thing that
you have to take care to remember.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你應該讓他們
自然地說話。
啊，還有一件事
你要特別記住。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You need to have the
voices of three people.
From a child, a young person and a
middle aged person.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你需要收集
三個人的聲音。
分別來自一個孩子、一個年輕人
和一箇中年人。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The magic is not just witchcraft
This type of magic is effective
only by embodying the desires of people.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這不僅僅是巫術。
這種魔法
只有體現人們的願望時才有效。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Take care of yourself, cough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
保重，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is very, very hard to return alive
from a lair of a dragon
without strength and courage.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果沒有力量和勇氣，
想要從龍的巢穴活著回來，
是非常、非常困難的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Unless you want to be killed
you'd better forget
the magic gourd bottle, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
除非你想死，
否則最好忘掉
那個魔法的葫蘆瓶，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
To make the magic,
I need you to contain
the wish phrase 'I don't want winter to come.'
from the three people, kkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
為了施展魔法，
我需要你收集
三個人說的願望短語“我不想讓冬天到來”，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, one thing that you need to remember
is, do not force them to say it!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，有一件事
你需要記住，
不要強迫他們說這句話！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Next,
you should contain the word from
a child, a young man and a middle aged man.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下來，
你需要收集一個孩子、
一個年輕男子和一箇中年男子
所說的話。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, take care of yourself.
Cough, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好了，保重。
咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
My place has been revealed, cough, cough.
because of you!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我的藏身之處
因為你而暴露了，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
What did you do outside?
The soldiers of the Csar are
surrounding here so that
I cannot go out.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你在外面做了什麼？
沙皇計程車兵包圍了這裡，
讓我無法出去。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Did you do
what I told
you to do?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你做了
我讓你做的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Where is the Gourd Bottle?
I can't do anything without it.
Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
葫蘆瓶在哪裡？
沒有它我什麼都做不了。
咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Anyway, give me the bottle and
think about
what to do, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
總之，把瓶子給我，
然後想想該怎麼做，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
This bottle will be
used later and now,
the last step remains
to complete the work.
Pass me the book.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這個瓶子之後會用到，
現在，只剩下最後一步
來完成這項工作。
把書遞給我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
My abilities are deteriorating
and magic should only be
done by a single person.
So, you must compound the materials yourself,
kaaaaak!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我的能力正在衰退，
魔法只能由一個人施展。
所以，你必須自己混合材料，
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I know it is hard to do,
but it is the magic that
embodies and reveals
people's desires.
It is useless unless you put your
full effort into it, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我知道這很難，
但這是一種體現並揭示
人們願望的魔法。
除非你全力以赴，否則毫無用處，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ok, you see that book??
The letters on the book 
are illegible,
But you'll be able to read it 'cuz
I added comments under the lines for you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好了，看到那本書了嗎？
書上的字跡模糊不清，
但我線上條下添加了註釋，
所以你能讀懂它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Read carefully and just follow what
it tells you.
The magic is complete.
Do your best,
Cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
仔細閱讀，並按照
書上說的去做。
魔法就完成了。
加油吧，
咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Magic does not come from
something mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
魔法並不來自
什麼神秘的東西。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is your effort
that makes magic.
There is a saying,
if you really want it,
it will happen, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是你的努力
造就了魔法。
有句俗話說，
如果你真的想要，
它就會實現，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Here, according to the book
put the materials in the pot and
boil them for some time.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這裡，根據書上的指示，
把材料放進鍋裡，
煮一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehmmm...
Don't you think that
something is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯...
你不覺得
有什麼不對勁嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, try it again.
We still have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，再試一次。
我們還有足夠的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see, hmm!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我看看，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hmm, this might be your first time, but
this is good.
You may be talented, kkkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，這可能是你第一次，
但這很不錯。
你可能很有天賦，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Now then, we are in the final step.
I'll put the medicine in the bottle,
you break it by dropping it
in the center of the town.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
現在，我們到了最後一步。
我會把藥水裝進瓶子裡，
你把它摔碎在
城鎮的中心。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
If you do this, what the villagers want
will be happening,
forever.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果你這樣做，
村民們想要的東西
就會永遠實現。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You just drop the bottle
in the middle of the village
to break it.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你只需要把瓶子
摔碎在村莊的中心。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
And then,
It doesn't matter to me
if you tell the whole town or
report to the Csar to be praised.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
至於之後，
你是告訴全鎮的人，
還是向凱撒彙報以求表揚，
對我來說都無所謂。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, don't come back to me, cough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，別再回來找我了，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hey,
I told you
to never come back, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿，
我說過
永遠不要回來，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Stop disturbing me.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, do you accept?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，你答應了？
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, I thank you for your kindness.
Let's cooperate and
make my Secret Medicine.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，感謝你的好意。
讓我們合作，
製作我的秘密藥水。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see... Ah...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
讓我看看... 啊...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is not used often.
I don't remember
where it is.
Could you please come back later?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
這東西不常用。
我不記得
放在哪裡了。
請稍後再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who the hell are you.
You want me to kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你他媽是誰。
想讓我揍你嗎！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You, chicken,
I need to kick your ass more.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你這隻小雞，
我得好好揍你一頓。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hohoho~
You cannot beat my friends!
I don't know where you got
those Yaga Pestles, but
give them back to me!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呵呵呵~
你打不過我的朋友們！
我不知道你從哪弄來
那些雅嘎研杵的，
但把它們還給我！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who the hell are you?
You want me to kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你他媽是誰？
想讓我揍你嗎！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I need to kick your ass more.
Come here
to play a game
Heeeeeeeeeeee
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我得好好揍你一頓。
過來
玩個遊戲
嘿——————

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
No. They are...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
不。它們是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You have our Yaga Pestles!
You have so many of them...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你有我們的雅嘎研杵！
你有那麼多...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你，你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I will bewitch
and enslave you.
Come here, Heeee!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我會施法
奴役你。
過來，嘿！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Recently, I have no appetite.
But you will be
a good appetizer.
Come here, Heeeeeeeee.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
最近，我沒有食慾。
但你會是
很好的開胃菜。
過來，嘿——————。

scripts.text:
-Beside the pot,
There is an unusually large book.
The letters are in disarray and
some of them, I can't understand.
The comments by Baba Yaga
help me read some of them.-
scripts.translation:
-在鍋旁邊，
有一本異常巨大的書。
上面的文字雜亂無章，
有些我看不懂。
芭芭雅嘎的批註
幫助我讀懂了其中一部分。-

scripts.text: -Ok, time to read it.-
scripts.translation: -好了，該讀讀了。-

scripts.text:
...Therefore, this spell is
particularly good among our mighty ones.
Usually, the magic is considered
as a contract with evil.
But, the following is not the power
of Hell but of Nature and the spirit of humans.
I already told you that this spell
has 2 features as follows.
First, it changes natural phenomenon.
Unlike the idea from foolish scholars,
this world is composed of invisible and precise orders.
The things that people call
miracles are made by stimulating
them or simply altering their arrangement.
Most of the spells for weather
changing are included in them and
they require a high level of comprehension.
The orders of this world are not simply aligned.
It is almost impossible to observe
the smallest and detailed part of
them and completely understand their structure
However, it is not that difficult
to repeat the spells that are already made.
This thick spell book is for that purpose.
scripts.translation:
...因此，這個法術在我們強大的法師中尤為出色。
通常，魔法被視為與邪惡的契約。
但以下並非地獄的力量，
而是自然與人類精神的力量。
我已經告訴過你，這個法術有兩個特點。
首先，它改變自然現象。
不同於愚蠢學者的想法，
這個世界由不可見且精確的秩序構成。
人們所謂的奇蹟，
是通過刺激或簡單改變其排列而產生的。
大多數改變天氣的法術都包含在其中，
它們需要高程度的理解力。
這個世界的秩序並非簡單排列。
幾乎不可能觀察到它們
最微小和詳細的部分，
並完全理解其結構。
然而，重複已經制作好的法術
並沒有那麼困難。
這本厚重的法術書就是為了這個目的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That? That's just the preface?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那？那只是序言？！

scripts.text:
...The second feature is
This spell book represents the desire of mankind.
Their spirit is so great,
sometimes flames in their hearts
are embodied and become reality.
Now, practice one of the spells for weather.
You have to go to a damp and deserted place,
and have a pot of melting materials
along with the spirit of the caster.
The next spells should be conducted
through the exact process.
If you realize that something is
wrong, you'd MUST stop immediately.
To prevent the ordinary from
abusing the magic,
the narratives of the materials are metaphors,
but, whoever understands this can
read everything in it.
scripts.translation:
...第二個特點是
這本法術書代表了人類的慾望。
他們的精神如此強大，
有時心中的火焰
會具象化併成為現實。
現在，練習一個改變天氣的法術。
你必須去一個潮溼且荒涼的地方，
並準備一鍋正在熔化的材料，
以及施法者的精神。
接下來的法術必須
通過精確的過程進行。
如果你發現有什麼不對勁，
你必須立即停止。
為了防止普通人濫用魔法，
材料的描述都是隱喻，
但，無論誰理解這一點，
都能讀懂其中的一切。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just accounts for the spell.
What a long preface.
I'll mark this spot.
so I can easily find the mixing
process next time...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它只是描述了法術。
多麼長的序言啊。
我會標記這個位置，
以便下次輕鬆找到混合過程...

scripts.text:
^0000ffSeasonal Magic^000000:^ff0000Eternal Summer^000000
First of all, you need to put and
mix the first 3 things in a pre-heated pot.
The extended arms of those who stalk at night,
The rotten mixture of plants and animals,
and the limbs of one going forward,
who wants to run backward.
This first stage should be complete.
Just after this stage, the mixture
will barely show any alteration.
After this, you must add the liquid
that aids all life and stir 20 times.
At this point you will certainly
see its color and smell changing.
Remember that if you realize that
something is wrong, you must stop and start over.
Following these precise steps are
most important when working on magic.
Next, 2 things must be put in the pot.
First, objects that are seen when
looking at the night sky.
Second the pretty mass of earth,
slipping through even when watered.
You should check if it's smell has changed.
Then stir it well 15 times.
It's color will change.
The final ingredients will be those
that contain heat.
You must follow the order.
Stones that have the attribute of sun,
brains of a marine sphere,
the organ of passion,
and a stone that cannot be cut.
Once the final ingredient is placed in the pot,
It will be over.
The solution must be sprinkled at
the place where you want to affect,
the changing of the seasons.
scripts.translation:
^0000ff季節魔法^000000:^ff0000永恆之夏^000000
首先，你需要將前三種東西
放入預熱好的鍋中並混合。
那些在夜間潛遁者的伸展手臂，
植物和動物的腐朽混合物，
以及一個想要向前奔跑
卻想向後跑的人的四肢。
第一階段應該完成。
就在這一階段之後，混合物
幾乎不會顯示出任何變化。
之後，你必須加入
有助於所有生命的液體，並攪拌20次。
此時你肯定會看到
它的顏色和氣味發生變化。
記住，如果你發現有什麼不對勁，
你必須停止並重新開始。
遵循這些精確的步驟
在施展魔法時最為重要。
接下來，必須將兩樣東西放入鍋中。
第一，當仰望夜空時看到的物體。
第二，美麗的泥土團塊，
即使澆水也會滑落。
你應該檢查它的氣味是否改變。
然後充分攪拌15次。
它的顏色會改變。
最後的材料將是那些
包含熱量的東西。
你必須遵循順序。
具有太陽屬性的石頭，
氣泡蟲的大腦，
激情的器官，
以及一塊無法切割的石頭。
一旦最後的材料放入鍋中，
就結束了。
必須將溶液噴灑在
你想要影響的地方，
以改變季節。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll mark this page so that I
know where to read next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會標記這一頁，
以便知道下次從哪裡讀起。

scripts.translation: 從序言開始閱讀

scripts.text: Read from the marked page.
scripts.translation: 從標記的頁面開始閱讀

這本法術書代表了人類的慾望。
他們的精神如此強大，
有時心中的火焰
會具象化併成為現實。
現在，練習一個改變天氣的法術。
你必須去一個潮溼且荒涼的地方，
並準備一鍋正在熔化的材料，
以及施法者的精神。
接下來的法術必須
通過精確的過程進行。
如果你發現有什麼不對勁，
你必須立即停止。
為了防止普通人濫用魔法，
材料的描述都是隱喻，
但，無論誰理解這一點，
都能讀懂其中的一切。

scripts.text:
^0000ffSeasonal Magic^000000:^ff0000Eternal Summer^000000
First of all, you need to put and
mix the first 3 things in a pre-heated pot.
The extended arms of those who stalk at night,
The rotten mixture of plants and animals,
and the limbs of one going forward,
who wants to run backward.
This first stage should be complete.
Just after this stage, the mixture
will barely show any alteration.
After this, you must add the liquid
that aids all life and stir 20 times.
At this point you will certainly
see its color and smell changing.
Remember that if you realize that
something is wrong, you must stop and start over.
Following these precise steps are
most important when working on magic.
Next, 2 things must be put in the pot.
First, objects that are seen when
looking at the night sky.
Second the pretty mass of earth,
slipping through even when watered.
You should check if it's smell has changed.
Then stir it well 15 times.
It's color will change.
The final ingredients will be those
that contain heat.
You must follow the order.
Stones that have the attribute of sun,
brains of a marine sphere,
the organ of passion,
and a stone that cannot be cut.
Once the final ingredient is placed in the pot,
It will be over.
The solution must be sprinkled at
the place where you want to affect,
the changing of the seasons.
scripts.translation:
^0000ff季節魔法^000000:^ff0000永恆之夏^000000
首先，你需要將前三種東西
放入預熱好的鍋中並混合。
那些在夜間潛遁者的伸展手臂，
植物和動物的腐朽混合物，
以及一個想要向前奔跑
卻想向後跑的人的四肢。
第一階段應該完成。
就在這一階段之後，混合物
幾乎不會顯示出任何變化。
之後，你必須加入
有助於所有生命的液體，並攪拌20次。
此時你肯定會看到
它的顏色和氣味發生變化。
記住，如果你發現有什麼不對勁，
你必須停止並重新開始。
遵循這些精確的步驟
在施展魔法時最為重要。
接下來，必須將兩樣東西放入鍋中。
第一，當仰望夜空時看到的物體。
第二，美麗的泥土團塊，
即使澆水也會滑落。
你應該檢查它的氣味是否改變。
然後充分攪拌15次。
它的顏色會改變。
最後的材料將是那些
包含熱量的東西。
你必須遵循順序。
具有太陽屬性的石頭，
氣泡蟲的大腦，
激情的器官，
以及一塊無法切割的石頭。
一旦最後的材料放入鍋中，
就結束了。
必須將溶液噴灑在
你想要影響的地方，
以改變季節。

helped me make the medicine, but,
I never want to read it again.-
scripts.translation:

但我再也不想讀它了。-

scripts.text: -It's an unusually large book laid down, open.-
scripts.translation: -一本異常巨大的書攤開平放著。-

scripts.text:
-It is a very dirty pot.
Something is boiling
Baba Yaga might have done something
with it.
Well, let's get it started.-
scripts.translation:
-這是一個非常髒的鍋。
有什麼東西在沸騰。
芭芭雅嘎可能用它做了什麼。
好吧，讓我們開始吧。-

scripts.text:
-Something is still being boiled in the pot.
What am I going to do?-
scripts.translation:
-鍋裡還在煮著什麼東西。
我要做什麼？-

scripts.text: Put the materials in it.
scripts.translation: 放入材料

scripts.text: Pour water in it.
scripts.translation: 倒入水

scripts.text: Stir it up.
scripts.translation: 攪拌

scripts.text: It is over!
scripts.translation: 完成了！

-I put the {0} in the pot.
Its smell slightly changes.-
scripts.translation:
-我把{0}放進了鍋裡。
它的氣味稍微改變了。-

scripts.text:
-I pour water in the pot a little.
The liquid has become thin.
No other remarkable changes
have happened.-
scripts.translation:
-我往鍋裡倒了一點水。
液體變稀了。
沒有其他明顯的變化。-

scripts.text:
-I stir it up
with a stick several times.
No other remarkable changes
have happened.-
scripts.translation:
-我用木棍攪拌了幾次。
沒有其他明顯的變化。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will tell Baba Yaga that
the work has been done.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會告訴芭芭雅嘎，工作已經完成了。

scripts.text:
-The liquid has been changed
and is now bubbling.
It seems to have shrunk,
but not by much.-
scripts.translation:
-液體發生了變化，現在正在冒泡。
看起來體積縮小了一些，但幅度不大。-

scripts.text:
-Anyway, the first step is done
let's go on the next stage.-
scripts.translation:
-總之，第一步完成了。
讓我們繼續下一步。-

scripts.text: -Well, What am I going to do?-
scripts.translation: -嗯，我接下來該做什麼呢？-

scripts.text: Pour water in it.

scripts.text: It is over!

-我把{0}放進了鍋裡。

-I pour water in the pot a little.
The boiling sounds stronger as if
something in the cloudy liquid
has changed.-
scripts.translation:
-我往鍋裡倒了一點水。
沸騰的聲音變大了，
彷彿渾濁液體中的某些東西發生了變化。-

scripts.text: -I pour water in the pot and, the liquid gets thin.-
scripts.translation: -我往鍋裡倒水，液體變稀了。-

How many times should I..?

好的，這次我來攪拌。
應該攪拌多少次呢？

scripts.text: -It must be 20 times.-
scripts.translation: -應該是20次。-

scripts.text:
-Stirring up makes it
brighter and
its smell gets
more bearable.
scripts.translation:
-攪拌後顏色變亮了，
氣味也變得不那麼難聞了。-

scripts.text: -I won't stir it up.-
scripts.translation: -我不攪拌了。-

scripts.text:
-It won't be able
to stir so many times.
Let me think again.-
scripts.translation:
-我沒辦法攪拌那麼多次。
讓我再想想。-
