scripts.text: Do you like the warm weather, little girl?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡溫暖的天氣嗎，小女孩？

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Yes, I like it very much~
I never want it to leave. I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[約瑟菲娜]
是的，我非常喜歡~
我希望它永遠不要離開。我不希望冬天到來。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Yes, I like it very much~
But, as soon as the sun sets I must go back home.
scripts.translation:
[約瑟菲娜]
是的，我非常喜歡~
但是，太陽一落山我就必須回家了。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Baba Yaga kidnaps
bad kids wandering
in the night, I heard.
scripts.translation:
[約瑟菲娜]
我聽說，芭芭雅嘎會在夜裡
綁架到處亂跑的壞孩子。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Baba Yaga, the Horrible Cannibal
is living outside the town.
scripts.translation:
[約瑟菲娜]
可怕的食人魔芭芭雅嘎
住在城外。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
My mom told me.
that she is real.
scripts.translation:
[約瑟菲娜]
我媽媽告訴我的。
她說那是真的。

scripts.text: You don't like winter, do you?
scripts.translation: 你不喜歡冬天，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
No, I don't like the cold winter.
And I get angry when
seeing couples.
scripts.translation:
[費多爾]
不，我不喜歡寒冷的冬天。
而且看到情侶在一起
我就會生氣。

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Huuuu, I wish I could have a girlfriend
I would be able to enjoy the warm sunlight better...
scripts.translation:
[費多爾]
呼...要是能有個女朋友就好了，
那樣我就能更好地享受溫暖的陽光了...

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Who are you?
Don't make matters worse!
scripts.translation:
[費多爾]
你是誰？
別把事情搞得更糟！

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Finally, winter is over.
Spring is coming
to my mind...
scripts.translation:
[費多爾]
終於，冬天過去了。
春天就要來了，
我想...

scripts.text: Whoever likes the winter?
scripts.translation: 誰喜歡冬天啊？

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Tell me about it!
Everyone will be sad
when it comes again.
I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[維克托]
告訴我吧！
當它再次來臨時，
每個人都會感到悲傷。
我不希望冬天到來。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Hmm, do you think so...
I am too familiar with both
summer and winter to care much for
one over the other.
scripts.translation:
[維克托]
嗯，你是這麼想的嗎...
我對夏天和冬天都太熟悉了，
所以並不特別偏愛哪一個。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Our people are very, very
proud of their strength and
invincible spirits.
scripts.translation:
[維克托]
我們的人非常、非常
自豪於自己的力量
和無敵的精神。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
It doesn't matter to us
how cold the winter is!
scripts.translation:
[維克托]
冬天有多冷，
對我們來說並不重要！

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Wow, he is
an adventurer, an adventurer!!
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
哇，他是
冒險者，冒險者！！

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Why did you come here?
Don't you have any colleague?
I heard that the heroes in epics were tall,
but, why are you so small?
Where is your gold-shining sword?
I heard that the armor glittered white,
but, why don't you have on the armor?
Won't you go for another adventure?
How can you do it in the cold and snowy winter?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
你為什麼來這裡？
你沒有同伴嗎？
我聽說史詩裡的英雄都很高大，
但，你為什麼這麼小？
你那金光閃閃的劍在哪裡？
我聽說盔甲閃閃發白，
但，你為什麼沒穿盔甲？
你難道不再去冒險了嗎？
在寒冷多雪的冬天，你怎麼能那樣做呢？

scripts.text: I will go if it gets warm.
scripts.translation: 天氣暖和了我就去。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Will you? I will also
go out for adventures
with shining armor and
a long and heavy sword
some day.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
真的嗎？總有一天，
我也會穿著閃閃發光的盔甲，
拿著又長又重的劍
出去冒險。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Ah, when are you leaving?
Where are you going this time?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
啊，你什麼時候出發？
這次你要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
If winter is gone,
it is much easier to go on adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
如果冬天過去了，
去冒險就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Will you go to slay the dragon,
that breathes fire and can
exterminates 10 men by flapping
its wings once?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
你會去屠龍嗎？
就是那種會噴火，
扇一次翅膀就能消滅十個人的龍？

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Tell me your exciting story.
Have you fought a dragon?
Where is your gold-shining sword and shield?
Where?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
快講講你精彩的冒險故事吧！
你打敗過龍嗎？
你那閃閃發光的劍和盾在哪裡？
在哪裡？

scripts.text: You look good today.
scripts.translation: 你今天看起來氣色不錯。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
Yes, I feel good.
When it gets warm, sunflowers bloom.
The sunflower is the symbol
of this province.
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
是啊，我感覺很好。
天氣暖和了，向日葵就開了。
向日葵是這個省份的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
I wish that winter never comes back and
I could see sunflowers everyday.
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
我希望冬天永遠不要再來，
這樣我就能天天看到向日葵了。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
The spring has come~
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
春天來了~

scripts.text:
[Katya]
A million sunflowers are blooming~
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
一百萬朵向日葵都開了~

scripts.text: The weather is getting warmer.
scripts.translation: 天氣越來越暖和了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Yes, kids like it and
flowers are blooming.
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
是啊，孩子們很喜歡，
花兒也開了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
In the warm days,
I'm in trouble.
It's too hard to control
the children.
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
在暖和的日子裡，
我有點頭疼。
太難管住那些孩子了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Whoever likes the cold and dark winter?
I hope this weather last forever.
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
誰喜歡寒冷黑暗的冬天呢？
我希望這種天氣能永遠持續下去。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
I think
I need winter again.
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
我覺得
我還是需要冬天。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Naughty children get too
excited in the warm days.
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
調皮的孩子們在暖和的日子裡
太興奮了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Where is the sun?
Where is it hiding?
scripts.translation:
[羅扎]
太陽在哪裡？
它躲到哪裡去了？

scripts.text: Do you like mysterious stories?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡神秘的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
Yes, I love them.
But, in winter,
nobody comes out of their homes.
So it's not very fun.
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
是的，我很喜歡。
但是，在冬天，
沒人會出門。
所以不太好玩。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
Yes, my Grandma told me
fairy-tales.
The winter is cold, but
it is fun to hear them.
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
是的，我的老奶奶
給我講過童話。
冬天雖然冷，
但聽故事很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
If winter never comes
I can have
fun all the time...
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
如果冬天永遠不來，
我就可以
一直玩下去了...

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
This is the story
about a terrible dragon.
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
這是一個
關於可怕巨龍的故事。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
It is sleeping
in its lair,
but, it destroys everything
around it when it awakes.
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
它正在巢穴裡睡覺，
但一旦醒來，
就會摧毀周圍的一切。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
This came from my grandma's
grandma's grandma's
grandma's grandma's
grandma's grandma.
scripts.translation:
[費利克斯]
這個故事來自我奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
I am going to adventure
to experience new worlds
as you do.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞夫]
我要去冒險，
像你們一樣，
去體驗新的世界。

scripts.text: When do you feel good?
scripts.translation: 你什麼時候心情好？

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
When the weather is as good as recently
I feel an impulse to adventure
many times a day.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞夫]
當天氣像最近這樣好的時候，
我一天會有好幾次
想要去冒險的衝動。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
Well...
I don't know.
I just am sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞夫]
嗯...
我也說不清。
只是有時候會這樣。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
But, I don't want to in the cold winter.
Hu, if the weather everday was as good as lately,
I would like to go out a lot more.
I hate winter...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞夫]
但是，我不想在寒冷的冬天出門。
呼，如果每天天氣都像最近這樣好，
我就更想多出去走走了。
我討厭冬天...

scripts.text: What do you usually do in winter?
scripts.translation: 你冬天通常做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Orek]
It is too cold in winter so I don't go outside.
There's so much snow that it makes it hard to go
around here and there.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷克]
冬天太冷了，所以我不出門。
雪太大了，
讓人很難到處走動。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
It snows a lot in winter and
gets too cold.
So, we don't go outside
without a particular reason.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷克]
冬天雪下得很大，
而且太冷了。
所以，沒有特別的原因，
我們不會出門。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
In winter, fishing is more difficult,
anyway, it is bad for us.
I think it would be ok if we never had winter again.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷克]
冬天釣魚更難了，
總之，這對我們很不利。
我想，如果再也沒有冬天就好了。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
My family just sits beside the pechka and talks,
hoping that winter passes by soon.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷克]
我的家人只是坐在壁爐旁聊天，
希望冬天快點過去。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
The present Csar is a bit strict and
terrible, but
he actually loves
his people.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷克]
現在的沙皇有點嚴厲，
甚至有點可怕，
但他其實
很愛他的人民。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
I've seen many people
from other provinces recently.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
最近我見到很多
來自其他省份的人。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
This used to not
be a tourist town.
What happened...?
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
這裡以前
並不是旅遊城鎮。
發生了什麼事...？

scripts.text: Here it is warm and good.
scripts.translation: 這裡溫暖又舒適。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
Hohoho, that may be true now.
But, you don't even know how cold it gets here in winter.
You wouldn't even want to go outside.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
呵呵呵，現在也許是這樣。
但你不知道這裡冬天有多冷。
你甚至不想出門。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
It is good to stay with my family, but
nobody likes the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
和家人待在一起很好，
但沒有人喜歡寒冷的冬天。

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
Sunflowers are squeezed for oil and
their bodies are used for medicinal purposes.
They are very useful.
scripts.translation:
[薩賓娜]
向日葵被榨油，
它們的身體被用於藥用。
它們非常有用。

scripts.text: When do sunflowers bloom?
scripts.translation: 向日葵什麼時候開花？

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
They start to bloom
from the late summer.
You cannot help being
attracted to sunflowers,
if you see the spectacular scene
of a field filled up with them.
scripts.translation:
[薩賓娜]
它們從夏末開始開花。
如果你看到
一片開滿向日葵的壯觀景象，
你無法不被它們吸引。

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
If the summer continues to last,
I can see them all the time...
scripts.translation:
[薩賓娜]
如果夏天能一直持續，
我就可以一直看到它們了...

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
There is a old saying,
'an opportunity is a chance.'
scripts.translation:
[伊茲洛夫]
有句老話，
“機會就是機遇。”

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
It is best to confess
to ladies in the warm weather,
when their minds wander
right now!
scripts.translation:
[伊茲洛夫]
在溫暖的天氣裡向女士們表白最好，
因為她們的心思
現在正四處遊蕩呢！

scripts.text: It's good to have warm weather.
scripts.translation: 溫暖的天氣真好。

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
Of course.
From now on, it is my golden age of opportunity!
scripts.translation:
[伊茲洛夫]
當然。
從現在起，就是我的黃金機遇期了！

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
Of course.
The cold winter has gone.
From now on, it is my golden age!
scripts.translation:
[伊茲洛夫]
當然。
寒冷的冬天已經過去了。
從現在起，就是我的黃金時期！

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
If it is the summer all the time,
my life will be in an amorous mood.
Hahaha!
I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[伊茲洛夫]
如果永遠是夏天，
我的生活就會充滿情調。
哈哈哈！
我不希望冬天到來。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
I was once like you,
with a hot heart and cool reason,
adventuring everywhere and
coping with all the troubles...
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
我曾經也像你一樣，
熱血而理智，
四處冒險，
應對所有的麻煩...

scripts.text: You need to take a rest.
scripts.translation: 你需要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
Yes, under the warm sunlight,
I like to rest.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
是的，在溫暖的陽光下，
我喜歡休息。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
I hope that this warm weather
will last forever.
I hate the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
我希望這溫暖的天氣
能永遠持續下去。
我討厭寒冷的冬天。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
But, I am still alive!
I don't want to hear talk
like that from you.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
但是，我還活著！
我不想聽你
說那種話。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
The men here grow up
after going through tough waves in
the vast sea
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
這裡的男人們
在浩瀚的大海中
經歷風浪後成長起來

scripts.text: However, if winter comes...
scripts.translation: 不過，如果冬天來了...

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Yes, in winter the
sea is frozen, so it
is impossible to sail.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
是的，冬天大海會結冰，
所以無法航行。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Although I won't be able
to sail, my passion is not
cooled down from winter.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
雖然冬天無法航行，
但我的熱情
不會因為冬天而冷卻。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
I hope that winter never comes.
It is my dream.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
我希望冬天永遠不要來。
這是我的夢想。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Do you like
sailing?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
你喜歡
航海嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
Don't you think that the castle is magnificent?
It was built by my great great grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列爾]
你不覺得這座城堡很宏偉嗎？
它是由我的曾曾祖父建造的。

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
It is very strong and
it is warm inside of it.
I am very proud of it.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列爾]
它非常堅固，
裡面也很溫暖。
我為此感到非常自豪。

scripts.text: Is it cold much in winter?
scripts.translation: 冬天會很冷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
Yes, it is very cold.
If you didn't prepare,
it would be hard for you.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列爾]
是的，非常冷。
如果你沒有做好準備，
那會很難熬的。

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
It would be a lot better
if winter never came again.
But, design of coldness is
winter itself, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加夫列爾]
如果冬天再也不來了就好了。
但寒冷的設計，
不正是冬天本身嗎？

scripts.text: Do you like summer?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡夏天嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Ah, move a bit to the side.
a bit more... Yes.
Ah, stop there.
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
啊，稍微往旁邊挪一點。
再一點... 是的。
啊，就停在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Sure, I like the summer.
Why are you asking
such a question so suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
當然，我喜歡夏天。
你為什麼突然
問這種問題？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
I certainly like the summer.
Unless the sunlight is too strong,
it is much better than the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
我確實喜歡夏天。
只要陽光不是太強，
它比寒冷的冬天好多了。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
By the way, what is this for?
It is natural to like the summer.
Do you think
the winter should come again?
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
順便問一下，這是為了什麼？
喜歡夏天是很自然的。
你覺得
冬天應該再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
It's hard to look up at you.
Come lower so I can see your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
仰視你有點累。
下來一點，讓我看看你的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Hmm, that's better.
Children are the future.
I won't have a future if I fall
back and hurt my neck
while looking up at you.
scripts.translation:
[留裡克]
嗯，這樣好多了。
孩子是未來。
如果我仰視你時
向後摔倒傷了脖子，
我就沒有未來了。

scripts.text:
-There are ugly skulls
all over here but, 
this is the only place that I can stay.-
scripts.translation:
-這裡到處都是醜陋的頭骨，
但這是我能待的唯一地方。-

scripts.text:
-Get closer to see
more carefully.-
scripts.translation: -走近一點仔細看看。-

scripts.text: -The ugly skulls are gathered.-
scripts.translation: -醜陋的頭骨聚集在一起。-

scripts.text:
-She said that the Magic Gourd Bottle that
can hold people's speech
is around here.-
scripts.translation:
-她說能裝下人們話語的
魔法的葫蘆瓶就在附近。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is probably the only place
where the bottle is hidden,
but there are bones all over.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這大概是瓶子藏身的唯一地方，
但到處都是骨頭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, why am I here?
It would be trouble if
the dragon came back...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，我為什麼在這裡？
如果龍回來的話...
那就麻煩了...

scripts.text: Look for it.
scripts.translation: 尋找它

scripts.text: I will try next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再試

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here it is.
That was easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在這裡。
找起來還挺容易的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, I got it!
I better get out of here quickly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，拿到了！
我得趕緊離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where the hell is it?!
It has to be in here somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死，它在哪裡？！
它肯定就在某個地方！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will try later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我稍後再試。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
請稍等！！
您的物品欄已滿。
無法接收此物品。
請減輕負重後重試。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Hello, foreign traveler!
Have you had good day
in Moscovia?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你好，外來的旅行者！
在莫斯科比亞過得愉快嗎？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
A special souvenir for visiting Moscovia...?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
來莫斯科比亞遊玩的特別紀念品...？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
For you, let's make a Shafka hat.
The Shafka has practicality and
it's spruce! Do you want one?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
為了你，我們來做一頂遮耳帽吧。
遮耳帽既實用又精神！你想要一頂嗎？

scripts.text: Learn about the Shafka.
scripts.translation: 瞭解遮耳帽

scripts.text: Make a Shafka hat.
scripts.translation: 製作遮耳帽

scripts.text:
[Irina]
When I look at you, you seem to
want to put on something of a thick
fur hat on your head, out in this
temperature. A Shafka!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
看著你，似乎很想在這種氣溫下
戴一頂厚實的毛皮帽子。遮耳帽！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you've come here for the first
time, you might not know... that
winter here is famous for being so
long and cold in Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你是第一次來這裡，可能還不知道...
莫斯科比亞的冬天以漫長和寒冷而聞名。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
A Shafka hat is especially
necessary to live here during the
cold seasons. Without this hat, you
may not endure a winter!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
在寒冷的季節生活在這裡，
遮耳帽是特別必要的。沒有這頂帽子，
你可能無法熬過冬天！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Now, the long, long winter has
ended and the sun is shining... But
someday the winter will come again.
So, for preparation, you should
keep a Shafka hat handy.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
現在，漫長漫長的冬天結束了，
陽光普照...但總有一天冬天會再次來臨。
所以，為了做好準備，
你應該常備一頂遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Don't worry about keeping warm if
you're wearing a Shafka hat. Even
during the coldest weather... You
can roll around in the snow and the
Shafka still keeps you warm!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
戴著遮耳帽就不用擔心保暖了。
即使在最寒冷的天氣裡...
你可以在雪地裡打滾，
遮耳帽依然能保持溫暖！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Do you want to make a Shafka hat?
Heheh. Good idea!
That's a good task.
You will be grateful forever.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你想製作一頂遮耳帽嗎？
呵呵。好主意！
這是個不錯的任務。
你會永遠感激的。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you bring the materials,
we can make one immediately!
The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你帶來材料，
我們可以立刻製作！
材料是：^0000FF九尾狐 20, 毛線 10, 柔軟的綢緞布 10, 海獺的皮革 20, 線軸 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
You did well.
Give me the materials. I will make the Shafka.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你做得很好。
把材料給我。我來製作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Good, I made it. So, how about it?
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
很好，我做好了。那麼，感覺如何？
你喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you need a Shafka hat,
come to me whenever,
with the materials.
I will make it.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你需要遮耳帽，
隨時帶著材料來找我。
我會為你製作。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Okay?
Okay, so... Bye-bye!~
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
好嗎？
好的，那麼...再見！~

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Ah... You lack some materials. We
can't make the Shafka hat with just
these materials.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
啊...你缺少一些材料。僅憑這些材料
我們無法制作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you bring the right materials, I
will make a Shafka immediately.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你帶來正確的材料，
我會立刻為你製作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
材料是：^0000FF九尾狐 20, 毛線 10, 柔軟的綢緞布 10, 海獺的皮革 20, 線軸 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Ah, a foreigner,
you're not from
around here are you?
It's nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
啊，你是外鄉人吧？
看來你不是這裡的人。
很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Sage]
I've heard stories of the many adventurers from your lands. But, I haven't been able to talk with them much because they were always busy.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
我聽說過許多來自你們那裡的冒險者的故事。不過，因為他們總是很忙，所以我沒機會和他們多聊幾句。

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.....
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙...

scripts.text: Ok, let's talk.
scripts.translation: 好的，我們聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Ah, you are...
I just wanted to hear about news from other lands...
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
啊，你是...
我只是想聽聽其他地方的訊息...

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Sorry to bother you. You have a good trip.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
抱歉打擾你了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
I've heard that interesting creatures inhabit your lands. Could you please tell me about at least one of them?
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
我聽說你們那裡棲息著一些有趣的生物。能請你至少給我講講其中一種嗎？

scripts.text: Show him a Poring Card
scripts.translation: 給他看一張波利卡片

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a card of one of the monsters that inhabit the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是米德加爾特大陸上棲息的一種魔物的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
...?!
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
...？！
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah.. haha.. where is it?!
W, wait.. I've got one somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊..哈哈..它在哪裡？！
等，等等..我好像有一張！

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Hooh, it is.. I can't believe this is real.
Thank you for showing me this.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
哦，原來如此..真不敢相信這是真的。
謝謝你給我看這個。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
By the way, do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
順便問一下，你喜歡這個地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
現在冬天過去了，夏天即將到來，天氣很好。雖然我知道每年冬天都會回來，但我總是祈禱它不要再來了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
冬天過後，夏天的天氣讓森林變得茂密，空氣也溫暖起來。我最喜歡的季節永遠是夏天。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
但是，別忘了你還是要小心。在我們面前的森林裡，有很多冒險者迷路了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Have any of the adventurers returned?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有冒險者回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
只有一人回來了，他告訴我在一處道路分岔成三的地方有一塊神秘的石頭，觸控它的人會遭到詛咒，所以我一直避開那裡。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
不過，別擔心我。我對這裡很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
現在冬天過去了，夏天即將到來，天氣很好。雖然我知道每年冬天都會回來，但我總是祈禱它不要再來了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
冬天過後，夏天的天氣讓森林變得茂密，空氣也溫暖起來。我最喜歡的季節永遠是夏天。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
但是，別忘了你還是要小心。在我們面前的森林裡，有很多冒險者迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
只有一人回來了，他告訴我在一處道路分岔成三的地方有一塊神秘的石頭，觸控它的人會遭到詛咒，所以我一直避開那裡。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Me? Haha, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation:
[賢者]
我？哈哈，別擔心我。我對這裡很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈。

scripts.text: - The road forks here -
scripts.translation: - 道路在此分岔 -

scripts.text:
- Words are engraved -
- on the stone -
scripts.translation: - 石頭上刻著文字 -

scripts.text:
- Right path -> Drain -
- Left path -> Curse -
- Middle -> ? -
scripts.translation:
- 右路 -> 吸取 -
- 左路 -> 詛咒 -
- 中路 -> ? -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Where should I go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我該走哪條路？

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右路

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左路

scripts.text: Middle
scripts.translation: 中路

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the right...
- You decide to go to the right -
scripts.translation: - 你決定向右走 -

scripts.text:
- An unknown force has -
- drained your health -
scripts.translation:
- 一股未知的力量 -
- 吸取了你的生命值 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the left...?
- You decide to go to the left -
scripts.translation: - 你決定向左走 -

scripts.text:
- An unknown force has -
- cursed your body -
scripts.translation:
- 一股未知的力量 -
- 詛咒了你的身體 -

scripts.text: - You decide to go to the left -
scripts.translation: - 你決定向左走 -

scripts.text:
- Your trusty Pecopeco senses -
- an unknown force and tries -
- to run away!! -
scripts.translation:
- 你信任的大嘴鳥 -
- 察覺到了未知的力量 -
- 並試圖逃跑！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the middle...?

- You move forward -
- toward the middle -
scripts.translation:
- 你向中間 -
- 前進 -

scripts.text:
- Words are engraved -
- on the stone -
scripts.translation: - 石頭上刻著文字 -

scripts.text:
- Right path -> Drain -
- Left path -> Curse -
- Middle -> ? -
scripts.translation:
- 右路 -> 吸取 -
- 左路 -> 詛咒 -
- 中路 -> ? -

scripts.text:
- You carefully read the stone -
- and decide to wait -
scripts.translation:
- 你仔細閱讀石頭上的文字 -
- 並決定等待 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
... Turn back, adventurer...
This is not where you belong.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...回去吧，冒險者...
這裡不是你該來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Halt, adventurer.
Why did you disregard the warnings on the stone?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
站住，冒險者。
你為何無視石頭上的警告？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you the reason adventurers are getting lost around this forest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道你就是導致冒險者在這片森林迷路的原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
...lost around this forest.
He doesn't want anyone to wander around the forest.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...迷路在這片森林。
他不想讓任何人在這片森林徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He? Who is he?!

[Gray Wolf]
His name is Koshei, the Immortal...
and he has been freed from his captivity... You'd better leave before he finds you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
他的名字是不死者 科舍伊...
而且他已經被釋放了...你最好在他發現你之前離開。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I'm warning you again!
Unless you want to be killed, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我再警告你一次！
除非你想死，否則現在就離開。

scripts.text:
- The Gray Wolf attacks you -
- with it's claws and jumps -
- into the bushes behind you!! -
scripts.translation:
- 灰狼向你發起攻擊 -
- 它揮舞著利爪 -
- 跳進了你身後的灌木叢裡！！ -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
...Why did you come back?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...你為什麼又回來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am afraid of nothing!
I'm not afraid of your warning 'cuz I'm not as weak as you think I am!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什麼都不怕！
我不怕你的警告，因為我並不像你想像的那麼弱！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your attack from before was a cheapshot! If you have something to do with the missing people around here, you won't be forgiven!
Come on!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你剛才的攻擊是偷襲！如果你和這裡失蹤的人有關，我絕不會原諒你！
來吧！！！

scripts.text:
- You stand firm and -
- aim your weapon -
- at the Gray Wolf -
scripts.translation:
- 你堅定地站著 -
- 舉起武器 -
- 對準灰狼 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Stop it. You cannot beat me.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
住手。你打不過我的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see who's stronger?!
Take your position. I won't take you by surprise!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我們看看誰更強吧？！
擺好架勢。我不會偷襲你的！！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
......You...... Haha.....
Hahahahaha!!

[Gray Wolf]
Yes, you are very brave.
... Yes, I think that I've been waiting for someone like you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
是的，你很勇敢。
... 是的，我想我一直在等待像你這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Please accept my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
請接受我的道歉。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I need brave adventurers, like you, to help me. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我需要像你這樣勇敢的冒險者來幫我。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: No, how can I trust you?
scripts.translation: 不，我怎麼能信任你？

scripts.text: Ok, I'll help
scripts.translation: 好，我幫你

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Hu.. you won't. But, I ask you again. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
呼.. 你拒絕了我。但我再問一次。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Ok, ok. There's no way I can refuse this type of request.
So, what do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好吧，好吧。這種請求我沒法拒絕。
那麼，你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
This isn't a good place to talk. Get on my back, I will show you something.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
這裡不是說話的好地方。騎到我背上來，我帶你去看樣東西。

scripts.text:
- He turns his back to me -
- I jump up and suddenly -
scripts.translation:
- 他轉過身去 -
- 我跳上去，突然 -

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Who is there? Gray Wolf?!
Wolf, who are you with?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
誰在那裡？灰狼？！
狼，你帶著誰？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
This is an adventurer from another land. He is not afraid of Koshei. He may be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
這是一位來自異鄉的冒險者。他並不害怕科斯赫伊。也許他能幫到你。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Help me? Do you think he can stop Koshei?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
幫我？你覺得他能阻止科斯赫伊嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, hold on. Who is Koshei and who is talking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，等一下。科斯赫伊是誰？還有，是誰在說話？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Koshei.. He is an immortal and endless evil. I fought against him a long tim ago. After a fierce fight, I had to seal him in the darkness because he is immortal.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
科斯赫伊...他是永生不滅的邪惡。很久以前我曾與他戰鬥。經過一場激戰，我不得不將他封印在黑暗中，因為他是不死的。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
And as a result I became imprisoned in this wall.
He has found a way to break away from his seal and I fear for the worst.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
結果我也被囚禁在這面牆裡。
他找到了打破封印的方法，我擔心最壞的情況會發生。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
My name is Maria Morebna. Help me exterminate Koshei. I want to keep peace in Moscovia. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
我叫瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜。幫我消滅科斯赫伊。我想讓莫斯科比亞保持和平。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, I can
scripts.translation: 好，我可以

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，我該怎麼幫你？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
First, you need to find a way to get her out of there.
I've heard about a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything. There is a keymaker in town.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
首先，你需要找到把她從那裡弄出來的方法。
我聽說有一把'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'，它能開啟任何東西。鎮上有一位鎖匠。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
As you see, I look like a monster so I am not able to go there. I want you to find this keymaker and ask about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
你也看到了，我看起來像魔物，所以我無法去那裡。我想讓你去找這位鎖匠，問問關於'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'的事。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Please don't forget about me.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
請別忘了我。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Help me get out of here.
I hope you can help me find that '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
幫我把我從這裡弄出去。
我希望你能幫我找到那把能開啟任何東西的'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I've heard about a keymaker in Moscovia who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
我聽說莫斯科比亞有一位鎖匠，他知道如何製作'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Did you get the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你拿到鑰匙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I need golden thread. I heard that I was able to get it from Marozka. He....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我需要金線。我聽說可以從馬羅茲卡那裡得到。他....

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Marozka... He is the owner of winter and dwells in the deep underground. He won't let just anyone see him.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
馬羅茲卡...他是冬天的主人，居住在深深的地下。他不會讓隨便什麼人見到他。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
He has monsters that guard his underground lair. It's very dangerous. But, I know where he is.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
他有魔物守衛著地下的巢穴。那裡非常危險。但是，我知道他在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
What do you think? I can open a portal to the cave Do you want to go there now?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你覺得怎麼樣？我可以開啟一個通往洞穴的傳送門。你想現在去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text: Open the portal!
scripts.translation: 開啟傳送門！

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
... When you're ready, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
...當你準備好的時候，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
...Ok, be careful There are a lot of monsters there.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
...好的，小心點。那裡有很多魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你...拿到鑰匙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還沒有...請給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
If you gather all the necessary things, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
如果你收集齊了所有必要的東西，就去莫斯科比亞找那位鎖匠。請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你...拿到鑰匙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I collected every meterial for the key, But have not yet got the key...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我收集齊了製作鑰匙的所有材料，但還沒有拿到鑰匙...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Go to Moscovia and find the keymaker.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
去莫斯科比亞找那位鎖匠。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還沒有...請給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
If you gather all the things necessary, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
如果你收集齊了所有必要的東西，就去莫斯科比亞找那位鎖匠。請幫我這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I can feel Koshei's energy.. It is not a time to use the key...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
我能感覺到科謝伊的能量...現在不是使用鑰匙的時候...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Did you get the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你拿到鑰匙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did. So, how do I use it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做到了。那麼，我該怎麼使用它？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Listen very carefully!
Left the key up, and shout '^0000ffThe Free wind blows and gets you wherever you want^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
請仔細聽！
舉起鑰匙，然後大喊'^0000ff自由的風會把你吹向任何你想去的地方^000000'。

scripts.text:
- The key begins to glow -
- wind begins to blow -
- from somewhere -
scripts.translation:
- 鑰匙開始發光 -
- 風開始吹起 -
- 從某個地方 -

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
You must've said it wrong...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你肯定唸錯了...

scripts.text:
- The wind disappears and -
- a very young girl appears -
scripts.translation:
- 風消失了 -
- 一個非常年幼的女孩出現了 -

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Thank you!
I'm finally out of there! Now I can.....................aaaaak!!!....
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
謝謝你！
我終於出來了！現在我可以.....................啊啊啊！！！....

scripts.text:
- Maria is attacked -
- and falls down!! -
scripts.translation:
- 瑪麗亞遭到攻擊 -
- 倒下了！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Maria?! What happened?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
瑪麗亞？！發生什麼了？！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
I really want to thank you, human. Maria was imprisoned in the wall so I couldn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
我真想謝謝你，人類。瑪麗亞被囚禁在牆裡，我什麼都做不了！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
She'll thank me for giving her a quick death!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
她一定會感謝我給了她一個痛快的死法！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
But you, human... You are here to disturb me?
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
但是，人類...你是來打擾我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
No one can stop me! Now, die!!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
沒有人能阻止我！現在，去死吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Watch out!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
小心！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
Gray Wolf...
You think you can fight me?!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
灰狼...
你以為你能打敗我？！

scripts.text:
- Staggering from -
- Koshei's flames, -
- Gray Wolf quickly tell me -
scripts.translation:
- 灰狼被科舍伊的火焰 -
- 逼得踉蹌後退， -
- 它迅速對我說 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Listen, I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
聽著，如果我現在就治療她，我還能救瑪麗亞。
我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
Stop! Where do you think you're going?!!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
站住！你以為你能逃到哪裡去？！！！

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
你...拿到鑰匙了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can sense Koshei's presence.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
我能感覺到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
如果我現在就治療她，我還能救瑪麗亞。
我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Maria...
I... could do nothing...

[Gray Wolf]
No, it's not too late!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
不，還不算太晚！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
She's alive.
But, she's still unstable.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
她還活著。
但是，她的情況仍然不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她會知道該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我撐不了太久了。你必須找到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
But, she's still unstable.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
但是，她的情況仍然不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她會知道該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
我撐不了太久了。你必須找到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can sense Koshei's presence.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
我能感覺到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
如果我現在就治療她，我還能救瑪麗亞。
我會帶著她逃走，留你一個人去對付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
Did you get the 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的聲音]
你拿到“生命之水”和“死亡之水”了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've got them! How's Maria?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了！瑪麗亞怎麼樣了？！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I fear that her spirit has gone. Severe wounds and curses are hindering her spirit from coming back. But we can save her with that water.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
恐怕她的靈魂已經離開了。嚴重的傷勢和詛咒阻礙了她的靈魂迴歸。但我們可以用那些水來救她。

scripts.text: Death Water
scripts.translation: 死亡之水

scripts.text: Life Water
scripts.translation: 生命之水

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hope this works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希望這能管用...

scripts.text:
- I pour the Death Water -
- on Maria's stiff body -
scripts.translation:
- 我將死亡之水 -
- 倒在瑪麗亞僵硬的身體上 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hope this works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希望這能管用...

scripts.text:
- I pour the Life Water -
- on Maria's stiff body -
scripts.translation:
- 我將生命之水 -
- 倒在瑪麗亞僵硬的身體上 -

scripts.text: - Nothing changed -
scripts.translation: - 沒有任何變化 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huk, was this wrong...?!

[Gray Wolf]
What are you doing?! I told you we did not have much time! What are you going to do now?!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
你在幹什麼？！我告訴過我們時間不多了！你現在打算怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am so sorry. But some water is left...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
非常抱歉。但還剩下一些水...

scripts.text:
- The wounds and -
- curses on her body -
- are removed !! -
scripts.translation:
- 她身上的傷口 -
- 和詛咒 -
- 都被消除了！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok! Next...
Death Water
scripts.translation: 死亡之水

scripts.text: Life Water
scripts.translation: 生命之水

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pour the 'Death Water' again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再次倒入“死亡之水”...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...!? No, not 'Death Water'.. I should pour 'Life Water'.......

[{0}]
Hehehe, you can trust me. Next is the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呵呵呵，你可以信任我。接下來是“生命之水”。

scripts.text: - I pour 'Life Water' on Maria -
scripts.translation: - 我將“生命之水”倒在瑪麗亞身上 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, next the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，接下來是“生命之水”。

scripts.text:
- I pour the Life Water -
- on Maria's stiff body  -
scripts.translation:
- 我將生命之水 -
- 倒在瑪麗亞僵硬的身體上 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Success!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
成功了！！

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Ah, did I...?!
You saved me. I really appreicate it. Thank you for helping us fight against Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
啊，我...？！
你救了我。我非常感激。謝謝你幫助我們對抗科斯海。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
And you, Gray Wolf.. Thank you for protecting me while I was helpless.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
還有你，灰狼...謝謝你在我無助的時候保護我。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Koshei wasn't completely destroyed. But, his power has weakened, it shouldn't be hard to seal his power without me also being sealed.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
科斯海並沒有被完全消滅。但他的力量已經減弱，即使沒有我也應該不難封印他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Koshei and I are bound by magic. If one's power should be sealed, the other must be sealed as well.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
科斯海和我被魔法繫結在一起。如果一方的力量被封印，另一方也必須被封印。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
But the original seal weakened over time and Koshei was able to get out of his confinement. That is why I asked you to get me out of here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
但最初的封印隨著時間推移而減弱，科斯海得以逃脫束縛。這就是為什麼我讓你把我救出來。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
He realized that I was trying to break free and waited here for anyone who would help me. I never ever expected it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
他意識到我想掙脫束縛，便在這裡等待任何會幫助我的人。我從未想到過這一點...

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Anyway, I'm so grateful for everything you did.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
總之，我非常感激你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Please accept my poor reward, I hope that it will be of some help for such a brave adventurer. I hope that the gods will bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
請收下我微薄的獎勵，希望這對勇敢的冒險者有所幫助。願眾神保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
It's been a long time since I've felt the sunlight, fresh wind and the scent of grass. I'm so grateful.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜]
我已經很久沒有感受到陽光、清新的微風和草地的芬芳了。我非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
... Koshei is immortal and will surely appear again someday...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
...科斯海是不死的，總有一天他一定會再次出現...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
When that time comes, I will deal with him. I will use my time of waiting to train to make myself strong whenever he returns...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
當那一天來臨時，我會親自解決他。我會利用等待的時間磨練自己，變得更強，無論他何時歸來...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I'm grateful that you did your best for me and my village. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
我很感激你為了我和村莊竭盡全力。我永遠不會忘記你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Ah, Go to Baba Yaga in your free time. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
啊，有空的時候去找找芭芭雅嘎吧。她似乎有話要告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Take care of yourself. It is better for you to stay away from here because, Koshei may try to use your power as his own, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的聲音]
請保重。最好離這裡遠一點，因為科斯海可能會試圖利用你的力量為己用，呼呼。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Why are you carrying that much?
Are you training for something?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
你為什麼要帶這麼多東西？
是在為某件事做準備嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈~
天氣真好！咦？
正是野餐的好天氣。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
不過，我聽說有些人在這座村莊附近島嶼的森林裡迷路了。這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈~
天氣真好！咦？
正是野餐的好天氣。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
不過，我聽說有些人在這座村莊附近島嶼的森林裡迷路了。這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, have you heard of a keymaker who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你聽說過會製作'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'的鑰匙匠嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? Who told you about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
嗯，你是冒險者嗎？是誰告訴你'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'的事的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, in fact...

- You tell him about -
- Maria Morebna -
- and Gray Wolf -
scripts.translation:
- 告訴他關於 -
- 瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜 -
- 和灰狼的事 -

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, then... The keymaker for the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
You are very lucky to have asked me about this.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
那麼...關於'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'的鑰匙匠。
你能問到我，真是運氣好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, what do you mean...?

[The Blacksmith]
I'm the only one in this town that knows what materials are needed to make the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'! Bahaha!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
我是這個鎮上唯一知道製作'^0000ff黃金色鑰匙^000000'需要哪些材料的人！巴哈哈！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I guess you think that getting the materials will be easy huh?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
我想你大概覺得收集材料很容易吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey I didn't say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，我可沒這麼說...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahahaha~
It will take a lot of work.
A long journey awaits you
If you choose to take it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈哈~
這需要付出很多努力。
如果你選擇接受，
前方將是一段漫長的旅程。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Your boots will be worn
out after this journey.
What do you think?
Would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
你的靴子會在旅途中磨破。
你覺得怎麼樣？
想試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course! I have to help Maria!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然！我必須幫助瑪麗亞！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha! I like you!
Ok, first, bring me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000. I'm not going anywhere so come back here when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈！我喜歡你！
好，首先，給我帶^0000ff25個鋼鐵^000000來。我就在這裡，拿到後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok so that's the first thing you need for the 'Golden Key' right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，所以這是製作“黃金色鑰匙”需要的第一個材料，對吧？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahahaha~
I promise you, I'll explain when you bring the ^0000ff25 Steel^000000 to me. Please just get the Steel and come back.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈哈~
我向你保證，等你把^0000ff25個鋼鐵^000000帶給我時，我會解釋的。請先把鋼鐵找來再回來。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ohhh, that was faster than I expected!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
哦，比我預想的還要快！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok then, wait here.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
那麼，在這裡等一下。

scripts.text:
- He melts the steel -
- and begins to forge -
- it into something !! -
scripts.translation:
- 他熔化了鋼鐵 -
- 並開始鍛造 -
- 成某種東西！！ -

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~, it's not my
best work, but it'll do.
Here ya go!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈~，雖然不是我的得意之作，但夠用了。
給你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah?! This is?!!

[The Blacksmith]
Strong Steel Boots!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
強力鋼鐵靴！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~ Didn't I tell you? A long journey awaits you. These boots will help you on your long journey.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈~ 我沒告訴過你嗎？前方將是一段漫長的旅程。這雙靴子會在旅途中幫到你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
When they have worn out, you will know that your journey is near it's end.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
當它們磨破時，你就知道旅程即將結束了。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
^ff0000You must always wear these boots while gathering the materials for the 'Golden Key'.^000000
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
^ff0000在收集製作“黃金色鑰匙”的材料時，你必須一直穿著這雙靴子。^000000

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok, I'll tell you what materials you need to get. I can make the key anytime if you get them to me.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
好，我會告訴你需要哪些材料。只要你把它們帶給我，我隨時可以打造鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
製作鑰匙需要^0000ff2 1個詛咒紅寶石、3個黃金、1個紅戒指、2束盧莎卡的頭髮、10根金線^000000。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
Bahahaha~
And don't forget to wear these!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
好了，你知道該做什麼了。我會在這裡等你。
巴哈哈哈~
別忘了穿上這雙靴子！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
What are you doing? First, you must get me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
你在做什麼？首先，你必須給我帶^0000ff25個鋼鐵^000000來。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The faster you get me the materials, The faster you can help Maria Morebna.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
你越快給我材料，就能越快幫助瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
So, you got all the materials. I can't believe it.
You did your best until your boots were worn out, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
所以，你集齊了所有材料。真不敢相信。
你一直努力到靴子磨破為止，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, you know, it's not very comfortable walking around in Steel boots all day!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你知道的，整天穿著鋼鐵靴子走路並不舒服！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~ Ok, well done.
Well.. While you were looking for the materials, I was searching for the keymaker who can make the key!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴哈哈~ 好，幹得不錯。
嗯... 在你尋找材料的時候，我也在尋找能打造這把鑰匙的鑰匙匠！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought you said that you knew how to make the key?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不是說你知道怎麼打造這把鑰匙嗎？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Hmm... Well I know the materials. And I know who makes the key. So I will tell you where to find the keymaker. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
嗯... 好吧，我知道材料。我也知道誰打造這把鑰匙。所以我會告訴你去哪裡找鑰匙匠。這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course! I have to know where this person is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然！我必須知道這個人在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok, listen carefully. The Keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
好，仔細聽。鑰匙匠在普勒斯特森林深處的一個小屋裡。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, wait. Take off your armor. I need to cast a protection spell on you, ok? Hey, don't get the wrong idea. This is just a simple protection spell!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
啊，等等。脫下你的盔甲。我需要給你施加一個保護咒語，好嗎？嘿，別想歪了。這只是一個簡單的保護咒語！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bah ram y--- wait that's uh something else...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
巴...拉姆... 等等，這...這是另一回事...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
'^ff0000Spellshield Protection^000000.

[The Blacksmith]
This spell protects you from any curse the keymaker might try to use. Remember the words of the spell. It won't last very long because I am just a blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
這個咒語可以保護你免受鑰匙匠可能使用的任何詛咒。記住咒語的內容。它不會持續太久，因為我只是個鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah, and your steel boots..?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
森林很危險。在裡面一定要非常小心！
啊，還有你的鋼鐵靴子...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah and you shouldn't be needing those Steel Boots anymore. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
森林很危險。在裡面一定要非常小心！
啊，而且你不再需要那些鋼鐵靴子了。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
它們在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
製作鑰匙需要^0000ff2 1個詛咒紅寶石、3個黃金、1個紅戒指、2束盧莎卡的頭髮、10根金線^000000。

scripts.text: Red Ring?
scripts.translation: 紅戒指

scripts.text: Lusalka's Hair?
scripts.translation: 盧薩爾卡的頭髮

scripts.text: Golden Thread?
scripts.translation: 金線

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The Red Ring has powerful enchanting powers. I had one before, but I gave it to my friend, Vassili, as a gift.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
紅戒指擁有強大的附魔力量。我以前有一個，但我把它作為禮物送給了我的朋友瓦西里。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I think it would be odd to ask him to give it back to me. So uh you've got to ask him if he would give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
我覺得讓他把它還給我有點奇怪。所以呃，你得問問他是否願意把它給你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
It's said that a bride who drowns to death just before her wedding becomes Lusalka, the aqua fairy.
You must find Lusalka's hair.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
據說在婚禮前溺水而死的未婚妻會變成盧薩爾卡，水之妖精。
你必須找到盧薩爾卡的頭髮。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I heard that a young maid has been lost recently.
It's very unfortunate but...
she might be Lusalka...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
我聽說最近有個年輕的女僕失蹤了。
這很不幸，但是...
她可能就是盧薩爾卡...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Her mother is somewhere in this village asking for people to help her find her missing daughter.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
她的母親在這個村莊的某個地方，正在請求人們幫她尋找失蹤的女兒。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Golden Thread is made from gold by using a special spinning wheel technique. I don't know exactly how it's done. But I know who does.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
金線是用特殊的紡紗技術從黃金中製成的。我不太清楚具體怎麼做。但我知道誰懂。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Find a man named Marozka. He is the only one who knows how to use the spinning wheel to make the Golden Thread.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
去找一個叫馬羅茲卡的男子。他是唯一知道如何用紡紗機制作金線的人。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Maria should know where he is.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
瑪麗亞應該知道他在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, and... You still have the boots that I made right? ^ff0000Without them, you cannot get anything for the key, I swear. You must put on them.^000000
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
啊，對了...你身上還穿著我做的靴子吧？^ff0000沒有它們，你絕對拿不到鑰匙，我發誓。你必須穿上它們。^000000

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
好了，你知道該怎麼做。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
鑰匙匠人在森林深處的一個小屋。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
This person is no ordinary person. It is said that you can be cursed by the keymaker's words.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
這個人不是普通人。據說你會被鑰匙匠人的話語詛咒。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Don't forget the spell, '^ff0000Spellshield Protection.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
別忘了咒語，'^ff0000魔法盾。^000000'

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
He is in his cabin deep inside of the forest. There, the keymaker of the Golden Key is living.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
他在森林深處的小屋裡。那裡住著黃金色鑰匙的鑰匙匠人。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The Golden Key is able to release Maria. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
黃金色鑰匙可以釋放瑪麗亞。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I heard the news. You have done well.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
我聽到訊息了。你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, the person living around that cabin wants you to see her. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠]
啊，住在那附近小屋的人想見你。她似乎有話要告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Why are you carring that much?
Are you training for something?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
你為什麼背了這麼多東西？
是在訓練什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
嗯，你是冒險者嗎？那麼，你覺得這裡怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not too bad.
The weather here is great!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還不錯。
這裡的天氣很棒！

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Even though it is fine now in Moscovia, it is not such a great place during the harsh winter season.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
雖然莫斯科比亞現在很美好，但在寒冷的冬季，這裡並不是個很好的地方。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Eeee, I don't want to experience that coldness any more.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
唉，我再也不想經歷那種寒冷了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
嗯，你是冒險者嗎？那麼，你覺得這裡怎麼樣？

scripts.text: It's so-so
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text: I have something to ask...
scripts.translation: 我有事想問...

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, you have traveled so much. I guess if you're tired from your trip then it's only natural, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
嗯，你走了很多路。我想如果你旅途勞累，那也是很自然的，呼呼。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Eh? What do you want to ask me about?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
咦？你想問我什麼？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Red Ring?! Why are you looking for that?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
紅戒指？！你為什麼要找那個？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Mmm, what? I don't understand you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
嗯？什麼？我不明白你的意思。

scripts.text:
- You tell him about the -
- Gray Wolf and Maria -
scripts.translation:
- 你告訴他關於 -
- 灰狼和瑪麗亞的事 -

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Huuuh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
呼...原來如此。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
What should I do?
I want to help but I can't.
I gave it to my youngest
daughter, Mashenka,
as a present. But... she...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
我該怎麼辦？
我想幫忙，但我無能為力。
我把它作為禮物送給了我的小女兒，瑪申卡。但是...她...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
It's just that Mashenka...
..........
....she died...

[Vassili Grandpapa]
She was really pretty and smart. My first daughter, Ryubaba, is also pretty and smart but her temper is...
hotter than Ifrit's flames!
Do you know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
她非常漂亮，也很聰明。我的大女兒，柳芭芭，也很漂亮聰明，但她的脾氣...
比伊夫利特的火焰還要火爆！
你明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Anyway, Mashenka was such a kind and tender daughter. On cold winter nights, when I came back home late, she would wait for me with a hot bowl of my favorite stew.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
總之，瑪申卡是個非常溫柔體貼的女兒。在寒冷的冬夜，當我深夜回家時，她總會為我留著一碗熱騰騰的我最愛喝的湯。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
How couldn't I be touched by such kindness? So, I gave the Red Ring to her as a gift.
I can still remember how happy she was when I gave it to her.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
面對這樣的善意，我怎能不感動？所以，我把紅戒指作為禮物送給了她。
我至今還記得，當我把戒指給她時，她是多麼開心。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
She disappeared soon... after Now all I have is Ryubaba. She is also pretty and smart but nothing can relieve the sadnesss in my heart from losing Mashenka...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
她很快就消失了...現在我只剩下柳芭芭了。她也很漂亮聰明，但失去瑪申卡的悲傷，沒有任何東西能緩解...

scripts.text:

I can still remember how happy she was when I gave it to her.
scripts.translation:

我至今還記得，當我把戒指給她時，她是多麼開心。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Ehh? you are the adventurer that I met before. Something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
咦？你是之前見過的那個冒險者。有什麼事要告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

...W, what is this? Ehh??
My daughter, Mashenka, was.. by Ryubaba...!?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
...哇，這是什麼？咦？！
我的女兒，瑪申卡，是被...柳芭芭...殺死的！？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
No... this isn't true?
Don't try to trick me... Why are you telling... That flute is... Mashenka...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
不...這不是真的？
別想騙我...你為什麼要說...那支長笛是...瑪申卡的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't this.. isn't this Mashenka's voice?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...這不是瑪申卡的聲音嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Don't tell me those lies about..!! My daughters... That...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
別跟我說那些謊話...！！我的女兒們...那個...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Uh... I'm so sorry...

[Vassili Grandpapa]
... Can you please... play the flute again?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
...能請你...再吹一次長笛嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
It is.. It is true...
When I saw this ring in Ryubaba's room, I never thought that. But, it has to be true...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
這是...這是真的...
當我在柳芭芭的房間看到這枚戒指時，我從未想過會是那樣。但這一定是真的...

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Damn this cursed ring!!! Why did my daughters have this tragedy....? ~Sob!
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
該死的詛咒戒指！！！為什麼我的女兒們會遭遇這樣的悲劇....？~嗚咽！

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
........i'm sorry. ...I know that this wasn't easy for you to tell me. Thank you for the truth.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
........對不起。...我知道告訴你這些並不容易。謝謝你告訴我真相。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
You said you needed this ring, right? Take it...
It has brought me nothing but grief.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
你說你需要這枚戒指，對吧？拿去吧...
它只給我帶來了悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
...It is my fault that this tragedy between my daughters happened. I will spend the rest of my life trying to make up for it...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
...是我導致了女兒們之間的這場悲劇。我會用餘生來彌補...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ehh?! This is weird. Where is the flute?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？！這不對勁。長笛在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
You may think it is foolish but I cannot relieve the sadness of my lost daughter.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
你可能覺得這很愚蠢，但我無法消除失去女兒的悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
It is parents that wander around the entrance of the village to wait for their children...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爺爺]
...是父母在村口徘徊，等待他們的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]

scripts.text:
[Ryubaba]
What on earth do you have in your bag?
Are you training for something?
scripts.translation:
[柳芭芭]
你包裡到底裝了什麼？
你在練習什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ryubaba]
Ah, how beautiful I am.
scripts.translation:
[柳芭芭]
啊，我真美。

scripts.text:
[Ryubaba]
Mmm, you must be an adventurer? What would you say? Have you seen somebody more beautiful than me? I doubt it. How can you find anyone more beautiful than me?
scripts.translation:

嗯，你一定是個冒險者吧？你覺得呢？你見過比我更美的人嗎？我懷疑。你怎麼可能找到比我更美的人呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Besides, if there was a most beautiful girl in the world it would be me, me, me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Ryubaba]

I hate you! Get out of my face!

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

I hate you! Get out of my face!

scripts.text:
[Ryubaba]
Ah, that ring... Yes, my father gave it to my baby sister, Mashenka.
But, she went out to take a stroll and disappeared around the marsh.
scripts.translation:

但是，她出去散步，在沼澤附近失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, your father told me that she died!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

Give me that flute!

我笛子吹得可好了！如果你給我足夠的尖尖的樹枝，我會用它們做一支笛子，為你演奏美妙的音樂。拜託啦~！

scripts.text:
[Shepherdess]
I will never play a flute made from the Pointed Branches around the marsh ever again!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊女]
我再也不會吹用沼澤地附近的尖尖的樹枝做的笛子了！

scripts.text:
[Shepherdess]
Haaaa, boring, boring! Herding sheep is really boring!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊女]
哈啊，好無聊，好無聊！放羊真的超級無聊！

scripts.text:
[Shepherdess]
I wish that I could listen to music all the time.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊女]
我真希望能一直聽音樂。

scripts.text:
- I avoid the thorns and -
- cut off a branch!! -
scripts.translation:
- 我避開荊棘 -
- 砍下了一根樹枝！！ -

scripts.text: - My hand is pricked by thorns! -
scripts.translation: - 我的手被荊棘刺到了！ -

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Where is she...
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
她在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Have you heard of the bridge who drowned to death just before her wedding and became Lusalka, an aqua nymph?
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
你聽說過那個在婚禮前溺水身亡，變成了水之精靈盧薩爾卡的新娘嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
My daughter disappeared some days ago and now i'm really worried. I hope nothing happened to her...
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
我的女兒幾天前失蹤了，我現在真的很擔心。希望她沒事...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Where is she...
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
她在哪裡...

scripts.text:

Have you heard of the bridge who drowned to death just before her wedding and became Lusalka, an aqua nymph?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
My daughter disappeared some days ago and now i'm really worried. I hope nothing happened to her...
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
我的女兒幾天前失蹤了，我現在真的很擔心。希望她沒事...

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Did you go to the marsh in the Moscovia field? Did you see my daughter? I don't care even if she became Lusalka. I just want to know where she is.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
你去過莫斯科比亞野外的沼澤地嗎？你看到我的女兒了嗎？就算她變成了盧薩爾卡我也無所謂。我只想知道她在哪裡。

scripts.text: Calm her down.
scripts.translation: 安撫她

scripts.text: I will find her.
scripts.translation: 我會找到她的

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She should be ok.
She will be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她應該沒事的。
她很快就會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Will she? I really hope so.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
是嗎？我真的希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Ah, will you?
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
啊，你會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
I tried to find her but, I couldn't approach the marsh due to all of the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
我試著去找她，但因為到處都是魔物，我根本無法靠近沼澤地。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Please, please find my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
拜託了，請找到我的女兒。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Ah, there are some things that you have to know.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
啊，有些事情你需要知道。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
If my daughter has became the water nymph Lusalka you need to listen to what I know about her.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
如果我的女兒變成了水之精靈盧薩爾卡，你需要聽聽我所知道關於她的事情。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Lusalka is a good aqua nymph but is not completely harmless. Her stare will seriously hurt anyone who makes eye contact with her.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
盧薩爾卡是個善良的水之精靈，但並非完全無害。她的凝視會嚴重傷害任何與她對視的人。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
You must have something to protect yourself from Lusalka. '^0000ffHoly Water^000000' will protect you from Lusalka'a gaze.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
你必須準備一些東西來保護自己免受盧薩爾卡的傷害。'^0000ff聖水^000000'可以保護你免受盧薩爾卡凝視的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
And Lusalka is nocturnal. You should be able to find her from ^ff00005 pm to 6 am PST^000000.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
而且盧薩爾卡是夜行性的。你應該能在^ff0000下午5點到凌晨6點^000000之間找到她。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
Don't forget. You have to bring '^0000ffHoly Water^000000' with you, and find her from ^ff00005 pm to 6 am PST^000000.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
別忘了。你必須帶上'^0000ff聖水^000000'，並在^ff0000下午5點到凌晨6點^000000之間找到她。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
I'm not sure where she would be but it has to be somewhere near water. Please, find where my daughter is. I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
我不確定她會在哪裡，但肯定是在水邊附近。拜託了，找到我的女兒在哪裡。我求求你了。

scripts.translation:

我不確定她會在哪裡，但肯定是在水邊附近。拜託了，找到我的女兒在哪裡。我求求你了。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
I am able to do nothing recently.
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
最近我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Worried Mother]
It seems that I lost something, but I don't know what it is...
scripts.translation:
[憂心的母親]
我好像丟了什麼東西，但我不知道是什麼...

scripts.text:
WARNING !! 
No Swimming
scripts.translation:
警告！！
禁止游泳

scripts.text: - Splash !! -

- You hear a splashing sound -
- and see something gleaming -
scripts.translation:
- 你聽到水花聲 -
- 並看到有什麼東西在閃閃發光 -

scripts.text:
- You hear a splashing as -
- something gleaming -
- seems to stare at you!! -
scripts.translation:
- 你聽到水花聲 -
- 那閃閃發光的東西 -
- 似乎正盯著你！！ -

scripts.text:
[Lusalka's Voice]
His name is 'Igor'.. He has gone to the capital of Rune-Midgarts. Give him my golden earrings.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡的聲音]
他的名字叫“伊戈爾”...他去了盧恩·米德加茲的首都。請把我的鍍金項鍊交給他。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka's Voice]
And please, tell him to stop suffering and to be happy. This is my request.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡的聲音]
還有，請告訴他不要再受苦了，要幸福地生活。這是我的請求。

scripts.text: - Splash !! -
-You hear splashing sound and see something gleaming-
scripts.translation: - 你聽到水花聲，並看到有什麼東西在閃閃發光 -

scripts.text: -You seem to hear the splash but something gleaming raids on you!!-
scripts.translation: - 你似乎聽到了水花聲，但那個閃閃發光的東西向你襲來！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What was that?!
Why am I here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什麼？！
我為什麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
- After standing up, you see -
- the wet hair in front of you -
scripts.translation:
- 你站起身來，看到 -
- 面前有一縷溼漉漉的頭髮 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...This.. is Lusalka's hair?
Ah, right.. I came here to get her hair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...這是...盧薩爾卡的頭髮？
啊，對了...我來這裡是為了取她的頭髮。

scripts.text: - You pick up the hair -
scripts.translation: - 你撿起了那縷頭髮 -

scripts.text:
- As soon as you touch the -
- cool damp hair, you seem -
- the feel the sadness within -
scripts.translation:
- 當你觸碰到那 -
- 冰涼潮溼的頭髮時，你似乎 -
- 感受到了其中的悲傷 -

scripts.text:
- You feel that someone -
- is watching you -
scripts.translation:
- 你感覺到有人 -
- 正在注視著你 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who's there? Anybody here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
誰在那裡？有人嗎？

scripts.text:
- The splashing sound -
- fades away, but you -
- still feel the sadness -
scripts.translation:
- 水花聲漸漸 -
- 消失了，但你 -
- 依然能感受到那份悲傷 -

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...Your alive...
My stare didn't...
What are you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
...你還活著...
我的凝視沒有...
你為什麼會在這裡...？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...Your alive...
My stare didn't...
What are you doing here...?
scripts.translation:

我的凝視沒有...
你為什麼會在這裡...？

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
...Your alive...
My stare didn't...
What are you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
...你還活著...
我的凝視沒有...
你為什麼會在這裡...？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Nighttime for the aqua nymph.
Haven't you heard that Lusalka's stare can kill people. If you didn't have the 'Holy Water', you would surely have died.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
對於水之精靈來說，這是夜晚。
你沒聽說過盧薩爾卡的凝視能致人死地嗎。如果你沒有帶“聖水”，你肯定已經死了。

scripts.text: I am an adventurer and...
scripts.translation: 我是一名冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...An adventurer...?
If so, you came here from another continent, not Moscovia...?
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
...冒險者...？
如果是這樣，你是從其他大陸來的，而不是莫斯科比亞...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm from Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來自盧恩·米德加茲。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...Rune... Midgarts...
A few days ago, my lover left for Rune-Midgarts.. Can you find him for me? I want to talk with him...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
...盧恩...米德加茲...
幾天前，我的愛人去了盧恩·米德加茲。你能幫我找到他嗎？我想和他談談...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...I don't know why but, I can't remember how I became Lusalka. When I woke up, I was lying down on the bottom of the river.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
...我不知道為什麼，但我記不起我是怎麼變成盧薩爾卡的。當我醒來時，我正躺在河底。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I forgot everything, but not him. His smile and warm hand. I remember everything about him.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
我忘記了一切，除了他。他的笑容和溫暖的手。關於他的一切我都記得。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I watched him from the bottom of the river sitting randomly around the river and staring into the marsh. With very sad eyes.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
我從河底看著他，隨意地坐在河邊，凝視著沼澤。他的眼神非常悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I suffered seeing him grieve, but wasn't able to meet him. Ordinary people are killed immediately when they see Lusalka's stare...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
看著他悲傷讓我很痛苦，但我無法與他相見。普通人看到盧薩爾卡的凝視會立刻死去...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I saw him coming to the marsh everyday and heard him mourning. And his assurance to go to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
我看到他每天都來到沼澤，聽到他哀悼。還有他要去盧恩·米德加茲的決心。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Adventurer, can you find him for me? I can't leave this marsh. Please, find him for me?
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
冒險者，你能幫我找到他嗎？我無法離開這片沼澤。求你了，幫我找到他？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I don't want him to come back or to meet me again. But, Please tell him that I hope he'll stop suffering and to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
我不希望他回來，也不希望再見到我。但是，請告訴他，我希望他停止痛苦，幸福地生活。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I became Lusalka, but it is ok. I'm not sad. But, I can feel his sadness around this river that surrounds me. I feel sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
我變成了盧薩爾卡，但這沒關係。我不悲傷。但我能感覺到圍繞著我的這條河流中，他的悲傷。這讓我感到難過。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Please, find him and tell him that I am ok and to stop suffering...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
請找到他，告訴他我很好，讓他停止痛苦...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我能在哪裡找到他？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
The night when he left, he said that he would go to the capital of Rune-Midgarts. I am not sure if he is still there...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
他離開的那個夜晚，他說他會去盧恩·米德加茲的首都。我不確定他是否還在那裡...

scripts.text: Ok, I will do it
scripts.translation: 好的，我會去做的

scripts.text: I don't think I can do it...
scripts.translation: 我覺得我做不到...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rune-Midgarts is large! I don't think I can do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
盧恩·米德加茲很大！我覺得我做不到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing we can do. Just give it up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們無能為力。放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Ah... but...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
啊...但是...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Ah! Thank you so much! His name is '^0000ffIgor^000000'. Ah, give these earrings to him. He gave them to me as a present.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
啊！非常感謝！他的名字是'^0000ff伊戈爾^000000'。啊，把這些耳環給他。這是他送給我的禮物。

scripts.text:
- ^0000ffI receive the^000000 -
- ^0000ffgolden earrings^000000 -
- ^0000fffrom Lusalka!^000000 -

[Lusalka]
His name is 'Igor'.. He has gone to the capital of Rune-Midgarts. Give him my golden earrings.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
他的名字是“伊戈爾”。他去了盧恩·米德加茲的首都。請把我的鍍金項鍊交給他。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
And please, tell him to stop suffering and to be happy. This is my request.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
還有，拜託告訴他，不要再痛苦了，要幸福起來。這是我的請求。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Have you seen him? How was he?
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
你見到他了嗎？他過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a message from Igor.
He said that he remembers every moment with you and still loves you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是伊戈爾的信。
他說他記得和你在一起的每一刻，並且依然愛著你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And he would come back to Moscovia until the full moon and wanted you to meet him. He told me that he will be strong enough not to make you suffer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說他會在滿月時回到莫斯科比亞，想見你一面。他告訴我，他會變得足夠強大，不再讓你受苦。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Igor...
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
伊戈爾...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Thank you very much. I really appreciate it.
How can I thank you? Let me know what I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
非常感謝。我真的感激不盡。
我該怎麼報答你呢？請告訴我，我能為你做些什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I ask a favor of you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我能請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
If I can, I will do it.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
如果我能做到，我會做的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If so!!
....I need some of your hair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果是這樣！！
....我需要你的一些頭髮。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...Eh, hair? Is that all?
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
...誒，頭髮？就這些嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually it's not all.
I need 2 lockes!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實不止這些。
我需要兩束！

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Ah, hahaha.
Is that what you wanted? Huhu, sure take what you want.
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
啊，哈哈哈。
原來你想要這個？呼呼，好吧，拿去吧。

scripts.text:
- Lusalka cuts some -
- of her hair with her -
- sharp nails -
scripts.translation:
- 盧薩爾卡用她 -
- 鋒利的指甲剪下 -
- 一些頭髮 -

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Here, my hair...?!
Aaaaaaaah!??!?!
scripts.translation:
[盧薩爾卡]
給你，我的頭髮...？！
啊啊啊啊啊！？！？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, what was that!?
Who's there?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，那是什麼！？
誰在那裡？！

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
Don't think that you've succeeded in keeping me sealed in this prison you fool!
You will never stop me!!!
hahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
別以為你把我封印在這個牢籠裡就成功了，你這個蠢貨！
你永遠也阻止不了我！！！
哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text:
[A Wanderer from a strange land]
Hey, there are so many adventurers around here. I can see why this is the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[來自異鄉的漂泊者]
嘿，這裡有很多冒險者。難怪這裡是盧恩·米德加茲王國的首都！

scripts.text:
[A Wanderer from a strange land]
In your free time, come to see me! The weather here is even more favorable than our the best summer back home.
scripts.translation:
[來自異鄉的漂泊者]
有空的時候來看看我吧！這裡的天氣甚至比我們家鄉最好的夏天還要宜人。

Hmm, no.
I have never heard that name.
scripts.translation:

嗯，沒有。
我從未聽說過這個名字。

scripts.text:

Hmm, no. But, that name is familiar.
scripts.translation:
[來自異鄉的漂泊者]
嗯，沒有。不過，這個名字聽起來很熟悉。

scripts.text:
[A Wanderer from a strange land]
Ah, oh yes! How could I forget?
scripts.translation:
[來自異鄉的漂泊者]
啊，對了！我怎麼忘了？

scripts.text:
[A Wanderer from a strange land]
We came here from Moscovia together. He called himself Igg. I came here with him but parted with him quite a while ago. He was sad because he couldn't forget about his lost lover.
scripts.translation:
[來自異鄉的漂泊者]
我們是從莫斯科比亞一起過來的。他自稱伊格。我和他一起來到這裡，但很久以前就分開了。他很傷心，因為他無法忘記他失去的愛人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, yes that must be Igor.
I am looking for him!
Do you know where he is now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，是的，那一定是伊戈爾。
我正在找他！
你知道他現在在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:

Hmm, I don't know
exactly where he is.

me that he wanted
to travel to a desert.

嗯，我不知道
他具體在哪裡。

scripts.text:

Let me know somewhere.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
Huh, more and more adventurers are settling here recently, so it's hard to tell who is a villager or an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
嗯，最近越來越多的冒險者定居在這裡，很難分辨誰是村民，誰是冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
But natives, like me, can tell the difference.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
但像我這樣的原住民，能看出區別。

As I was saying, I like this village. The desert is hot and Kafra staff is even hotter!!! *hack* *cough*!!
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
正如我剛才說的，我很喜歡這個村莊。沙漠很熱，卡普拉的職員們更熱！！！*咳* *咳*！！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
Ah, but don't get me wrong! I'm not coughing because of the Kafra Staffers. It's uhh the heat, it's getting to me... ya...
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
啊，別誤會！我咳嗽不是因為卡普拉的職員。是...是天氣太熱了，有點受不了...咳...

................................
The hell you talking about..? I'm looking for someone.

[Morocc Villager]
I see so many adventurers around here, how can I remember everybody? Got any descriptions of this someone..? Or traits..? anything to help me remember.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
這裡到處都是冒險者，我怎麼可能記得住每個人？你有那個人的描述嗎...？或者特徵...？任何能幫我想起來的線索。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... I don't know how he looks like but he is from a land called Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我不記得他長什麼樣，但他來自一個叫莫斯科比亞的地方。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
Ah, are you talking about a guy that's always sad and dresses funny? I figured his accent wasn't from around here...
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
啊，你說的是那個總是很悲傷、穿著很奇怪的人嗎？我早就覺得他的口音不像本地人...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
He was here a coupla days ago but he left to see the Pyramid. I never saw him after that. I said it would be dangerous but he went anyways.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
他幾天前在這裡，但後來去金字塔了。從那以後我就沒見過他。我說過那裡很危險，但他還是去了。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
Yep that's gotta be who you're looking for. I can see his gloomy face right now... that poor sad man.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
沒錯，那肯定就是你要找的人。我現在還能看到他那張陰鬱的臉...那個可憐又悲傷的男人。
