scripts.text:
[Morocc Villager]
Many travellers in the village and I feel fun to see them. Even though I am here, I feel like that I travel all around the world?
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克村民]
村裡有很多旅行者，看到他們我覺得很有趣。雖然我一直待在這裡，卻感覺像是環遊了全世界？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
............................

[A gloomy looking soldier]
............................

[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
............................

[A gloomy looking soldier]
...I don't know who you are. Just get outta my face. I don't want to talk...
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
...我不知道你是誰。從我面前滾開。我不想說話...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's pretty dangerous here. There are fierce monsters all over the place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡很危險。到處都是兇猛的魔物。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
... Good. Let them come. I want to die here alone.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
...很好。讓它們來吧。我想在這裡孤獨地死去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A-Are you Igor? What're you talking about? Have you gone nuts?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你是伊戈爾嗎？你在說什麼？你瘋了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you have any idea how much your lover is suffering?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道你的愛人正在承受多大的痛苦嗎？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
My... lover...?
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
我的...愛人...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought a message from her. She says not to suffer anymore and to just be happy...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我帶來了她的信。她說不要再受苦了，只要快樂就好...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The more you suffer, the deeper she sinks into sadness. Don't think that you're the only one that's suffering...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你越痛苦，她就陷得越深。別以為只有你一個人在受苦...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
...Svetlana?!
Wait, how could you...? She... how do I know that she really spoke to you?!
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
...斯維特蘭娜？！
等等，你怎麼會...？她...我怎麼知道她真的跟你說過話？！

scripts.text:
-^0000ff Without a word, ^000000-
-^0000ff you give him Lusalka's ^000000-
-^0000ff golden earrings ^000000-

[A gloomy looking soldier]
T, this is Svetlana's...?!
H, how did you!?
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
這...這是斯維特蘭娜的...？！
你...你怎麼會有這個？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met her by accident. She became Lusalka in the marsh of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我偶然遇見了她。她在莫斯科比亞的沼澤裡變成了盧薩爾卡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She told me that you wouldn't believe me so she gave me these earrings as proof... The present that you gave to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她說你不會相信我，所以給了我這對耳環作為證明...那是你送給她的禮物。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Is that true?
Did she really become Lusalka?
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
這是真的嗎？
她真的變成了盧薩爾卡？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
It was near the end of the harsh Moscovia winter... She... didn't realize that the ice on the marsh was already melting...
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
那是莫斯科比亞嚴冬的末尾...她...沒有意識到沼澤上的冰已經開始融化了...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
By then, it was too late the ice cracked where she was and she fell into the freezing cold marsh.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
等到發現時已經太遲了，她腳下的冰裂開了，她掉進了冰冷刺骨的沼澤裡。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
She wasn't able to swim. I tried to get her out but it was impossible.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
她不會游泳。我試圖把她拉上來，但根本做不到。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
She sunk quickly into the marsh. I was able to reach her hand but, she realized that it would kill both of us and she released my hand... I regret that moment every single day.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
她迅速沉入了沼澤。我抓住了她的手，但她意識到這樣會害死我們兩個人，於是鬆開了手...我每天都在為那一刻感到後悔。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
My last memory of her was of her smiling, as she sunk into the cold, wet marsh. As if to say, 'You will be ok.'
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
我對她最後的記憶，是她微笑著沉入冰冷潮溼的沼澤。彷彿在說：'你會沒事的。'

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
I, I was a coward. I was too afraid of drowning to pull her out of the marsh. Too afraid of....
Oh... Svetlana!!!
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
我...我是個懦夫。我太害怕溺水了，不敢把她從沼澤里拉上來。太害怕...了...
噢...斯維特蘭娜！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
I knew that she had become the cursed nymph Lusalka. But, I still went every night... to find her. I just wanted to see her and talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
我知道她變成了被詛咒的精靈盧薩爾卡。但我還是每晚都去...尋找她。我只是想看看她，和她說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She told me that she also wanted to see you. But, she was afraid that Lusalka's curse would kill you if you saw her.
And so she hid...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她說她也想見你。但她害怕盧薩爾卡的詛咒會在你看到她時奪走你的性命。
所以她躲起來了...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
How could she think of me...
...I, how should I.. Should I...
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
她怎麼能這樣想我...
...我，我該怎麼辦...我應該...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't be sad. She still loves you. Your suffering is her suffering.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別難過。她依然愛著你。你的痛苦就是她的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
................................................She is? Thank you. You've encouraged me.

[A gloomy looking soldier]
I will go back to Moscovia. But, I'm not well enough at the moment to go back.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
我會回到莫斯科比亞的。但我現在的狀態還不夠好，無法立刻回去。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
請你去見她，把我的話告訴她好嗎？
我記得和她在一起的每一個瞬間...我依然愛著她。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
在滿月之前，我會回到莫斯科比亞見她。我會變得足夠強大和快樂，這樣當我去見她時，她就不會再受苦了。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
請你去見她，把我的話告訴她好嗎？
我記得和她在一起的每一個瞬間...我依然愛著她。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
在滿月之前，我會回到莫斯科比亞見她。我會變得足夠強大和快樂，這樣當我去見她時，她就不會再受苦了。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
... I feel like I lost something precious.
scripts.translation:
[神情陰鬱計程車兵]
...我感覺自己失去了什麼珍貴的東西。

scripts.text: - He looks down at the golden earrings and rubs it carefully -
scripts.translation: - 他低頭看著那對鍍金項鍊，小心翼翼地擦拭著 -

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
Who dares to come into my cave!
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
誰敢闖進我的洞穴！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Marozka? Maria sent me! I need your 'Golden Thread' to make a 'Golden Key' to release her from the wall!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是馬羅茲卡嗎？是瑪麗亞派我來的！我需要你的“金線”來製作“黃金色鑰匙”，以釋放被<黑暗蒐集者>牆困住的她！

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
...To make a 'Golden Key'?
Do you think that you are right for this job?
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
...製作“黃金色鑰匙”？
你以為自己適合做這件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
You must be fighting against 'Koshei' if you are asking about the 'Golden Key' and Maria! Do you think that you are strong enough to fight against him?
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
既然你在打聽“黃金色鑰匙”和瑪麗亞，那你一定是在對抗“科謝伊”！你以為自己有足夠的實力與他戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course I'm strong enough!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我當然有足夠的實力！

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
You are very confident.
But, I need to test you to see if you truly are capable.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
你很有自信。
但我需要測試你，看看你是否真的有能力。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
In this cave, there is a 'Stone Furnace' and an 'Apple Tree'.
You can escape from the cave with ^0000ff100 Well Baked Cookies^000000 from the Stone Furnace and ^0000ff100 Apples^000000 from the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
在這個洞穴裡，有一個“石爐”和一棵“蘋果樹”。
你可以用石爐裡的^0000ff100烤好的餅乾^000000和蘋果樹上的^0000ff100蘋果^000000離開洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
It won't be easy. Monsters are wandering around the Stone Furnace and the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
這不會容易。魔物在石爐和蘋果樹周圍遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
Show me what you can do.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的聲音]
讓我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
- You can see the -
- well baked cookies. -
- Be careful and -
- don't get burned -
scripts.translation:
- 你可以看到 -
- 烤好的餅乾。 -
- 小心一點， -
- 別被燙到 -

scripts.text:
- You quickly stretch out -
- your hand and pick up -
- the well baked cookies! -
scripts.translation:
- 你迅速伸出手 -
- 拿起了烤好的餅乾！ -

scripts.text:
- ^0000ffYou got 100^000000 -
- ^0000ffWell Baked Cookies!!^000000 -

- You quickly stretch out -
- your hand and pick up -
- the well baked cookies! -
scripts.translation:
- 你迅速伸出手 -
- 拿起了烤好的餅乾！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops, it's hot, hot!!!

[Marozka's Guard]
How did this rat get inside the cave?!
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡的衛兵]
這隻老鼠是怎麼鑽進洞穴裡的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
- There are Ripe Apples -
- growing in clusters. -
- But they are higher than -
- you expected them to be -
scripts.translation:
- 結實的蘋果 -
- 成串地生長著。 -
- 但它們比你 -
- 預想的要高 -

scripts.text:
- You hit the tree firmly, -
- and the apples fall down! -
scripts.translation:
- 你用力敲打樹幹， -
- 蘋果掉了下來！ -

scripts.text:
- You hit the tree firmly, -
- worms fall down! -
scripts.translation:
- 你用力敲打樹幹， -
- 蟲子掉了下來！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahhhhhhhh!!!
- ^0000ff You get 100 Apples !!^000000 -

[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

[馬羅茲卡]
...你來了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Marozka? Here, I've proven to you my strength now can you make me the 'Golden Thread'?
I need it to get Maria out of that wall.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是馬羅茲卡嗎？我已經向你證明了我的實力，現在你能給我製作“金線”嗎？
我需要它來把瑪麗亞從牆裡救出來。

scripts.text:
- You put the cookies and -
- apples in front of him -
- and he slowly utters -
scripts.translation:
- 你把餅乾和 -
- 蘋果放在他面前 -
- 他緩緩說道 -

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
正如你所知，製作“金線”非常困難，而且需要很長的時間。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
我現在就開始製作...讓我看看...你能在一小時後回來找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Ah, just in time.
I have finally finished making the 'Golden Thread'. Just wait one more second and it'll be ready.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
啊，正好趕上。
我終於完成了“金線”的製作。再等一秒，它就準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
正如你所知，製作“金線”非常困難，而且需要很長的時間。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
我現在就開始製作...讓我看看...你能在一小時後回來找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As promised, here's the 'Golden Thread'.
So, you are really going to fight Koshei the Immportal, eh?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
如約而至，這是“金線”。
所以，你真的要去挑戰不死者科斯希嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know but I promised to get Maria out of there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道，但我答應過要把瑪麗亞從那裡救出來。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Huh, Koshei is not your average adversary. Strength alone cannot beat him. You will need wisdom and an unfaltering spirit in order to win.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
科斯希可不是普通的對手。僅憑力量是無法戰勝他的。你需要智慧和堅定的意志才能獲勝。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Koshei will be extremely hostile to you because you are helping Maria.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
因為你幫助了瑪麗亞，科斯希會對你極度敵視。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Do you still want the Golden Thread? Ok, I will give it to you! But, there is one more test.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
你還要金線嗎？好吧，我會給你的！但是，還有一個考驗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
One more test?
Didn't I already prove my worth?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有一個考驗？
我不是已經證明了自己的價值嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
That was a test of your strength. Now you must pass the test of mind and wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
那是對你力量的考驗。現在，你必須通過智慧和心智的考驗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
...So? Have you decided?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
...那麼？你決定了嗎？

scripts.text: I need more time...
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間...

scripts.text: I will take it!
scripts.translation: 我接受！

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Ok then. Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
好吧。等你準備好了再回來。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
You will... Ok, let's get to it. You must answer all of these questions correctly in order to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
你會...好吧，讓我們開始吧。你必須正確回答所有這些問題才能通過考驗。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
What is deaf, dumb, and blind and always tells the truth?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
什麼東西是聾的、啞的、瞎的，卻總是說真話？

scripts.text: A Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: A Picky
scripts.translation: 小雞

scripts.text: A Mirror
scripts.translation: 鏡子

scripts.text: A Tree
scripts.translation: 樹

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
If 4 cats can catch 4 mice every 4 minutes, what is the minimum number of cats needed to get 10 mice in 10 minutes?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
如果4只貓每4分鐘能抓4只老鼠，那麼要在10分鐘內抓10只老鼠，最少需要幾隻貓？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Which of these gets shorter during winter and longer during summer?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
下列哪樣東西在冬天會變短，在夏天會變長？

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Day
scripts.translation: 白天

scripts.text: Waves
scripts.translation: 波浪

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Doris Etticoat, wears a petticoat and has a red nose; the longer she stands, the shorter she grows. What is she?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
多麗絲·艾提科特，穿著襯裙，有著紅色的鼻子；她站得越久，身體就越短。她是什麼？

scripts.text: A Star
scripts.translation: 星星

scripts.text: A Candle
scripts.translation: 蠟燭

scripts.text: A Sword
scripts.translation: 劍

scripts.text: The Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
My top and bottom are twins of a kind. The middle of me makes one body combined. If I stand tall and still, run faster I will. What am I?
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
我的頭和腳是某種意義上的雙胞胎。我的中間部分將兩者結合成一個整體。如果我站得筆直靜止，我跑得就會更快。我是什麼？

scripts.text: A Woman
scripts.translation: 女子

scripts.text: Valkyrie
scripts.translation: 瓦爾基里

scripts.text: The Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: An Hourglass
scripts.translation: 沙漏

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Now let's see how you did.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
現在來看看你的表現吧。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
You got all of them correct.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
你全部答對了。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I told you before that I wouldn't give you the Golden Thread until you got all questions correct.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
我之前說過，除非你答對所有問題，否則我不會把金線給你。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
It is not too late to try again. With wisdom comes patience.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
現在再試一次也不晚。智慧伴隨著耐心。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I know that a quiz is a strange way of evaluating a person's wisdom. But, it is my way of knowing if you are truly committed to fighting Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
我知道用問答來評判一個人的智慧有些奇怪。但這是我確認你是否真的下定決心要對抗科斯希的方式。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I hope you help Maria with your strength and kindness.
scripts.translation:
[馬羅茲卡]
希望你能用你的力量和善良去幫助瑪麗亞。

scripts.text:
- He closes his eyes -
- and stands still -
scripts.translation:
- 他閉上了眼睛 -
- 靜靜地站著 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
...........................
If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
...........................
你們要是再在這裡閒逛，我就把自己煮成一鍋美味的人肉湯！嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Why are you here, you yummy looking human? If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你們這些看起來很好吃的人類，為什麼在這裡？要是再在這裡閒逛，我就把自己煮成一鍋美味的人肉湯！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I, ah, I.. Gold.. golden...

[Baba Yaga]
What are you babbling about?
Do you want me to transform you into a savage beast?!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你在胡說什麼？
要不要我把你變成一隻野獸？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Presto Change-o!!'
'Turn into a pig!!'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“變變變！！”
“變成豬！！”

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmm? You are protected by a Protection Spell?
But, it was weake. My spell destroyed it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯？你被保護咒語保護著？
但是，它很弱。我的咒語摧毀了它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Leave now, or I will curse you again! 'Presto...'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
現在離開，否則我會再次詛咒你！“變變變...”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...

[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
{1} !!!

[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
{1} !!!

[Baba Yaga]
What are you planning to do with that weak spell!?
Get away, child!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你打算用那個弱小的咒語做什麼？！
快滾，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ho, you are protected by a Protection Spell. You are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
哦，你被保護咒語保護著。你不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you are able to make the 'Golden Key' and that's why I am here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說你能製作“黃金色鑰匙”，所以我才來到這裡！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Golden Key'? Why do you need it?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“黃金色鑰匙”？你為什麼要它？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need it to release Maria Mobrena from her dark wall prison.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要它來釋放瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜，把她從黑暗之牆中解救出來。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
...Maria Morebna...
Are you fighting against Koshei?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
...瑪麗亞·莫雷布娜...
你是在對抗科斯希嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he gets in my way of keeping my promise to her, I guess that I will fight him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他阻礙我履行對她的承諾，我想我會和他戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ho, kiheeheheheheheh. Ehehehehehehe.
You are interesting. You don't seem to be scared of Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
呵呵，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
你很有趣。你似乎並不害怕科斯希。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok, the materials for the key are...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，製作鑰匙的材料是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You have already gatered all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你已經收集齊所有材料了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What? I cannot make you the 'Golden Key' without the materials.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
什麼？沒有材料，我無法為你製作“黃金色鑰匙”。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Go and find ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
去收集^0000ff2 詛咒紅寶石、3個金幣、1個紅戒指、2份盧莎卡的頭髮、10根金線^000000！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok, let's begin. Ah, before that... Wait here!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，讓我們開始吧。啊，在那之前...站在這裡別動！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You come here!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你過來！

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga looks -
- at you carefully -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎 -
- 仔細地打量著你 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmmm, you look energetic and strong. Ok, while I make the 'Golden Key', you must first do a favor for me!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，你看起來精力充沛且強壯。好吧，在我製作“黃金色鑰匙”的時候，你必須先幫我一個忙！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
My cow has run away. Find her and cast a Return Spell on her. The spell is '^ff0000Good feed is orange-flavored^000000'. You sould remember it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
我的奶牛跑掉了。找到她並對她施放“返回”法術。法術是'^ff0000好吃的飼料是橙色的^000000'。你應該記得它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快點，否則我會想辦法懲罰你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Behind my house, there is noisy coffin. It has been so nosiy recently that I can't sleep. Silence it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
在我房子後面，有一個吵鬧的棺材。最近它太吵了，讓我無法入睡。讓它安靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快點，否則我會想辦法懲罰你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Please find my silver spoons. Those bad pirates stole them. I can feel them around the wrecked ship. Bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
請找到我的銀勺子。那些壞海盜偷走了它們。我能感覺到它們在沉船附近。把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快點，否則我會想辦法懲罰你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Buy me a magic book. It is published by Momotaro in Amatsu. Go there and buy it for me.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
幫我買一本魔法書。它是櫻花城的桃太郎出版的。去那裡幫我買回來。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快點，否則我會想辦法懲罰你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Can you see a jar next to the cabin? There is a House ghost living in there. Drive him out of there. He irritates me a lot.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你能看到小屋旁邊的罐子嗎？裡面住著一個屋中幽靈。把它趕出去。它讓我很煩躁。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快點，否則我會想辦法懲罰你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Go to the Broom Grandmother in Payon and buy me a broom. It is best for cleaning but I don't have time to go there.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
去斐揚的掃帚祖母那裡幫我買一把掃帚。它最適合打掃衛生，但我沒時間親自去。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
請找到我的銀勺子。那些壞海盜偷走了它們。我能感覺到它們在沉船附近。把它們帶給我。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

Buy me a magic book. It is published by Momotaro in Amatsu. Go there and buy it for me.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga takes the book, -
reads one of the pages, -
and casts something -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎接過書， -
讀了一頁， -
然後施放了什麼 -

scripts.text:

'Keep off the grass!!!'
scripts.translation:

“禁止踐踏草坪！！！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, what is this, suddenly?!

[Baba Yaga]

scripts.translation:

呵...這是為了美麗的花園。這比我預期的要好。那麼，讓我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, are you listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

'There is an order for you to open your eyes!!!'
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you doing!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在幹什麼！！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmm, this one makes people deligent and doesn't look effective. Ok then, next is a House Ghost...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，這個讓人變得勤勉，看起來沒什麼效果。那麼，下一個是屋中幽靈...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, I am talking...

[Baba Yaga]
'In the corner...'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“在角落裡...”

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What, child? Do you feel bad?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
怎麼了，孩子？你感覺不舒服嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When will you give me the key?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你什麼時候給我鑰匙？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Huh, I can make it for you right now. You have a violent temper.
scripts.translation:

哈，我現在就可以為你製作。你的脾氣真暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Go to the Broom Grandmother in Payon and buy me a broom. It is best for cleaning but I don't have time to go there.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
去斐揚的掃帚祖母那裡幫我買一把掃帚。它最適合打掃衛生，但我沒時間親自去。

scripts.text:

I have done your favor! I got the cow!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我幫你辦好了！我抓住了奶牛！

scripts.text:

Oh, great. I just finished making the 'Golden Key'!
scripts.translation:

哦，太好了。我剛做好“黃金色鑰匙”！

scripts.text:

Here, help Maria with this key and watch out for Koshei. He is very dangerous. Kehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:

拿著，幫瑪麗亞用這把鑰匙，小心科斯赫。他非常危險。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have done your favor! The coffin is now silenced!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我幫你辦好了！棺材現在安靜了！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Oh, yes. I can sleep at night now. Kehehehehe.
scripts.translation:

哦，是的。我現在晚上能睡個好覺了。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

Oh, yes, yes. Give them to me.

哦，是的，是的。把它們給我。

Here they.. They..?!

You fool! Where did you sell my spoons!? Get them for me right now!

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我幫你辦好了！看，斐揚最好的掃帚！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ooh, yes. Well done. My flying broom was getting old. Kehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
噢，是的。做得好。我的飛行掃帚已經舊了。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You are on time. I just finished making the 'Golden Key'!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You got the key and went to Maria immedately, right?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你拿到鑰匙後，立刻去找瑪麗亞了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Take care of yourself. When you release her, Koshei will come out and bring destruction.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
照顧好你自己。當你釋放她時，科斯赫就會出來，帶來毀滅。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What are you doing here? Kehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你在這裡做什麼？嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Koshei... suddenly appeared.. and Maria.. Wolf... killed...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
科斯赫...突然出現了...然後瑪麗亞...狼...殺死了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Calm down and speak slowly. I cannot hear you at all. Drink some water.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
冷靜點，慢慢說。我完全聽不清你在說什麼。喝點水吧。

scripts.text:
- You drink some water and -
- tell her the story slowly -
scripts.translation:
- 你喝了一些水 -
- 慢慢地把故事告訴她 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You beat Koshei? Did you?
Kehehe, you are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你打敗了科斯赫？真的嗎？
嘿嘿，你可不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Water to enliven Maria...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
讓瑪麗亞復活的水...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Living Water'... I just need the ingredients.  I need ^0000ff1 Holy Water^000000 and ^0000ff2 Yggdrasil Leaves^000000.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“生命之水”...我只需要材料。我需要^0000ff1聖水^000000和^0000ff2世界樹葉子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
And 'Dead Water'.. I need ^0000ff1 Cursed Water^000000 and ^0000ff10 Hinalle Leaflets^000000.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
還有“死亡之水”...我需要^0000ff1暗水^000000和^0000ff10西納雷葉子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Bring them to me quickly! Time is running out!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
快點把它們帶給我！時間不多了！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Kehe, you are very quick.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嘿嘿，你動作真快。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok, let's make the 'Living Water' first...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好，我們先製作“生命之水”...

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga brings a big pot, -
- pours the Holy Water in it, -
- puts the Yggdrasil Leaves -
- in it and stirs them up -
- as it casts strange spells -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎拿出一個大鍋，-
- 將聖水倒入其中，-
- 放入世界樹葉子，-
- 一邊攪拌一邊吟唱著-
- 奇怪的咒語 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Yg~ Yg~ Yggdrasil~ Yggdrasil has lots of iron~
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
伊格~伊格~世界樹~世界樹富含鐵質~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Here, I made the 'Living Water' so now let's make the 'Dead Water'...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好了，“生命之水”做好了，現在我們來製作“死亡之水”...

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga pours the cursed -
- water in another pot, then -
- pounds the Hinalle leaflets, -
- puts their juice in the pot -
- and stirs them together -
- as it casts strange spells -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎將暗水倒入-
- 另一個鍋中，然後-
- 搗碎西納雷葉子，-
- 將汁液倒入鍋中-
- 一邊攪拌一邊吟唱著-
- 奇怪的咒語 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hi~ hi~ hi~ hi~ na~ lle~ Stir with right hand~ Stir with left hand~ Both hands will be ok~
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
希~希~希~希~娜~蕾~右手攪拌~左手攪拌~雙手一起也可以~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Here, it's done.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好了，完成了。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Take this and help Maria. Kehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
拿著這個去幫助瑪麗亞吧。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
First, pour the 'Dead Water' to remove the wound and curse on her and then pour the 'Living Water' to enliven her.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
首先，倒出“死亡之水”去除她身上的傷口和詛咒，然後倒出“生命之水”讓她復活。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Go there right now! Kehehehehe
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
現在立刻去吧！嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You are more useful than I thought, kid.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你比我想像的要更有用，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
I thank you for helping Maria. To tell the truth, it was me that connected her with Koshei. In order to seal Koshei, I needed a sacrfice...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
謝謝你幫助瑪麗亞。說實話，是我把她和科謝伊聯絡在一起的。為了封印科謝伊，我需要一個祭品...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
I succeeded in sealing Koshei away by using a girl who was magically strong. Sadly the girl also had to remain in the same condition as Koshei in order to maintain the seal.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
我成功利用一個魔力強大的女孩封印了科謝伊。不幸的是，為了維持封印，那個女孩也必須保持與科謝伊相同的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
However, after so many years it was impossible to keep him sealed with Maria's power alone.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
然而，過了這麼多年，僅靠瑪麗亞的力量已經無法繼續封印他了。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
So that's when I decided that if you could subdue Koshei, it would be the only way to release Maria instead of using her to maintain the seal.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
所以，我決定如果你能制服科謝伊，那就是釋放瑪麗亞、不再利用她維持封印的唯一方法。

scripts.text:

嗯，沒錯，這是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Momotoro Publisher]
You don't have enough money?
Check it again and come to me, please
scripts.translation:
[桃太郎出版社]
您的錢不夠嗎？
請確認後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Momotoro Publisher]
Thank you for buying our books. If you need more books, contact us please.
scripts.translation:
[桃太郎出版社]
感謝您購買我們的書。如果您還需要更多書，請聯絡我們。

scripts.text:
[Momotoro Publisher]
Thank you for buying our books. If you need more books, contact us please.
scripts.translation:
[桃太郎出版社]
感謝您購買我們的書。如果您還需要更多書，請聯絡我們。

scripts.text:
[Momotoro Publisher]
Did you order a book?
scripts.translation:
[桃太郎出版社]
您預訂了書嗎？

scripts.text:
[Momotoro Publisher]
Someone ordered a book but did not pick it up.
scripts.translation:
[桃太郎出版社]
有人預訂了書，但還沒有來取。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Is it in here..? Hey, hey...

- You tap the jar -
- with your hand -
scripts.translation: - 你用手敲了敲罐子 -

scripts.text:
- A voice laughs in the jar as -
- it shakes from right to left -
scripts.translation:
- 罐子裡傳來笑聲 -
- 它從左向右搖晃 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You! No more games! Come out of there!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你！別鬧了！快出來！

scripts.text:
- You kick the jar -
- it rolls to the floor -
- as bugs come out!! -
scripts.translation:
- 你踢了罐子 -
- 它滾到了地上 -
- 蟲子爬了出來！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ehh.. you, what are you doing!!

- As you plan to kick the jar -
- again, something scared -
- utters in a shaky voice -
scripts.translation:
- 當你準備再次踢罐子時 -
- 裡面傳來顫抖的聲音 -

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
No! Please stop it! I was wrong!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
不！請停下！我錯了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I have been bored. After dying, I've had nothing to do and no friends to play with..
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
我真的很無聊。死後，我無事可做，也沒有朋友可以一起玩...

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
When I was alive, I always stayed still, but now it's too boring...
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
活著的時候，我總是待在原地，但現在實在太無聊了...

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I can't even drink my favorite milk... Being a ghost is too inconvenient.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
我甚至喝不了我最喜歡的牛奶...當幽靈真是太不方便了。

scripts.text: Can I play with you?
scripts.translation: 我可以和你一起玩嗎？

scripts.text: So what can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 那我該為你做些什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ehhh, are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
呃...你確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Hmm, can you do something for me? It won't take much time.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
嗯，你能幫我做點事嗎？不會花太多時間的。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
What about a card game? I was good at those games! Ah, where are my cards? Wait here! I'll find them!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
玩紙牌遊戲怎麼樣？我很擅長這些遊戲！啊，我的牌在哪裡？等一下！我去找找！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Hehe, what about a card game? I have an Angeling, Ghostring and a Poring Card.
All you have to do is just guess which card I pick up!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
嘿嘿，玩紙牌遊戲怎麼樣？我有一張天使波利卡片、一張幽靈波利卡片和一張波利卡片。
你只需要猜我拿起的是哪一張！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Let's play best out of 5. So if you win 3 games, I promise to stay quiet!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
我們玩五局三勝吧。如果你贏了3局，我保證保持安靜！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok! It will be fun. Let's do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！聽起來很有趣。我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok, first let me shuffle these cards around.
Ready!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
好，先讓我把這些牌洗一洗。
準備好了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
一！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One! Two!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
一！二！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok! I will pick one of them up!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
好！我要拿起其中一張了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok! I will pick one of them up!
What is this card?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
好！我要拿起其中一張了！
這張是什麼卡片？

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Angeling
scripts.translation: 天使波利

scripts.text: Ghostring
scripts.translation: 幽靈波利

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmmm, I think it is the {1} Card!

[House Ghost]
Ok, time to find out!
One! Two! Three!!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
好，是時候揭曉答案了！
一！二！三！！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Huuu...
Better luck next time!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
呼...
下次再加油吧！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
You are better than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
你比我想像的要厲害呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly! Let's do it again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛才沒想清楚！我們再來一次吧！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Huhu, ok. Let's do it again?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
呼呼，好吧。我們再來一次？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ah, it was fun. It has been a long time since I've been able to play a game like that.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
啊，真有趣。好久沒有玩過這樣的遊戲了。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
As promised, I will be quiet now. Thank you for playing with me.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
說到做到，我現在會安靜下來的。謝謝你陪我玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh and by the way, I have a present for you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，順便說一句，我有禮物要送給你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said you like milk. Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說你喜歡牛奶。來，拿著這個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said you like milk. Here, take.. Eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說你喜歡牛奶。來，拿...咦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, where is this? Wait here. I will bring it soon!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，這是哪裡？你在這裡等一下。我馬上拿來！！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ah, wow!! Can I have this?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
啊，哇！！我可以收下這個嗎？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Thank you so much!!
I promise I wil be quiet now. I will be the acting guardian for this house!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
太感謝您了！！
我保證現在會安靜下來。我會擔任這座房子的守護靈！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I will never forget your kindness of entertaining me.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
我會永遠銘記您陪我玩的這份好意。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Thank you so much!!
I promise I wil be quiet now. I will be the acting guardian for this house!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
太感謝您了！！
我保證現在會安靜下來。我會擔任這座房子的守護靈！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I will never forget your kindness of entertaining me.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽靈]
我會永遠銘記您陪我玩的這份好意。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
A broom from Payon is the best!
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
斐揚產的掃帚是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
It is so good that even ghosts want only a Payon broom.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
它好得連幽靈都只想要斐揚產的掃帚。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
A broom from Payon is best!
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
斐揚產的掃帚是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
It is so good that even ghosts want only a Payon broom.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
它好得連幽靈都只想要斐揚產的掃帚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to buy a broom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想買一把掃帚。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Oh, you are a guest. Yes, you need a broom?
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
哦，你是客人。是的，你需要一把掃帚？

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
But, I have no broom. Ghosts stole all my newly made brooms. I was pleased because they were nice even for ghosts. But...
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
但是，我沒有掃帚了。幽靈把我新做的掃帚都偷走了。我本來很高興，因為那些掃帚做得很好，連幽靈都喜歡。但是...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
My son went to their place to get back the brooms, but he failed since the ghosts tricked him.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
我的兒子去他們那裡想把掃帚拿回來，但失敗了，因為幽靈騙了他。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah.. What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
啊...我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
There are ghosts inside the dungeon of Payon. There is a tree there where the ghosts is hiding.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
斐揚的地下城里有一些幽靈。那裡有一棵樹，幽靈們就藏在樹裡。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
My son went to their place to get back the brooms, but he failed since the ghosts tricked him.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
我的兒子去他們那裡想把掃帚拿回來，但失敗了，因為幽靈騙了他。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah.. What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
啊...我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah, you have taken them back. You are a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
啊，你把它們拿回來了。你真是一位偉大的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
You can have that broom. I believe it is its destiny.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
這把掃帚你可以拿走了。我相信這是它的命運。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
A broom from Payon is the best!
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
斐揚產的掃帚是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
It is so good that even ghosts want only a Payon broom.
scripts.translation:
[掃帚婆婆]
它好得連幽靈都只想要斐揚產的掃帚。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Errr, a human? What are you doing here? Do you want to play with me?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
呃...人類？你在這裡做什麼？想跟我玩嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Return the broom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
把掃帚還給我。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhuhu, if you want it, you must give me the correct answers to my questions!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼呼，如果你想要的話，就必須回答我的問題！

scripts.text: Ok, ask me!
scripts.translation: 好，問吧！

scripts.text: No, just give it to me!
scripts.translation: 不，直接給我！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
What!? You are rude to ask for what you want by doing nothing!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
什麼？什麼都不做就想要東西，太無禮了！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Get away! You must be punished!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
走開！你必須受到懲罰！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, you a cool kid?!
I like a person confident as talented. Let's begin the test!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，你是個酷小孩嗎？！
我喜歡自信又天才的人。讓我們開始測試吧！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Eh.. Let's see. This will be a good start! Let's get started if you are ready!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
呃...讓我看看。這會是好的開始！如果你準備好了，我們就開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
First question. Listen to me carefully and answer the question!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
第一個問題。仔細聽我說，然後回答問題！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kafra sisters had a race. Listen to what they say and guess their ranking in the race. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
卡普拉姐妹們進行了一場比賽。聽她們說的話，猜猜她們在比賽中的排名。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok, then, listen to them.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
好，那麼，聽她們說。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
I am not good at running but Jasmine won over me and I won over Blossom.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
我不擅長跑步，但賈絲敏贏了我，而我贏了布洛森。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
I think that the smaller you are, the less the air disturbs you. Curly Sue was so fast that I couldn't follow her.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
我覺得你越小，空氣阻力就越小。捲毛蘇跑得那麼快，我根本追不上她。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Jasmine]
I won over Pavianne, but not Curly Sue. Huhu.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 賈絲敏]
我贏了狄波羅太，但沒有贏捲毛蘇。呼呼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Curly Sue]
Wohuhu, it was difficult to race with the fast runners. Anyway, I am pleased to win over Roxie!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 捲毛蘇]
嗚呼呼，和跑得快的選手比賽真難。不過，我很高興贏了洛克茜！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Pavianne]
...I wasn't the last one even though Roxie won over me...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 狄波羅太]
...雖然被洛克茜超過了，但我並不是最後一名...

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok then, who was the first?!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
那麼，誰是第一名？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Who was the second?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
誰是第二名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Who was the third?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
誰是第三名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
And then who was the forth?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
那麼，誰是第四名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
And who was the last?!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
誰是最後一名？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ho, you are good!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
呵，你很不錯嘛！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ah, you are wrong, wrong!
Do you really think that you can take the brooms back?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
啊，你錯了，錯了！
你真的以為這樣就能拿回掃帚嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok, let's see if you are good next time.
Gear yourself up!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
好吧，讓我們看看下次你表現如何。
做好準備！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly! I will try it again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛才沒想清楚！我要再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, ok. Let's do it again. Try your best.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，好吧。我們再來一次。盡力而為吧。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
The second question. Listen carefully and answer!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
第二個問題。仔細聽好並回答！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
One day, you, {0}, upgraded your 'Hat of the Sun God', your ancestral treasure.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
有一天，你，{0}，升級了你的傳家寶“太陽神頭盔”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh? I didn't...

[Ghost Tree]
Shut up! Listen to me!
While Aragam, Antonio, Hermanthorn, and Holgren, 4 blacksmiths, upgraded the 'Hat of the Sun God' in turn, it was broken!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
閉嘴！聽我說！
當阿拉甘、安東尼奧、赫曼索恩和霍爾格倫這四位鐵匠輪流升級“太陽神頭盔”時，它壞了！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
The stauts of 'Hat of the Sun God' was +7. Here, you guess who broke it!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
“太陽神頭盔”的狀態是+7。來，猜猜是誰弄壞的！

scripts.text:
[Aragam]
I heard that Holgren upraded it up to +7. It was overpace.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉甘]
我聽說霍爾格倫把它升到了+7。那是過度升級。

scripts.text:
[Antonio]
...We upgraded it twice for each...
scripts.translation:
[安東尼奧]
...我們每人升級了兩次...

scripts.text:
[Hermanthorn]
Hogren worked after me.
scripts.translation:
[赫曼索恩]
霍爾格倫是在我之後工作的。

scripts.text:
[Holgren]
I did it after Aragam!
scripts.translation:
[霍爾格倫]
我是在阿拉甘之後做的！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Have you heard all of them? Who broke the 'Hat of the Sun God'?!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
你們都聽完了嗎？到底是誰弄壞了“太陽神頭盔”？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
You are wrong, wrong!
Look at this. In this way, it will take you a million years to take them back!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
你錯了，大錯特錯！
看看這個。照這樣下去，你要花上百萬年才能把它們拿回來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly!!!
Again, again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛才沒想清楚！！！
再來一次，再來一次！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, Ok then. You should do better next time!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，好吧。下次你應該表現得更出色一些！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Good! Well done. The last one is to cast a dice with me! If you win over me, I will give you what you want!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
很好！幹得不錯。最後一關是和我擲骰子！如果你贏過我，我就給你想要的東西！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Gear yourself up and come to me again!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
準備好裝備，再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, you did good until now. If you win over me, I will give the brooms as promisied.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，你到目前為止表現不錯。如果你贏過我，我會如約把掃帚給你。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
The game is simple. Your number must be more than mine.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
遊戲規則很簡單。你的點數必須比我大。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Cast 3 times if you win once, I will give you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
擲三次，只要贏一次，我就給你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok! I will do it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！我接受挑戰！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
I cast first.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
我先擲。

scripts.text: - Ghost Tree casts a dice. The dice falls down, rotates and stops there-
scripts.translation: - 幽靈樹擲骰子。骰子落下，旋轉，然後停在那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
I've got ^0000ffNumber {0}^000000.

[{0}]
Ok, it is my turn?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，輪到我了？

scripts.text: -You cast a dice. The dice falls down, rotates and stops there-
scripts.translation: - 你擲骰子。骰子落下，旋轉，然後停在那裡 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...

[{0}]
Let's see... Wow, I got it! I've got ^0000ffNumber {1}^000000!

[Ghost Tree]
You seem lucky...
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
你似乎很幸運...

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ah. I lost, but it was fun.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
啊。雖然我輸了，但過程很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
For the fun play, I will give the broom to you as promised.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
為了這場有趣的對局，我會如約把掃帚送給你。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
I can say that you are fun. If possible, play with me again. And take them.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
不得不說，你很有趣。如果可能的話，請再和我玩一次。這些也請收下。

scripts.text: - ^0000ff You receive the best broom from Payon !!^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^0000ff 你獲得了斐揚最好的掃帚！！^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, nobody is worse than you. Remember that you have to win over me to get what you want
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，沒有人比你更差勁了。記住，想要得到你想要的東西，就必須贏過我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not what I am! Let's do it again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我剛才不是那個樣子！再來一次！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok, let's play again. If prepared, try again?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
好的，我們再來一局。準備好了就再試一次？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, I can say that you are fun. If possible, play with me again.
scripts.translation:
[幽靈樹]
庫呼呼，不得不說，你很有趣。如果可能的話，請再和我玩一次。
